```sql
				WHEN DAY(T.DataZero) < 22 AND DAY(T.DataZero) > 14 THEN 15

							WHEN DAY(T.DataZero) < 15 AND DAY(T.DataZero) > 7 THEN 8
							WHEN DAY(T.DataZero) < 22 AND DAY(T.DataZero) > 14 THEN 15
							WHEN DAY(T.DataZero) > 21 THEN 22

			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDCV + C.PDCV, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIN + C.PDIN,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PDIV + C.PDIV,
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFN + C.PSFN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSFV + C.PSFV,	CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCN + C.PSCN, 
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSCV + C.PSCV, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIN + C.PSIN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.PSIV + C.PSIV,
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.TotJobs = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.TotJobs + C.TotJobs,
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SN + C.SN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.SV + C.SV,
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EN = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EN + C.EN, CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EV = CubeCostAccountIDWeek.EV + C.EV
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					T.DataZero, T.CostAccountID,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDFN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDFV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDCN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDCV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDIN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDIV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSFN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSFV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSCN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSCV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSIN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSIV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDFN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDFV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDCN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDCV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDIN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDIV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSFN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSFV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSCN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSCV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSIN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSIV,
					SUM(TotalJobs) AS TotJobs,
					SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 4 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS SN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 4 THEN CostMono  ELSE 0 END) AS SV,
					SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 5 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS EN,
					SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 5 THEN CostMono  ELSE 0 END) AS EV
				FROM
					@Temp T
				GROUP BY
					T.DataZero, T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
		WHERE
			CubeCostAccountIDWeek.yearw = YEAR(C.DataZero)
			AND CubeCostAccountIDWeek.monthw = MONTH(C.DataZero)
			AND (CubeCostAccountIDWeek.dayw = (CASE
													WHEN DAY(C.DataZero) < 8 THEN 1
													WHEN DAY(C.DataZero) < 15 AND DAY(C.DataZero) > 7 THEN 8
													WHEN DAY(C.DataZero) < 22 AND DAY(C.DataZero) > 14 THEN 15
													WHEN DAY(C.DataZero) > 21 THEN 22 
												END)
			OR CubeCostAccountIDWeek.dayw = 28)
			AND CubeCostAccountIDWeek.CostAccountID = C.CostAccountID

		--*************** CUBOS NUCLEO *************************

		IF (@DataAtual >= @StartDate)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				CubeCore
			SELECT
				DataZero,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDFN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDFV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDCN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDCV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDIN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CDIV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSFN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSFV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSCN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSCV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN PagesColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSIN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesColor > 0 THEN CostColor ELSE 0 END) AS CSIV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDFN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDFV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDCN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDCV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDIN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 1 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PDIV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSFN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 3 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSFV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSCN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 2 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSCV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSIN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PrintWayID = 0 AND JobTypeID = 1 AND PagesMono > 0 THEN CostMono ELSE 0 END) AS PSIV,
				SUM(TotalJobs) AS TotJobs,
				SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 4 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS SN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 4 THEN CostMono  ELSE 0 END) AS SV,
				SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 5 THEN PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS EN,
				SUM(CASE WHEN JobTypeID = 5 THEN CostMono  ELSE 0 END) AS EV
			FROM
				@Temp
			GROUP BY
				DataZero

			--*************** CUBOS DE ANALISE *************************

			INSERT INTO
				CubeAnalyze
			SELECT
				T.DataZero,
				T.AccountID,
				T.CostAccountID,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PaperSizeId = 9 THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS A4,
				SUM(CASE WHEN PaperSizeId <> 9 THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS NA4,
				SUM(CASE WHEN OutTime = 0 THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS InTime,
				SUM(CASE WHEN OutTime = 1 THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS OutTime,
				SUM(CASE WHEN dbo.ReturnPrinterQueueTypeID(T.PrinterQueueID) = 1  THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS [Local],
				SUM(CASE WHEN dbo.ReturnPrinterQueueTypeID(T.PrinterQueueID) <> 1 THEN PagesColor + PagesMono ELSE 0 END) AS Net
			FROM
				@Temp T
			WHERE
				T.JobTypeID IN (1, 2, 3)
			GROUP BY
				T.DataZero, T.AccountID, T.CostAccountID
		END

		PRINT 'Terminou às ' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR,GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR ) + ':' +
							   CAST(DATEPART(MINUTE,GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR ) +  ':' +
							   CAST(DATEPART(SECOND,GETDATE()) AS NVARCHAR) + ' os jobs do dia ' + CAST(YEAR(@DataAtual) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' +
																								  CAST(MONTH(@DataAtual) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' +
																								  CAST(DAY(@DataAtual) AS NVARCHAR)

		DELETE FROM
			@days
		WHERE
			DatePrinted = @DataAtual

	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Cubes_RecalcAnalize

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Cubes_RecalcAnalize]
@Date AS SMALLDATETIME = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON 

	DECLARE @DateAux SMALLDATETIME
	DECLARE @DataAtual DATETIME, @DataFim DATETIME, @Total INT
	DECLARE @Temp TABLE (PrinterQueueID INT, AccountID INT, PaperSizeID INT, Pages INT, CostAccountID INT, DataZero DATETIME, OutTime BIT)
	DECLARE @Days TABLE (DatePrinted DATETIME)

	BEGIN TRAN--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

		UPDATE CubeProcessing SET ServiceName = 'RecalcAnalise ' + Convert(NVARCHAR(40), getdate(), 121)

		IF (@Date IS NULL)
		BEGIN 
			PRINT 'Limpando todo o cubo de análise...'
			
			DELETE FROM CubeAnalyze

			INSERT INTO
				@Days 
			SELECT 
				CONVERT(DATETIME,CAST(Y AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(M AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(D AS NVARCHAR),20) AS DatePrinted  
			FROM
				( 
					SELECT DISTINCT
						YEAR(DatePrinted)AS Y, MONTH(DatePrinted) AS M , DAY(DatePrinted) AS D
					FROM
						PrintJobs
				) AS Dias 
			ORDER BY
				DatePrinted DESC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			PRINT 'Limpando cubo de análise a partir de data...'
			
			DELETE FROM CubeAnalyze WHERE Data >= @Date
			
			SET @DateAux = CONVERT(DATETIME,CAST(YEAR(@Date) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@Date) AS NVARCHAR) + '-01',20) --pega desde o começo do mes

			INSERT INTO
				@Days 
			SELECT 
				CONVERT(DATETIME,CAST(Y AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(M AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(D AS NVARCHAR),20) AS DatePrinted  
			FROM
				( 
					SELECT DISTINCT
						YEAR(DatePrinted)AS Y, MONTH(DatePrinted) AS M , DAY(DatePrinted) AS D FROM PrintJobs
					WHERE
						DatePrinted >= @DateAux
				) AS Dias
			ORDER BY 
				DatePrinted DESC
		END 

		----------------------------------------------------------
		DECLARE @TempVal NVARCHAR(5)
		DECLARE @AfternoonBeginHour SMALLINT
		DECLARE @AfternoonBeginMinute SMALLINT
		DECLARE @AfternoonEndHour SMALLINT
		DECLARE @AfternoonEndMinute SMALLINT
		DECLARE @MorningBeginHour SMALLINT
		DECLARE @MorningBeginMinute SMALLINT
		DECLARE @MorningEndHour SMALLINT
		DECLARE @MorningEndMinute SMALLINT

		SELECT @TempVal = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkAfternoonBegin'

		IF (@TempVal IS NULL)
		BEGIN 
			SET @TempVal = '12:00'
		END

		PRINT 'Horário de entrada verspertino: ' + @TempVal 

		SET @AfternoonBeginHour = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,1,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)
		SET @AfternoonBeginMinute = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,4,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)

		SET @TempVal = NULL 
		SELECT @TempVal = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkAfternoonEnd'

		IF (@TempVal IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @TempVal = '18:00'
		END

		PRINT 'Horário de saída vespertino: ' + @TempVal 

		SET @AfternoonENDHour = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,1,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)
		SET @AfternoonENDMinute = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,4,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)

		SET @TempVal = NULL 
		SELECT @TempVal = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkMorningBegin'

		IF (@TempVal IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @TempVal = '08:00'
		END

		PRINT 'Horário de entrada matinal: ' + @TempVal 

		SET @MorningBeginHour = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,1,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)
		SET @MorningBeginMinute = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,4,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)

		SET @TempVal = NULL 
		SELECT @TempVal = ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'TimeWorkMorningEND'

		IF (@TempVal IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @TempVal = '12:00'
		END

		PRINT 'Horário de saída matinal: ' + @TempVal 

		SET @MorningEndHour = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,1,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)
		SET @MorningEndMinute = CAST(SUBSTRING (@TempVal,4,charindex(':', @TempVal) -1) AS SMALLINT)
		-------------------------------------------------------------------

		WHILE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @Days) <>  0 
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				@DataAtual = DatePrinted 
			FROM
				@Days
				
			SET @DataFim = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @DataAtual)

			PRINT 'Atualizando dados do dia ' + CAST(@DataAtual AS NVARCHAR)  + ' às ' + CAST(datepart(hh,getdate()) AS NVARCHAR ) + ':' + CAST(datepart(mi,getdate()) AS NVARCHAR ) +  ':' + CAST(datepart(ss,getdate()) AS NVARCHAR)

			IF (@Date IS NULL)
			BEGIN 
				--se não foi passado data, atualizo o valor da variavel pra arrumar os cubos CuboX e CuboXobj
				SET @Date = @DataAtual
			END 

			DELETE FROM @Temp
			
			INSERT INTO
				@Temp	
			SELECT
				PrinterQueueID,
				AccountID,
				PaperSizeID,
				SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor) AS Pages,
				CostAccountID,
				DataZero,
				OutTime
			FROM
				(
					SELECT
						CASE WHEN PrinterQueueID IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE PrinterQueueID END AS PrinterQueueID,
						AccountID,
						PaperSizeID, 
						PagesColor,
						PagesMono, 
						CASE WHEN CostAccountID IS NULL THEN -1 ELSE CostAccountID END AS CostAccountID,
						@DataAtual AS DataZero,
						CASE WHEN 
							(((DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) = @MorningBEGINHour AND DATEPART(mi,dateprinted) >= @MorningBEGINMinute) OR DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) >= (@MorningBEGINHour + 1)) AND 
							((DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) = @MorningENDHour AND DATEPART(mi,dateprinted) <= @MorningENDMinute) OR DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) <= (@MorningENDHour-1)))
							OR
							(((DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) = @AfternoonBEGINHour AND DATEPART(mi,dateprinted) >= @AfternoonBEGINMinute) OR DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) >= (@AfternoonBEGINHour+1)) AND 
							((DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) = @AfternoonENDHour AND DATEPART(mi,dateprinted) <= @AfternoonENDMinute) OR DATEPART(hh,dateprinted) <= (@AfternoonENDHour-1)))
						THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS OutTime -- 1 - fora do horario de trabalho, 0 - dentro			
					FROM
						PrintJobs J  			
					WHERE
						DatePrinted >= @DataAtual AND DatePrinted < @DataFim 
						AND JobDisabled = 0 
						AND J.JobTypeID in (1, 2, 3)
				) AS TABLE01
			GROUP BY
				PrinterQueueID, AccountID, PaperSizeID, CostAccountID, DataZero, OutTime

			INSERT INTO
				CubeAnalyze
			SELECT 
				T.DataZero, 
				T.AccountID, 
				T.CostAccountID, 						
				SUM (CASE WHEN PaperSizeId = 9 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS A4,
				SUM (CASE WHEN PaperSizeId <> 9 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS NA4,
				SUM (CASE WHEN OutTime = 0 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS InTime,
				SUM (CASE WHEN OutTime = 1 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS OutTime,
				SUM (CASE WHEN dbo.ReturnPrinterQueueTypeID(T.PrinterQueueID) = 1 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS Local,
				SUM (CASE WHEN dbo.ReturnPrinterQueueTypeID(T.PrinterQueueID) <> 1 THEN Pages ELSE 0 END) AS Net
			FROM
				@Temp  T
			GROUP BY
				T.DataZero, T.AccountID, T.CostAccountID

			DELETE FROM
				@Days
			WHERE
				DatePrinted = @DataAtual
		END

		PRINT 'Finalizado'
		
	COMMIT -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
GO
```

### proc_CubesCubes_RecalcAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CubesCubes_RecalcAll]
@DateStart AS DATETIME = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	IF (@DateStart IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @DateStart = DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE())
	END

	SET @DateStart = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@DateStart) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' +
						  CAST(MONTH(@DateStart) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' +
						  CAST(DAY(@DateStart) AS NVARCHAR) AS DATETIME)

	WHILE (@DateStart < GETDATE()) 
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM CubeCube WHERE [Date] = @DateStart

		PRINT CAST(@DateStart AS NVARCHAR)

		INSERT INTO
			CubeCube
		SELECT
			@DateStart AS [Date], 
			SUM(PagesMono) AS Pages, 
			0 AS Cor, 
			SUM(CostMono) AS Custo, 
			CAST(PrintWayID AS BIT),  
			PrintApplicationID, 
			PrintQualityID, 
			CAST(PaperSizeID AS SMALLINT), 
			ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1), 
			JobOriginID, 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			ISNULL(PrinterQueueID,-1), 
			AccountID, 
			SiteID, 
			CAST(JobTypeID AS SMALLINT)
		FROM
			PrintJobs AS PPJ
		WHERE
			PagesMono <> 0
			AND JobDisabled = 0
			AND DatePrinted >= @DateStart AND DatePrinted < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @DateStart)
		GROUP BY
			PrintWayID,
			PrintApplicationID,
			PrintQualityID,
			PaperSizeID,
			CostAccountID,
			JobOriginID,
			PrinterQueueID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			AccountID,
			SiteID,
			JobTypeID

		UNION ALL

		SELECT     
			@DateStart AS [Date], 
			SUM(PagesColor) AS Pages, 
			1 AS Cor, 
			SUM(CostColor) AS Custo, 
			CAST(PrintWayID AS BIT),  
			PrintApplicationID, 
			PrintQualityID, 
			CAST(PaperSizeID AS SMALLINT), 
			ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1), 
			JobOriginID, 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			ISNULL(PrinterQueueID,-1), 
			AccountID, 
			SiteID, 
			CAST(JobTypeID AS SMALLINT)
		FROM
			PrintJobs AS PPJ
		WHERE
			PagesColor <> 0
			AND JobDisabled = 0
			AND DatePrinted >= @DateStart AND DatePrinted < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @DateStart)
		GROUP BY
			PrintWayID,
			PrintApplicationID,
			PrintQualityID,
			PaperSizeID,
			CostAccountID,
			JobOriginID,
			PrinterQueueID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			AccountID, 
			SiteID,
			JobTypeID

		SET @DateStart = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @DateStart)

	END

END
GO
```

### proc_DataTableReport

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_DataTableReport]
@TABLE_NAME sysname = NULL,
@COLUMN_NAME  sysname = NULL,
@TABLE_SCHEMA sysname = NULL
AS

BEGIN

SET NOCOUNT ON

IF (@TABLE_SCHEMA IS NULL)
	SET @TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo'

DECLARE @curTableName sysname -- cursor variable

/* 
** CREATE two TABLE variables to store the result sets 
** Note: due to usage of the sql_variant data types, this will produce a 
** warning about row size upon compilations.  However, this can be ignored, AS 
** the condition will never occur.
*/

-- @defnBuildTbl stores all existing extended properties meeting the criteria
DECLARE @defnBuildTbl TABLE (
	tableName sysname COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	objtype sysname COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	objname sysname  COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	[name] sysname COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	value sql_variant  NULL)

-- @defnResultsTbl stores the END result SET
DECLARE @defResultsTbl TABLE (
	TABLE_NAME sysname COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	COLUMN_NAME sysname COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT NULL,
	ORDINAL_POSITION SMALLINT NULL,
	[Description] sql_variant NULL,
	DATA_TYPE nvarchar(256) COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT,
	CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH INT,
	NUMERIC_PRECISION SMALLINT,
	NUMERIC_SCALE INT,
	IS_NULLABLE NVARCHAR(3)COLLATE DATABASE_DEFAULT )

-- cursor through the system TABLE list of tables; IF a tableName argument IS
-- passed in, only use that, otherwise look up all tables
DECLARE cTables CURSOR FOR
SELECT TABLE_NAME
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES  
-- preferable to use these views rather than system tables
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=@TABLE_SCHEMA
	AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'
	AND TABLE_NAME=COALESCE(@TABLE_NAME, TABLE_NAME)

OPEN cTables

FETCH NEXT FROM cTables
INTO @curTableName

WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN

	-- store listing of extended properties for this TABLE, IF any

	INSERT @defnBuildTbl (tablename, objtype, objname, [name], value)
	-- capture TABLE comment, IF any
	SELECT @curTableName, *
	FROM ::fn_listextendedproperty (default, 'user', @TABLE_SCHEMA, 'TABLE', 
					@curTableName, default, default)
	WHERE name='MS_Description' -- exclude 'caption' types
	UNION
	-- capture comments for any columns in the TABLE
	SELECT @curTableName, *
	FROM ::fn_listextendedproperty (default, 'user', @TABLE_SCHEMA, 'TABLE', 
					@curTableName, 'column', default)
	WHERE name='MS_Description' -- exclude 'caption' types

	FETCH NEXT FROM cTables
	INTO @curTableName
END

CLOSE cTables
DEALLOCATE cTables

/*
** now compile the result SET.  We again SELECT FROM the system tables to get 
** the full list of tables AND columns, THEN do an outer join against our 
** previous result SET.  This IS because we may NOT have comments in every
** TABLE/column.
** BY doing this, we can generate a full template data dictionary that includes
** any comments we have entered, AND blanks for any incomplete documentation.
*/

INSERT @defResultsTbl (	TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, 
[Description], DATA_TYPE,
	CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, IS_NULLABLE )
SELECT t.TABLE_NAME,
	t.COLUMN_NAME,
	t.ORDINAL_POSITION,
	[Description]=isNull(dt.value, dc.value),
	t.DATA_TYPE,
	t.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
	t.NUMERIC_PRECISION,
	t.NUMERIC_SCALE,
	t.IS_NULLABLE
FROM (	-- generate a derived TABLE that contains all tables AND columns.
	-- one row for each TABLE-level entry...
	SELECT
	TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME=NULL, DATA_TYPE=NULL,
	CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH=NULL, NUMERIC_PRECISION=NULL, NUMERIC_SCALE=NULL,
	IS_NULLABLE=NULL, ORDINAL_POSITION=0
	FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
	WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=@TABLE_SCHEMA
		AND TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'
	UNION
	-- ... AND one row for each of the columns per TABLE
	SELECT c.TABLE_NAME, c.COLUMN_NAME, c.DATA_TYPE,
		c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, c.NUMERIC_PRECISION, c.NUMERIC_SCALE,
		c.IS_NULLABLE, c.ORDINAL_POSITION
	FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES AS t
	JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS AS c ON
		t.TABLE_CATALOG = c.TABLE_CATALOG
		AND t.TABLE_SCHEMA = c.TABLE_SCHEMA
		AND t.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME
	WHERE t.TABLE_SCHEMA=@TABLE_SCHEMA
		AND t.TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE'
		AND c.TABLE_SCHEMA=@TABLE_SCHEMA
		AND c.COLUMN_NAME=COALESCE(@COLUMN_NAME, COLUMN_NAME) ) AS t
LEFT OUTER JOIN @defnBuildTbl AS dt ON -- any TABLE-level comments, IF any
	dt.tableName = t.TABLE_NAME
	AND dt.objName = t.TABLE_NAME
	AND dt.objType = 'TABLE'
	AND t.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL
LEFT OUTER JOIN @defnBuildTbl AS dc ON -- any column-level comments, IF any
	dc.tableName = t.TABLE_NAME
	AND dc.ObjName = t.COLUMN_NAME
	AND dc.objType = 'COLUMN'
WHERE t.TABLE_NAME=COALESCE(@TABLE_NAME, TABLE_NAME)

-- finally, RETURN the result SET;  comment out any columns you don't need/want
IF (@COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL) -- column-level
	SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, [Description], DATA_TYPE,
		CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, IS_NULLABLE
	FROM @defResultsTbl
	WHERE COLUMN_NAME=@COLUMN_NAME

ELSE -- TABLE-level
	SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION, [Description], DATA_TYPE,
		CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, NUMERIC_PRECISION, NUMERIC_SCALE, IS_NULLABLE
	FROM @defResultsTbl
	ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

RETURN
END -- procedure
GO
```

### proc_Domains_HasUniqueAdmin

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Domains_HasUniqueAdmin]
@DomainID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT 
		CASE COUNT (1) 
			WHEN 0 THEN 'True'
			ELSE 'False'
		END AS HasUniqueAdmin
	FROM
		AccountsPermissions AP
		INNER JOIN Accounts A ON A.AccountID = AP.AccountID
	WHERE
		PermissionControlID = 1
		AND PermissionAccessID = 9
		AND A.Removed = 0
		AND AP.AccountID NOT IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

END
GO
```

### proc_Domains_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Domains_Remove]
@DomainID INT

AS

BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Revisado para deletar todas as dependências do domínio
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2020-09-15
	--
	-- Alteração para apagar as regras de consolidação do domínio
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2020-10-20
	--
	-- Alteração para atualizar QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches.AccountID para NULL
	-- Douglas Macedo, 2020-11-20
	--
	-- Alteração para atualizar QuotasOperators.AccountID para NULL e anonimizar OperatorName
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2020-12-04
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os agendamentos para os usuários desse domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	DELETE FROM
		ScheduledAccountSend
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		
	DELETE FROM
		ScheduledReports
	WHERE
		OwnerAccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as cotas para os usuários desse domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	DELETE FROM
		QuotasPercentageAlertsCredits
	WHERE 
		QuotaCreditID IN (SELECT QuotaCreditID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID))
		OR QuotaPercentageAlertID IN (SELECT QuotaPercentageAlertID FROM QuotasPercentageAlertsSent WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID))
		
	UPDATE
		QuotasOperators
	SET
		AccountID = NULL,
		OperatorName = '[UserRemoved]'
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		QuotasCredits
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		QuotasDebits
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		QuotasRules
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		QuotasPayments
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		
	DELETE FROM
		QuotasPercentageAlertsSent
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	UPDATE
		QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches
	SET
		AccountID = NULL
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		QuotasUnlimited
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os usuários e grupos de usuários deste domínio que são membros de políticas de impressão
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	INSERT INTO
		PoliciesMembersRemoved
	SELECT 
		PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
    WHERE 
		PolicyMemberType = 2 
	    AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
    WHERE 
		PolicyMemberType = 2 
	    AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	INSERT INTO
		PoliciesMembersRemoved
	SELECT 
		PolicyMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
    WHERE 
		PolicyMemberType in (1,5) 
		AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountID from Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	    
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE 
		PolicyMemberType in (1,5) 
		AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) IN (SELECT AccountID from Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)		

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os usuários e grupos de usuários deste domínio que são membros de fluxos de digitalização
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	INSERT INTO
		ScanFlowMembersRemoved
	SELECT 
		ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		ScanFlowMembers
    WHERE 
		MemberType = 2 
	    AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	
	DELETE FROM 
		ScanFlowMembers 
    WHERE 
		MemberType = 2 
	    AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM AccountsGroups WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	INSERT INTO
		ScanFlowMembersRemoved
	SELECT 
		ScanFlowMemberID, GETUTCDATE()
	FROM
		ScanFlowMembers
    WHERE 
		MemberType = 1
		AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID from Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	    
	DELETE FROM 
		ScanFlowMembers
	WHERE 
		MemberType = 1
		AND AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID from Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)	

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os grupos de usuários deste domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os usuários deste domínio das contas e seus históricos e das contas selecionáveis
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsManagersPermissions
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsManagers
	WHERE 
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		
	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsHistorics
	WHERE 
		ObjectID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	-- Atualiza todas as contas selecionáveis
	UPDATE
		CostAccountsSelectable
	SET
		UpdatedDate = GETUTCDATE()

	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsSelectableObjects
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Adiciona os usuários desse domínio para o cache de usuários
	--##########################################################################################################################################	
	UPDATE --Atualiza os registros anteriores para removed, pois somente precisa de um IsRemovedCache ou de alteracao (IsCredentialCache/IsRegularCache) ativo
		PoliciesControlsAccounts
	SET
		IsRemoved = 1
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		AND IsRemoved = 0
		AND (IsCredentialCache = 1 OR IsRegularCache = 1 OR IsRemovedCache = 1)
		
	--Insere o registro do usuário
	INSERT INTO
		PoliciesControlsAccounts (AccountID, IsRegularCache, IsCredentialCache, IsRemovedCache, IsRemoved)
	SELECT
		AccountID, 
		0,	--IsRegularCache
		0,	--IsCredentialCache
		1,	--IsRemovedCache
		0	--IsRemoved
	FROM
		Accounts
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as auditorias dos usuários
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		Audits
	WHERE
		UserID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as solicitações de senha dos usuários
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		AccountsPassportRequests
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as configurações da primeira página ao acessar
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		AccountsViewSettings
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as configurações dos grids dos usuários
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		GridColumns
	WHERE
		AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os usuários dos membros do EcoToner
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	 DELETE FROM
        ScanFlowMembers
     WHERE 
        AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove os usuários deste domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
		INSERT INTO 
			AccountsRemoved (AccountID, RemovedDate) 
		SELECT 
			A.AccountID, GETUTCDATE() 
		FROM Accounts A 
			INNER JOIN Domains D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID 
		WHERE 
			A.DomainID = @DomainID
		
		DELETE FROM
			Accounts
		WHERE 
			DomainID = @DomainID
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove todos os endereços do domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		DomainsAddresses
	WHERE 
		DomainID = @DomainID
		
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Busca as referências das configurações de acesso para apagar posteriormente
	--##########################################################################################################################################    
    DECLARE @DomainAccessAdvancedID INT = (
        SELECT DomainAccessSettingsAdvancedID
        FROM
            DomainAccessSettings
        WHERE 
			DomainAccessSettingsID = (
                SELECT DomainAccessSettingsID
                FROM [Domains]
                WHERE DomainID = @DomainID))

    DECLARE @DomainAccessID INT = (
		SELECT DomainAccessSettingsID
        FROM
            Domains
        WHERE 
		    DomainID = @DomainID)

	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove regras de consolidação do domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
    DELETE FROM
        DomainConsolidateRules
	WHERE 
		DomainID = @DomainID

	-- Reordena as prioridades das regras
    DECLARE @TempTable TABLE (
        ID INT,
        [Priority] INT)

    INSERT INTO 
        @TempTable
    SELECT
        DomainConsolidateRuleID,
        [Priority]
    FROM
        DomainConsolidateRules
    ORDER BY
        [Priority]

    DECLARE @Priority INT = 1

    WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TempTable)
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @ID INT = (SELECT TOP(1) ID FROM @TempTable)

        UPDATE 
            DomainConsolidateRules
        SET 
            [Priority] = @Priority
        WHERE
            DomainConsolidateRuleID = @ID

        SET @Priority = @Priority + 1

        DELETE FROM @TempTable WHERE ID = @ID
    END
    
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove o domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	DELETE FROM
		[Domains]
	WHERE
		DomainID = @DomainID

    --##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Remove as configurações de acesso do domínio
	--##########################################################################################################################################
    DELETE FROM
        DomainAccessSettings
	WHERE 
		DomainAccessSettingsID = @DomainAccessID

    DELETE FROM
		DomainAccessSettingsAdvanced
	WHERE 
		DomainAccessSettingsAdvancedID = @DomainAccessAdvancedID
		
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	-- Atualiza o DomainID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	--##########################################################################################################################################
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 2	--DomainID
	END

END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Domains_RetrieveAll]

	ORDER BY
		D.DomainTypeID,

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Accounts_RetrieveAll]

AS

BEGIN

	--*****************************************************************************************************************
	-- Retorna todos os usuários da empresa que possuem Email, Senha e não estejam removidos
	-- Estes usuários serão utilizados no cadastramento de responsáveis pelas impressoras do MPS (EnterprisesAccounts)

		AND AC.Removed = 0
	ORDER BY
		AC.FullName ASC
		
END
```

### proc_GPV_Counters_RetrieveSetFromInterval

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Counters_RetrieveSetFromInterval]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate DATETIME,
@FinishDate DATETIME,
@GetStarter BIT

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 16/11/2015
	-- Se @GetStarter = 1, busca o contador mais antigo da impressora específicada dentro do intervalo de tempo específicado (@StartDate, @FinishDate)
	-- Se @GetStarter = 0, busca o contador mais recente da impressora específicada dentro do intervalo de tempo específicado (@StartDate, @FinishDate)
	--*******************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @CounterReadingID INT = 0;

	IF(@GetStarter = 1)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			CR.CounterReadingID,
			CT.CounterTypeName,
			CR.DateTimeRead,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
 
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1
					CounterReadingID,
					MIN(DateTimeRead) DateTimeRead
				FROM 
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
					AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @FinishDate
					AND Removed = 0		
				GROUP BY
					CounterReadingID
				ORDER BY
					DateTimeRead ASC
			) Aux ON CR.CounterReadingID = Aux.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
	END
	ELSE IF(@GetStarter = 0)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			CR.CounterReadingID,
			CT.CounterTypeName,
			CR.DateTimeRead,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
 
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1
					CounterReadingID,
					MAX(DateTimeRead) DateTimeRead
				FROM 
					CountersReadings
				WHERE
					PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
					AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @FinishDate	
					AND Removed = 0	
				GROUP BY
					CounterReadingID
				ORDER BY
					DateTimeRead DESC
			) Aux ON CR.CounterReadingID = Aux.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID

	END
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersCubes_RecalcAll

### proc_GPV_CountersData_RetrievePlainCounters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersData_RetrievePlainCounters]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME, 
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0,
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30
AS

BEGIN

	--Pega os ultimos contadores dentro do periodo
	DECLARE @LastCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
	
	INSERT INTO @LastCounters 
		SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
		FROM CountersReadings CR
		RIGHT OUTER JOIN
			(
				SELECT 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
					MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
				FROM 
					CountersReadings CR
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE 
					DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
					DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime  AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND 					
					((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3))) 
				GROUP BY 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS TableAux
			ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 
		
		
		--Pega os primeiros contadores do periodo somente das impressoras que tem registros dentro do limite maximo anterior
		DECLARE @FirstCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
				
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @StartDateTime and 
						DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,(@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1),@StartDateTime) AND
						PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						CR.Removed = 0
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 

		--Agora pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
		DECLARE @IntervalCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRIDLC INT, DTR DATETIME)
		INSERT INTO @IntervalCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MIN(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND 
						DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PDID FROM @FirstCounters)  
					GROUP BY 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 

		--Junto as duas tabelas de valores iniciais
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT * from @IntervalCounters 
			
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @IntervalCounters 		

		DECLARE @FirstCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT,DTR DATETIME, CTID INT, MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @FirstCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			FC.PDID,
			FC.CRID,  
			FC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @FirstCounters FC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = FC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @FirstCounters
		
		DECLARE @LastCountersReadings TABLE (PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME,CTID INT ,MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @LastCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			LC.PDID,
			LC.CRID,  
			LC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @LastCounters LC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = LC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @LastCounters
		
		SELECT 
            PD.PrinterDeviceID,
            REPLACE(dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID),';',',') AS PrinterDeviceName,
            ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
            dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS AddressName, 
            PMF.BrandName,
            PM.PrinterModelName,
            CASE
                  WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN (0, 2) THEN 0
                  ELSE 1
            END AS Engaged,
            ISNULL(PD.Location, '-') AS Location,
            S.SiteName,
            ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
            ISNULL((SELECT CounterTypeName FROM CounterTypes WHERE CounterTypeID = FCR.CTID),(SELECT CounterTypeName FROM CounterTypes WHERE CounterTypeID = LCR.CTID)) AS CounterTypeName,
            --Leituras
            FCR.DTR AS FirstDateTimeRead,
            LCR.DTR AS LastDateTimeRead,
            
            FCR.TOTAL AS  FirstCounterTotal,
			LCR.TOTAL AS LatestCounterTotal,
			FCR.MONO AS FirstCounterMono,
			LCR.MONO AS LatestCounterMono,
			FCR.COLOR AS FirstCounterColor,	
			LCR.COLOR AS LatestCounterColor           
			
		FROM 
			@LastCountersReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCountersReadings FCR on LCR.PDID = FCR.PDID AND LCR.CTID = FCR.CTID 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = LCR.PDID
			INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
			LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID 
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
            INNER JOIN Brands PMF ON PMF.BrandID = PM.BrandID
		ORDER BY 
			[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) ASC 

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersData_RetrieveReferences

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersData_RetrieveReferences]
@DateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@SiteID INT = NULL,
@SiteDivisionID INT = NULL,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************
	--** Rafael Machado 08/02/2017
	--** Utilizada diretamento pelo web service CountersData, retorna os contadores de referência
	--*******************************************************************************

	--Descobrir quais impressoras devo retornar
	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (
		PrinterDeviceID INT NOT NULL,
		CounterReadingID INT 
	)
	
	--Pego as impressoras que devo retornar
	INSERT INTO @Printers (PrinterDeviceID)
		SELECT 
			PD.PrinterDeviceID 
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices PD
		WHERE
			((@PrinterDeviceID) IS NULL OR (PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID))
			AND ((@SiteID IS NULL) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID))
			AND ((@SiteDivisionID IS NULL) OR (PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID))
			AND ((@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters = 0) OR (PD.EngagedStatus in (1,3)))

	--Busco as ultimas leituras das impressoras
	UPDATE @Printers 
		SET CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
	FROM
		@Printers  P
		INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON P.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
		RIGHT JOIN
		(
			SELECT 
				_CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
				MAX(_CR.DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
			FROM 
				CountersReadings _CR
				LEFT JOIN @Printers _PD ON _PD.PrinterDeviceID = _CR.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE 
				_CR.DateTimeRead <= @DateTime
				AND _CR.Removed = 0 
			GROUP BY 
				_CR.PrinterDeviceID
		) AS TableAux ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID  AND CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead

	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		REPLACE(dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID),';',',') AS PrinterDeviceName,
		ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS AddressName, 
		PMF.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		CASE
			WHEN PD.EngagedStatus IN (0, 2) THEN 0
			ELSE 1
		END AS Engaged,
		ISNULL(PD.Location, '-') AS Location,
		S.SiteName,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,	
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		CR.CounterReadingID,
		CR.ReferenceMono,
		CR.ReferenceColor,
		CR.IsUpdated        			
	FROM 
		@Printers P
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN  CountersReadings CR ON P.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
		LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID 
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands PMF ON PMF.BrandID = PM.BrandID
	ORDER BY 
		[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName2](PD.PrinterDeviceID) ASC 

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_CalculateDefaultReferenceCounters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_CalculateDefaultReferenceCounters] 
@CounterReadingID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************
	--** Rafael Machado 02/02/2017
	--** Recebe um CounterReadingID e calcula os contadores de referências Mono e Color utilizando
	--** a regra padrão.
	--** Diego 08/03/2017
	--** Caso o comando SUM estourar a variavel INT irá retornar o maior inteiro válido: 2147483647
	--** Rafael Machado 17/10/2017
	--** Adicionado '@' no uso da variável REFERENCE_COLOR
	--*******************************************************************************

	DECLARE @REFERENCE_COLOR AS INT
	SET @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0
	DECLARE @REFERENCE_MONO AS INT	
	SET @REFERENCE_MONO = 0
	
	SELECT 
	  @REFERENCE_COLOR = C.CounterColor
	FROM 
		CountersReadings CR
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes AS CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID 
	WHERE 
		CR.CounterReadingID = @CounterReadingID
		AND CT.CounterTypeName = 'Total'
		
				
	IF((@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL) OR (@REFERENCE_COLOR = 0))
	BEGIN 			
	
		DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
		SELECT 
			@REFERENCE_COLOR =
				CASE
					WHEN SUM(CAST(C.CounterColor AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
					ELSE SUM(CAST(C.CounterColor AS BIGINT))
				END
		FROM
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes AS CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
		WHERE 
			CR.CounterReadingID = @CounterReadingID
			AND CT.CounterGroupID = 2 							
	END		
		
	IF((@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL) OR @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0)
	BEGIN	
			
		SELECT 
			@REFERENCE_COLOR = C.CounterColor
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
		WHERE 
			CR.CounterReadingID = @CounterReadingID
			AND C.CounterTypeID = 1
	END		
	
	IF (@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL OR @REFERENCE_COLOR < 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0
	END
	
	SELECT 
		@REFERENCE_MONO = (C.CounterTotal - @REFERENCE_COLOR)
	FROM 
		CountersReadings CR
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON CR.CounterReadingID = C.CounterReadingID
	WHERE 
		CR.CounterReadingID = @CounterReadingID
 		AND C.CounterTypeID = 1 
	
	IF(@REFERENCE_MONO < 0 )
		SET @REFERENCE_MONO = 0	
	
	SELECT 
		@REFERENCE_MONO AS ReferenceMono, 
		@REFERENCE_COLOR AS ReferenceColor

END
 
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_CalculateDefaultReferenceCountersUsingPlainCounters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_CalculateDefaultReferenceCountersUsingPlainCounters]
@PlainCounters PlainCounters READONLY

AS
BEGIN

	--*******************************************************************************
	--** Rafael/Diego 06/02/2017
	--** Recebe a lista de contadores e monta os contadores de referencia
	--** Diego 08/03/2017
	--** Caso o comando SUM estourar a variavel INT irá retornar o maior inteiro válido: 2147483647
	--*******************************************************************************

	DECLARE @REFERENCE_COLOR AS INT
	SET @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0
	DECLARE @REFERENCE_MONO AS INT	
	SET @REFERENCE_MONO = 0
	
	SELECT 
	  @REFERENCE_COLOR = PC.CounterColor
	FROM 
		@PlainCounters AS PC 
		INNER JOIN CounterTypes AS CT ON PC.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID 
	WHERE 
		CT.CounterTypeName = 'Total'
				
	IF((@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL) OR (@REFERENCE_COLOR = 0))
	BEGIN 			
		
		DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
		SELECT 
			@REFERENCE_COLOR =
				CASE
					WHEN SUM(CAST(PC.CounterColor AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
					ELSE SUM(CAST(PC.CounterColor AS BIGINT))
				END
		FROM
			@PlainCounters AS PC 
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes AS CT ON PC.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
		WHERE 
			CT.CounterGroupID = 2 							
	END		
		
	IF((@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL) OR @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0)
	BEGIN	
			
		SELECT 
			@REFERENCE_COLOR = PC.CounterColor
		FROM 
			@PlainCounters AS PC 
		WHERE 
			CounterTypeID = 1
	END		
	
	IF (@REFERENCE_COLOR IS NULL OR @REFERENCE_COLOR < 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @REFERENCE_COLOR = 0
	END
	
	SELECT 
		@REFERENCE_MONO = (PC.CounterTotal - @REFERENCE_COLOR)
	FROM 
		@PlainCounters AS PC 
		--INNER JOIN CounterTypes AS CT ON PC.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
	WHERE 
		CounterTypeID = 1 
	
	IF(@REFERENCE_MONO < 0 )
		SET @REFERENCE_MONO = 0	
	
	SELECT @REFERENCE_MONO AS ReferenceMono, @REFERENCE_COLOR AS ReferenceColor

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_Insert

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_Insert]
@FileInputID INT = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME,
@CounterInputTypeID INT,
@ReferenceMono INT,
@ReferenceColor INT,
--Os tipos User-Defnied Table Types tem uma peculiaridade, quando esse parâmetor for passado, é necessário verificar se a ordem das colunas
--criadas no datatable que está sendo passado coresponde com a ordem das colunas estabelecidas no tipo dbo.PlainCounters.
--É necessário tomar esse cuidado por que o nome das colunas não é levado em consideração, apenas a ordem e a quantidade.
@CountersList AS dbo.PlainCounters READONLY ,
@IgnoreCountersValidation BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN
	
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 18/08/2015
	-- Encapsula o chamado a procedure que é executada pelo NSLImporter para faze a inserção de contadores.
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @CounterReadingID INT
	SET @CounterReadingID = 0;
	
	EXEC @CounterReadingID = [proc_IVT_Printers_Devices_Counters_Insert] 
								@FileInputID, 
								@PrinterDeviceID, 
								@DateTimeRead,
								@CounterInputTypeID,
								@ReferenceMono,
								@ReferenceColor,
								@CountersList,
								@IgnoreCountersValidation
	
	SELECT @CounterReadingID AS CounterReadingID

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveAllFromPrinters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveAllFromPrinters]
@PrinterDevicesIDs AS IntTable READONLY,
@StartDate DATETIME,
@LastDate DATETIME

AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************************************************
	-- Diego Antunes, 12/03/2018
	-- Retorna o primeiro e o último CounterReading do periodo por impressora, com um limite de busca de 7 dias para trás.
	--*********************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @LatestCounterReadings TABLE
	(
		ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
		PrinterDeviceID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
		CacheDate DATE,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		[Counter] INT
	)

	--Busca o último CounterReading dentro do periodo por impressora.
	INSERT INTO @LatestCounterReadings 	
		SELECT
			R.PrinterDeviceID,
			'' AS BrandName,
			'' AS PrinterModelName,
			CAST(DateTimeRead AS DATE),
			R.CounterReadingID,
			R.DateTimeRead,
			0
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,
					CR.DateTimeRead,
					CR.CounterReadingID,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CR.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY CR.DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					@PrinterDevicesIDs PDs
					INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON PDs.INTID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @LastDate AND
					CR.Removed = 0
			) R
		WHERE
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			R.PrinterDeviceID, R.DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @FirstCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
		PrinterDeviceID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
		CacheDate DATE,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		[Counter] INT
	)

	--Busca o primeiro CounterReading anterior ao periodo por impressora, com um limite de 7 dias para trás.
	--Somente de impressoras que tem o último CounterReading dentro do periodo.
	INSERT INTO @FirstCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			R.PrinterDeviceID,
			'' AS BrandName,
			'' AS PrinterModelName,
			CAST(DateTimeRead AS DATE),
			R.CounterReadingID,
			R.DateTimeRead,
			0
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,
					CR.DateTimeRead,
					CR.CounterReadingID,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CR.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY CR.DateTimeRead DESC) Num
				FROM
					@LatestCounterReadings PDs
					INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON PDs.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE				
					CR.DateTimeRead < @StartDate AND
					CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DAY,-7,@StartDate) AND
					CR.Removed = 0
			) R
		WHERE
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			R.PrinterDeviceID, R.DateTimeRead DESC

	DECLARE @IntervalCounterReadings TABLE
	(		
		ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
		PrinterDeviceID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
		CacheDate DATE,
		CounterReadingID INT,
		DateTimeRead DATETIME,
		[Counter] INT
	)

	--Busca o primeiro CounterReading dentro do periodo por impressora.
	--Somente de impressoras que tem o último CounterReading dentro do periodo mas não tem o inicial anterior ao periodo.
	INSERT INTO @IntervalCounterReadings 	
		SELECT 
			R.PrinterDeviceID,
			'' AS BrandName,
			'' AS PrinterModelName,
			CAST(DateTimeRead AS DATE),
			R.CounterReadingID,
			R.DateTimeRead,
			0
		FROM 
			(  
				SELECT
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,
					CR.DateTimeRead,
					CR.CounterReadingID,
					ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CR.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY CR.DateTimeRead ASC) Num
				FROM
					@LatestCounterReadings PDs
					INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON PDs.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE				
					CR.DateTimeRead BETWEEN @StartDate AND @LastDate AND
					CR.Removed = 0
					
			) R
		WHERE 
			Num = 1
		ORDER BY
			R.PrinterDeviceID, R.DateTimeRead DESC

	-- Retorna os CounterReadings do periodo, com os dados necessários por impressora.
	SELECT
		LCR.PrinterDeviceID,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		
		ISNULL(FCR.CounterReadingID,ISNULL(ICR.CounterReadingID,LCR.CounterReadingID)) AS StartCounterReadingID,
		ISNULL(FCR.DateTimeRead,ISNULL(ICR.DateTimeRead,LCR.DateTimeRead)) AS StartDateTimeRead,
		ISNULL(FCR.[Counter],ISNULL(ICR.[Counter],LCR.[Counter])) AS StartCounter,

		LCR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
		LCR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
		LCR.[Counter] AS EndCounter
	FROM
		@LatestCounterReadings LCR
		LEFT JOIN @FirstCounterReadings FCR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT JOIN @IntervalCounterReadings ICR ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = ICR.PrinterDeviceID

		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON LCR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveLatestFromPrinter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveLatestFromPrinter]
@PrinterDeviceID INT 
AS
BEGIN

       --***********************************************************************************************************
       -- Robson, 01/02/2017
       -- Traz os dados dos contadores de referência mais recentes da impressora
	   -- Ja traz também os dados auxiliares para que os contadores sejam atualizados caso estejam desatualizados
       --***********************************************************************************************************
             
       DECLARE @CounterReadingID INT
       
       SET  @CounterReadingID = ( 
                    SELECT TOP 
                           1 CounterReadingID 
                    FROM 
                           CountersReadings 
                    WHERE 
                           PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID AND
                           Removed = 0
                    ORDER BY DatetimeRead DESC
                    )
       
       SELECT  
             CR.PrinterDeviceID,
			 BrandName,
			 PrinterModelName,
			 CounterReadingID,
			 DateTimeRead,
			 ReferenceMono, 
			 ReferenceColor,
			 IsUpdated
		FROM 
			CountersReadings CR
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
       WHERE 
             CR.CounterReadingID = @CounterReadingID
             
       
END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferencesFromCompany

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_RetrieveReferencesFromCompany] 
@StartDate DATETIME , --com 00:00:00
@EndDate DATETIME, --com 23:59:59
@SiteID INT = NULL,
@GroupBySiteID BIT = 0

AS
BEGIN

    --***********************************************************************************************************
    -- Robson, 06/02/2017
    -- Traz os contadores iniciais e finais de referencia em um período, separados por dia
    -- Rafael Machado, 10/02/2017
    -- Alterando @CounterReadings para #CounterReadings utilizando uma tabela temporário, porque ela é a estrutura indicada 
    -- e otimizada para se trabalhar com um volume grande de dados.
    -- Sabemos que ela explicitamente usa o tempdb, e ainda precisamos avaliar os impactos para ter uma maior segurança no uso.
    --** Diego 08/03/2017
    --** Caso o comando SUM estourar a variavel INT irá retornar o maior inteiro válido: 2147483647
    --** Rafael 22/01/2018 -Task: #9910 
    --** Definido o nível de isolamento READ UNCOMMITTED
	--** Criado parâmetro GroupBySiteID, inves de tazer o resultado agrupado apenas  por dia, com ele true o resultado retornado é agrupado por data  e sites
    --** A busca das impressoras que serão pesquisadas foi colocada inline no select dos CountersReadings
    --** Um while que chamava a função getFirstCounterReadingFromPrinter foi reescrito para usar o CROSS APPLY do SQL
    --** e o conteúdo da função foi extráido e colocado inline no CROSS APPLY
	--** O trecho onde era preenchido com valores zerados os dias que não possuiam dados foi removido e agora essa lógica é feita na aplicação.
    --***********************************************************************************************************

    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

    SET NOCOUNT ON;
		
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CounterReadings') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN 
	   PRINT 'A tabela #CounterReadings existe no inicio na chamada, vamos dropar ela.'
	   DROP TABLE #CounterReadings
    END

    CREATE TABLE #CounterReadings (
	   ID INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1), 
	   PrinterDeviceID INT,
	   BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
	   PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
	   CacheDate DATE, 
	   DateTimeRead DATETIME,
	   CounterReadingID INT,
	   ReferenceMono INT,
	   ReferenceColor INT,
	   IsUpdated BIT,
	   SiteID INT
    )
    
    INSERT INTO #CounterReadings 	
	   SELECT 
		  Resumed.PrinterDeviceID,
		  BrandName,
		  PrinterModelName,   
		  DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateTimeRead))),
		  DateTimeRead,
		  CounterReadingID,
		  ReferenceMono,
		  ReferenceColor,
		  IsUpdated,
		  PD.SiteID
	   FROM 
		  (  
			 SELECT 
				*, 
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CAST(DateTimeRead AS DATE), PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) Num
			 FROM
				CountersReadings 					
			 WHERE				
				PrinterDeviceID IN 
			 (
				SELECT   
				    PD.PrinterDeviceID
				FROM  
				    PrintersDevices PD  
				WHERE  
				    PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3)
				    AND (PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)) 
				    AND ((@SiteID IS NULL) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID))
			 ) 
			 AND Removed = 0 
			 AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN DATEADD(D, -1, @StartDate) AND @EndDate --pega o contador do dia anterior para pegar o ultimo do primeiro dia
		  ) Resumed
		  INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON Resumed.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		  INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		  INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	   WHERE 
		  Num = 1
	   ORDER BY 
		  PD.PrinterDeviceID, 
		  DateTimeRead DESC

    DECLARE @FullCounterReadings TABLE (
	   SiteID INT,
	   PrinterDeviceID INT, 
	   BrandName NVARCHAR(255),
	   PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(255),
	   CacheDate DATE, 		
	   --StartDateTimeRead DATETIME,
	   StartCounterReadingID INT,
	   StartReferenceMono INT,
	   StartReferenceColor INT,
	   StartIsUpdated BIT,
	   --EndDateTimeRead DATETIME,
	   EndCounterReadingID INT,
	   EndReferenceMono INT,
	   EndReferenceColor INT,
	   EndIsUpdated BIT
    )

    --se tem contadores desatualizados, passa tudo para ser atualizado no componente
    INSERT INTO @FullCounterReadings
	   SELECT
		  ECR.SiteID,
		  ECR.PrinterDeviceID,
		  ECR.BrandName,
		  ECR.PrinterModelName,
		  ECR.CacheDate, 
		
		  --ISNULL(SCR.DateTimeRead,ECR.DateTimeRead) AS StartDateTimeRead,
		  ISNULL(SCR.CounterReadingID,ECR.CounterReadingID) AS StartCounterReadingID,
		  ISNULL(SCR.ReferenceMono,ECR.ReferenceMono) AS StartReferenceMono,
		  ISNULL(SCR.ReferenceColor,ECR.ReferenceColor) StartReferenceColor,
		  ISNULL(SCR.IsUpdated,ECR.IsUpdated) AS StartIsUpdated,

		  --ECR.DateTimeRead AS EndDateTimeRead,
		  ECR.CounterReadingID AS EndCounterReadingID,
		  ECR.ReferenceMono AS EndReferenceMono,
		  ECR.ReferenceColor EndReferenceColor,
		  ECR.IsUpdated AS EndIsUpdated		
	   FROM 
		  #CounterReadings ECR
		  LEFT JOIN #CounterReadings SCR ON ECR.ID = SCR.ID - 1 AND ECR.PrinterDeviceID = SCR.PrinterDeviceID
	   WHERE 
		  ECR.CacheDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate

    --ATUALIZAR COM O PRIMEIRO CONTADOR DO DIA SE O PRIMEIRO CONTADOR DO DIA ESTA IGUAL O ÚLTIMO DO DIA
    --ISSO SÓ PODE ACONTECER PARA O PRIMEIRO REGISTRO DE CADA IMPRESSORA (O INICIAL)
    --PODE SER QUE ACABE ENCONTRANDO O MESMO CONTADOR QUE JA ESTA (O ULTIMO DO DIA)
    UPDATE 
	   @FullCounterReadings
    SET
	   StartCounterReadingID = _.CounterReadingID,
	   StartReferenceMono = _.ReferenceMono,
	   StartReferenceColor = _.ReferenceColor,
	   StartIsUpdated = _.IsUpdated
    FROM 
	   @FullCounterReadings FCR
	   CROSS APPLY (
		  SELECT TOP 1
			 _CR.CounterReadingID, 
			 _CR.ReferenceMono, 
			 _CR.ReferenceColor, 
			 _CR.IsUpdated
		  FROM 
			 CountersReadings _CR
		  WHERE
			 PrinterDeviceID = FCR.PrinterDeviceID 
			 AND Removed = 0 
			 --POSSO PEGAR O CONTADOR O DIA SEGUINTE (DIA + 1 ) PQ EU SEI QUE TEM UMA LEITURA ANTES DESSE HORARIO
			 AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN FCR.CacheDate AND DATEADD(D, 1, FCR.CacheDate) 
		  ORDER BY
			 _CR.DateTimeRead ASC
	   ) _
    WHERE    
	   StartCounterReadingID = EndCounterReadingID 

    IF ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @FullCounterReadings WHERE (StartIsUpdated = 0 OR EndIsUpdated = 0) AND CacheDate BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate) > 0 )
    BEGIN
	
	   SELECT 	   
		  SiteID,
		  PrinterDeviceID, 
		  BrandName,
		  PrinterModelName,
		  CacheDate, 		
		  StartCounterReadingID,
		  StartReferenceMono,
		  StartReferenceColor,
		  StartIsUpdated,
		  EndCounterReadingID,
		  EndReferenceMono,
		  EndReferenceColor,
		  EndIsUpdated 
	   FROM 
		  @FullCounterReadings
	
    END
    ELSE
	   BEGIN

		  --ta tudo atualizado, manda os valores prontos
		  --Tabela que contém os dados de bilhetagem	
		  DECLARE @TBPrintCacheCounters  TABLE
		  (	
			 CacheDate DATE,
			 SiteID INT,	
			 PrinterDeviceID INT,
			 PagesMono INT,
			 PagesColor INT
		  )
		
		  INSERT INTO @TBPrintCacheCounters
			 SELECT			
				CacheDate,
				SiteID,
				PrinterDeviceID,
				CASE WHEN (EndReferenceMono - StartReferenceMono) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE EndReferenceMono - StartReferenceMono END AS PagesMono,
				CASE WHEN (EndReferenceColor - StartReferenceColor) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE EndReferenceColor - StartReferenceColor END AS PagesColor
			 FROM 
				@FullCounterReadings
			 GROUP BY 
				CacheDate,
				SiteID,
				PrinterDeviceID,
				EndReferenceMono,
				StartReferenceMono,
				EndReferenceColor,
				StartReferenceColor

		  

		  DECLARE @MaxIntValue INT = [dbo].[GetMaxIntValue]()
		
		  IF(@GroupBySiteID = 0)
		  BEGIN

			 SELECT
				CacheDate,
				CASE
				    WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				    ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT))
				END AS TotalPagesMono,
				CASE
				    WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				    ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT))
				END AS TotalPagesColor
			 FROM
				@TBPrintCacheCounters
			 GROUP BY
				CacheDate
			 ORDER BY
				CacheDate

		  END
		  ELSE
		  BEGIN

			 SELECT
				CacheDate,
				SiteID,
				CASE
				    WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				    ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesMono AS BIGINT))
				END AS TotalPagesMono,
				CASE
				    WHEN SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT)) > @MaxIntValue THEN @MaxIntValue
				    ELSE SUM(CAST(PagesColor AS BIGINT))
				END AS TotalPagesColor
			 FROM
				@TBPrintCacheCounters
			 GROUP BY
				CacheDate, 
				SiteID
			 ORDER BY
				CacheDate

		  END

	   END 

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#CounterReadings') IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN 
	   PRINT 'Limpando recursos, dropando tabela #CounterReadings'
	   DROP TABLE #CounterReadings
    END
					
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CountersReadings_SetIsUpdated

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CountersReadings_SetIsUpdated]
@IsUpdated BIT,
@ChangedGeneralRule BIT,
@UnchangedBrandList AS BrandsUDT READONLY,
@ChangedBrandList AS BrandsUDT READONLY,
@UnchangedPrinterModelsList AS PrintersModelsUDT READONLY,
@ChangedPrinterModelsList AS PrintersModelsUDT READONLY

AS

BEGIN
	
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 31/01/2017.
	-- Define o valor da coluna IsUpdated.
	-- @BrandsList deve conter os fabricantes que não devem ser atualizados, ou seja, os fabricantes que possuem refras que não foram alteradas.
	-- @UnchangedPrinterModelsList deve conter os fabricantes que não devem ser atualizados, ou seja, os fabricantes que possuem refras que não foram alteradas.
	-- @UnchangedPrinterModelsList deve conter o BrandName para que filtrar nos casos onde um mesmo nome de modelo é comum para mais de um fabricante.
	-- @ChangedPrinterModelsList é necessário no cenário onde, por exemplo: 
	--	* tenho uma regra o fabricante Lexmark e tenho uma regra para o modelo xyz da Lexmark
	--	* utilizo a interface para excluir/modificar a regra do modelo xyz da Lexmark, nesse momento a regra é marcada como modificada,
	--  * porém a regra a nível de fabricante não sofre alteração (unchanged) e o fabricante é inserido na @UnchangedPrinterModelsList.
	--  * o modelo xyz que deveria ser atualizado neste cenário ele não é, estão é necessário criar essa lista (@ChangedPrinterModelsList) com as exceções.
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	
	--Espero uma lista de fabricantes, e aqui no NPDB descubro o ID delas e então uso na hora de determinar quem deve ser atualizado.
	DECLARE @UnchangedBrands_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		BrandID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	DECLARE @ChangedBrands_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		BrandID INT,
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)
	
	--Espero uma lista de modelos de impressora que não sofreram alteração, e aqui no NPDB descubro o ID delas e então uso na hora de determinar quem deve ser atualizado.
	DECLARE @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		PrinterModelID INT,
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(100),
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)	

	--Espero uma lista de molodes de impressora que sofreream alteração;
	DECLARE @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP AS TABLE 
	(
		PrinterModelID INT,
		PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(100),
		BrandName NVARCHAR(100)
	)

	--Busco o BrandID das @UnchangedBrandList
	INSERT INTO @ChangedBrands_TMP (BrandName)
		SELECT 
			BrandName 
		FROM 
			@ChangedBrandList

	UPDATE @ChangedBrands_TMP 
	SET BrandID = B.BrandID 
	FROM Brands B
		INNER JOIN @ChangedBrandList BL ON B.BrandName = BL.BrandName
		
	--Busco o BrandID das @UnchangedBrandList
	INSERT INTO @UnchangedBrands_TMP (BrandName)
		SELECT 
			BrandName 
		FROM 
			@UnchangedBrandList

	UPDATE @UnchangedBrands_TMP 
	SET BrandID = B.BrandID 
	FROM Brands B
		INNER JOIN @UnchangedBrandList BL ON B.BrandName = BL.BrandName

	--Busco o PrinterModelID das @UnchangedPrinterModelsList
	INSERT INTO @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP (PrinterModelName, BrandName)
		SELECT 
			PML.PrinterModelName, PML.BrandName
		FROM 
			@UnchangedPrinterModelsList PML

	UPDATE @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP 
	SET PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	FROM PrintersModels PM
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		INNER JOIN @UnchangedPrinterModelsList PML ON PM.PrinterModelName = PML.PrinterModelName AND B.BrandName = PML.BrandName
		
	--Busco o PrinterModelID das @ChangedPrinterModelsList
	INSERT INTO @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP (PrinterModelName, BrandName)
		SELECT 
			PML.PrinterModelName, PML.BrandName
		FROM 
			@ChangedPrinterModelsList PML

	UPDATE @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP 
	SET PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	FROM PrintersModels PM
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		INNER JOIN @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP PML ON PM.PrinterModelName = PML.PrinterModelName AND B.BrandName = PML.BrandName
		
	IF (@ChangedGeneralRule = 1)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE 
			CountersReadings
		SET 
			IsUpdated = @IsUpdated
		FROM
			CountersReadings CR 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		WHERE
			CR.IsUpdated <> @IsUpdated AND 
			(NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedBrands_TMP _B WHERE _B.BrandID = PM.BrandID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP _UPM WHERE _UPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))
	END

	UPDATE 
		CountersReadings
	SET 
		IsUpdated = @IsUpdated
	FROM
		CountersReadings CR 
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	WHERE
		CR.IsUpdated <> @IsUpdated AND
		((EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @ChangedBrands_TMP _CB WHERE _CB.BrandID = PM.BrandID) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @UnchangedPrinterModels_TMP _UPM WHERE _UPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))
			OR EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM @ChangedPrinterModel_TMP _CPM WHERE _CPM.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID))

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_CounterTypes_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_CounterTypes_RetrieveAll]
@PrinterModelID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN
	
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 19/08/2015
	-- Retonar os tipos de contadores.
	-- Rafael Machado, 17/09/2015
	-- Ajustando procedure para permitir o filtro pela modelo de impressora.
	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	IF(@PrinterModelID IS NULL)
	BEGIN 

		SELECT 
			CounterTypeID,
			CounterTypeName,
			[Description]
		FROM 
			CounterTypes

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT DISTINCT
			CT.CounterTypeID,
			CT.CounterTypeName,
			CT.[Description]
		FROM
			Counters C
			INNER JOIN CountersReadings CR ON C.CounterReadingID = CR.CounterReadingID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON C.CounterTypeID = CT.CounterTypeID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			PD.PrinterModelID = @PrinterModelID
			--Pega os contadores dos últimos 30 dias.
			AND CR.DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(D, -30, GETDATE()) 
	END	
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_NSLReadings_Remove]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateTimeRead DATETIME

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***************************************************************************
	-- Remove uma leitura MANUAL de um contador nsl de uma impressora
	-- Diego, 16/08/2013
	--
	-- Deleta sempre: Robsonm 06/03/2017
	--
	-- Diego, 24/03/2017
	-- Se for leitura manual deleta
	-- Se for leitura de nsl atualiza os contadores para zero
	-- Diego, 28/04/2017
	-- Alterado para remover o SuppliesReferenceCounters do NSLReading que foi zerado
	--***************************************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	DECLARE @NSLReadingID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @FileInputID INT = NULL

	SELECT @NSLReadingID = NSLReadingID, @FileInputID = FileInputID FROM NSLReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND DateTimeRead = @DateTimeRead

	IF(@NSLReadingID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		IF(@FileInputID = 0)
		BEGIN

			--Manual deleta
			DELETE FROM
				NSLReadings
			WHERE
				FileInputID = 0 AND
				PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				@DateTimeRead = DateTimeRead

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN

			--NSL atualiza
			UPDATE
				NSLReadings
			SET
				CounterColor = 0,
				CounterTotal = 0
			FROM
				NSLReadings
			WHERE
				NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID

			DELETE FROM
				SuppliesReferenceCounters
			WHERE
				NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID

		END

	END

	SELECT 1

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromRange

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromRange]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@DateStart DATETIME,
@LatestDate DATETIME

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************
	--Retorna os contadores da impressora com leitura após a data passada por parâmetro.
	--************************************************************************************

	SELECT
		DateTimeRead,
		CounterColor,
		CounterTotal
	FROM
		NSLReadings
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND DateTimeRead BETWEEN @DateStart AND @LatestDate
	ORDER BY
		DateTimeRead

END
GO
```
