```sql
AS
BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 08-09-2015
	-- Stored Procedure usada para buscar os dados das leituras de referência
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	SELECT 
		@PrinterDeviceID PrinterDeviceID,
		CR.CounterReadingID,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		CR.DateTimeRead,
		CR.ReferenceMono, 
		CR.ReferenceColor,
		CR.IsUpdated
	FROM 
		CountersReadings CR
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CR.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PD.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE 
		CR.DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime AND
		CR.DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
		CR.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		CR.Removed = 0
	ORDER BY DateTimeRead ASC

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_PrintJobs_RetrieveFromPrinter]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Maicon Pereira 08-09-2015
	--
	-- Stored Procedure usada para listar os jobs de impressão que foram impressos no período.
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	
	SELECT
		P.PrintJobID,
		P.Title,
		P.DatePrinted,
		P.PagesMono,
		P.PagesColor,
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PS.PaperSizeName
	FROM 
		PrintJobs P
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA on P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID 
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS on P.PaperSizeID = PS.PaperSizeID
	WHERE 
		(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)AND
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND
		P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3) AND
		P.JobDisabled = 0
	ORDER BY 
		P.DatePrinted ASC

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingCosts

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingCosts]
AS
BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 18/06/2013
	--** Traz os custos (agora grupos) das impressoras para o relatório de fechamento
	--**********************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @C TINYINT
	SELECT @C = COUNT(*) FROM CostGroups
	
	IF (@C <= 20) --20 é o limite do excel
	BEGIN
		
		SELECT 
			pc.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName, 
			pc.CostMono AS MonoCost,
			pc.CostColor AS ColorCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexMono AS DuplexMonoCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexColor AS DuplexColorCost,
			pc.CostMono AS CopiesMonoCost, 
			pc.CostColor AS CopiesColorCost, 
			ISNULL(pcps.CostMono, pc.CostMono) AS A3MonoCost,
			ISNULL(pcps.CostColor, pc.CostColor) AS A3ColorCost,
			pc.CostScan AS ScanCost,
			pc.CostSentFax AS FaxCost
		FROM
			CostGroups pc  
			LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize pcps ON pcps.CostGroupID = pc.CostGroupID AND pcps.PaperSizeID = 8
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		--Se tem mais que 20 custos pega só os 20 primeiros que estiverem em uso
		SELECT 
			pc.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName, 
			pc.CostMono AS MonoCost,
			pc.CostColor AS ColorCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexMono AS DuplexMonoCost, 
			pc.CostDuplexColor AS DuplexColorCost,
			pc.CostMono AS CopiesMonoCost, 
			pc.CostColor AS CopiesColorCost, 
			ISNULL(pcps.CostMono, pc.CostMono) AS A3MonoCost,
			ISNULL(pcps.CostColor, pc.CostColor) AS A3ColorCost,
			pc.CostScan AS ScanCost,
			pc.CostSentFax AS FaxCost
		FROM
			CostGroups pc  
			LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize pcps ON pcps.CostGroupID = pc.CostGroupID AND pcps.PaperSizeID = 8
		WHERE
			pc.CostGroupID IN (SELECT DISTINCT TOP 20 CostGroupID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE EnabledCounterStatus in (1,3))

	END

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingData

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingData]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters bit,
@ShowBillingData bit = 1

AS
BEGIN

                --**********************************************************************************************
                --** Robson, 18/06/2013
                --** Traz os dados de impressão para o relatório de fechamento
                --UPDATE: Ramiro Pedrozo (17/09/2012),foi alterado para atender requesito ""REQ 4.12.0.004""
                --do cenario ""CEN022308_GP_Gestão"", no mesmo foi descrito uma alteração de filtro por 
                --impressoras de contrato, e para isso foi preciso adiciopnar um parametro novo ""@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters""
                --UPDATE: Hugo Longo (05/02/2013),foi alterado para atender o ID ""46964""
                --Buscar dados de contabilização das impressoras  (padrão marcado), e para isso foi preciso adicionar um novo parâmetro ""@ShowBillingData""
                --**********************************************************************************************
                
                DECLARE @ClosingDataList TABLE
                (
                               PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
                               Model NVARCHAR(255),
                               SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
                               MachineIP NVARCHAR(52),
                               [Type] bit,
                               SiteName NVARCHAR(255),
                               FirstCounter int,
                               FirstCounterDate datetime,
                               LastCounter int,
                               LastCounterDate datetime,
                               Total int,
                               TotalMono int,
                               TotalColor int,
                               TotalCopies int,
                               TotalCopiesMono int,
                               TotalCopiesColor int,
                               TotalfaxReceived int,
                               TotalfaxSent int,
                               TotalScan int,
                               TotalDuplex int,
                               TotalDuplexMono int,
                               TotalDuplexColor int,
                               TotalA3 int,
                               TotalA3Mono int,
                               TotalA3Color int,
                               PrintCostName NVARCHAR(255),
                               Engaged int,
                               Monitored int,
                               CostFixed decimal (19,6),
                               CostExtra decimal (19,6),
                               Location NVARCHAR(255),
                               Productivity int,
                               EngagedVolume int,
                               Department NVARCHAR(100),
                               CounterBlackNumber int,
                               CounterColorNumber int,                          
                               PrinterDeviceID int)
                               
                
                DECLARE @CountersOutput TABLE
                (
                               PrinterDeviceID INT, 
                               CounterTypeID INT,
                               AdjustType TINYINT,
                               ComplementType TINYINT,
                               ProductionIsLife BIT,
                               FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                               LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
                               CounterTotalDif BIGINT, 
                               CounterBlackDif BIGINT,
                               CounterColorDif BIGINT,
                               CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                               CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, 
                               CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT
                )
                
                --CARREGA OS DADOS DOS CONTADORES DE PRODUÇÃO, BASEANDO-SE NO FILTRO SOLICITADO
                --UPDATE: Ramiro Pedrozo (17/09/2012),foi alterado para atender requesito ""REQ 4.12.0.004""
                --do cenario ""CEN022308_GP_Gestão"", no mesmo foi descrito uma alteração de filtro por 
                --impressoras de contrato 
                
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersOutput
                               SELECT 
                                               *
                               FROM
                                               [dbo].[getPrintersCountersData]
                                               (
                                                               @StartDateTime,
                                                               @EndDateTime,
                                                               NULL, --@PrinterDeviceID,
                                                               NULL, --@SiteID,
                                                               NULL, --@SiteDivisionID,
                                                               @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters,
                                                               30,--@MaxLimitDaysEarlier,
                                                               1, --@GetLatestCounterNumbers (para este relatório é preciso os ultimos contadores)
                                                               1, --@GetJustProductionCounters (se é pra trazer só so contadores de produção)
                                                               1)--@OnlyPrintersWithCounters)
                
                DECLARE @CountersCube TABLE 
                (PDID INT, FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, TotalPages INT, CNDif Bigint, CCNDif Bigint,
                CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)
                
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersCube
                               SELECT 
                                               PrinterDeviceID, 
                                               FirstDateTimeRead, 
                                               LastDateTimeRead, 
                                               0, 
                                               CounterTotalDif,
                                               CounterColorDif,
                                               CounterTotalLatestNumber, 
                                               CounterBlackLatestNumber, 
                                               CounterColorLatestNumber
                               FROM
                                               @CountersOutput
                
                --INSERIR IMPRESSORAS DE CONTRATO QUE NÃO ESTÃO AQUI.
                INSERT INTO 
                               @CountersCube
                               SELECT 
                                               PrinterDeviceID, 
                                               @StartDateTime, 
                                               @EndDateTime, 
                                               0, 
                                               0,
                                               0,
                                               0, 
                                               0, 
                                               0
                               FROM 
                                               PrintersDevices 
                               WHERE 
                                               EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
                                               EngagedStatus IN (1,3) AND 
                                               PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @CountersOutput)
                
                --VERIFICA SE PRECISA ADICIONAR A CONTABILIZAÇÃO NO RELATÓRIO
                IF(@ShowBillingData = 1)
                BEGIN
                               --COLOCA O TOTAL DE PÁGINAS NAS IMPRESSORAS     
                               UPDATE @CountersCube SET TotalPages = ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(FirstDateTimeRead, LastDateTimeRead, PDID), 0)
                END
                ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                --- AGORA AQUI VAMOS CALCULAR OS VALORES DOS DEMAIS CONTADORES (CÓPIA, FAX, ETC)
                ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

                --ARMAZENA NA TABELA TEMPORÁRIA AS IMPRESSORAS, OS PRIMEIROS E ÚLTIMOS CONTADORES DELAS NO PERÍODO E A DIFERENÇA ENTRE ELES
                DECLARE @OthersCountersCube TABLE 
                               (PDID2 INT, 
                               CTID INT,
                               CNDif   BIGINT,
                               CCNDif  BIGINT)
                
                
                INSERT INTO @OthersCountersCube
                               SELECT PDID2, CTID, SUM(CNDif), SUM(CCNDif) FROM
                               (
                                               SELECT 
                                                               CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayTotal) ELSE SUM(FullTotal) END AS CNDif,
                                                               CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayColor) ELSE SUM(FullColor) END AS CCNDif,
                                                               CC.PrinterDeviceID AS PDID2,
                                                               CC.CounterTypeID AS CTID
                                               FROM 
                                                               CubeCounter CC
                                                               INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CC.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
                                               WHERE 
                                                               (CC.CubeDate BETWEEN @StartDateTime  AND @EndDateTime) AND --DENTRO DO PERÍODO INFORMADO
                                                               PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
                                                               PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation) AND
                                                               CC.CounterTypeID <> 1 AND CC.CounterTypeID <> 2 --TIRA FORA O GERAL E O DE IMPRESSÃO

                                               GROUP BY CC.PrinterDeviceID, CC.CounterTypeID, BeforeDate
                               ) AS TABLE1
                               GROUP BY PDID2, CTID

                DELETE FROM @OthersCountersCube WHERE CNDif = 0

                DECLARE @Complementares TABLE 
                               (PDID INT, 
                               TotalCopies INT,
                               TotalCopiesColor INT,
                               TotalfaxReceived INT,
                               TotalfaxSent INT,
                               TotalScan INT,
                               TotalDuplex INT,
                               TotalDuplexColor INT,
                               TotalA3 INT,
                               TotalA3Color INT)

                
                INSERT INTO @Complementares 
                               SELECT distinct PDID2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 

                -- cópias 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalCopies = CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copies') and PDID = PDID2

                --cópias 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalCopies = TotalCopies  + CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = TotalCopiesColor  + CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copy') and PDID = PDID2
                               
                --fax recebido 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxReceived = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Fax') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax recebido 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxReceived = TotalfaxReceived + CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxReceived') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax enviado
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalfaxSent = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxSent') and PDID = PDID2

                --fax enviado
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalScan = CNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Scan') and PDID = PDID2

                -- duplex
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalDuplex = CNDif, TotalDuplexColor = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Duplex') and PDID = PDID2

                -- a3 1
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalA3 = CNDif, TotalA3Color = CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3AndBiggerSizes') and PDID = PDID2

                -- a3 2
                UPDATE @Complementares
                               SET TotalA3 = TotalA3 + CNDif, TotalA3Color = TotalA3Color + CCNDif
                               FROM @OthersCountersCube 
                               WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3') and PDID = PDID2

                INSERT INTO @ClosingDataList
                               SELECT     
                                               PD.PrinterDeviceName AS PrinterDeviceName,
                                               PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
                                               PD.SerialNumber,
                                               '[' + PD.AddressName  + ']' AS MachineIP, 
                                               PD.IsLocal AS [Type],
                                               Sites.SiteName,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber - C.CNDif,0) AS FirstCounter,                      
                                               C.FirstDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber,0) AS LastCounter,
                                               C.LastDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
                                               C.CNDif AS Total,                            
                                               (C.CNDif - C.CCNDif )AS TotalMono,
                                               C.CCNDif AS TotalColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) AS TotalCopies,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesMono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalfaxReceived,0) AS TotalfaxReceived,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalfaxSent,0) AS TotalfaxSent,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalScan,0) AS TotalScan,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) AS TotalDuplex,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexMono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexColor,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) AS TotalA3,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Mono,
                                               ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Color,
                                               PC.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName,
                                               CASE PD.EngagedStatus WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Engaged,
                                               C.TotalPages AS Monitored,
                                               0  AS CostFixed, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do nddPrintMaster
                                               0  AS CostExtra, --Não tem mais
                                               PD.Location,
                                               0 AS Productivity, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do KB
                                               0 AS EngagedVolume, --Não tem mais
                                               ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'Sem departamento') AS Department,
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterBlackLatestNumber,0) AS CounterBlackNumber,                                                                                                     
                                               ISNULL(C.CounterColorLatestNumber,0) AS CounterColorNumber,                                     
                                               PD.PrinterDeviceID 
                               FROM 
                                               PrintersDevices PD
                                               INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
                                               INNER JOIN @CountersCube C ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = C.PDID
                                               INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID
                                               LEFT OUTER JOIN @Complementares O ON C.PDID = O.PDID
                                               INNER JOIN CostGroups PC ON PD.CostGroupID = PC.CostGroupID
                                               LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID

                SELECT * FROM @ClosingDataList
                               
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingDataRetrocomp

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_RetrieveClosingDataRetrocomp]
@StartDateTime DATE,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters bit,
@ShowBillingData bit = 1

AS
BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 03/05/2016
	--** gera relatório retrocompativel com contadores de produção para a versão 5.5
	--** Robson, 31/07/2017
	--** Alterado porque o order parou de funcionar e o recalculo nao começava do começo então 
	--** impressoras ficavam de fora 
	--**********************************************************************************************

	set nocount on 
	
	DECLARE @ClosingDataList TABLE
		(PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200),
		Model NVARCHAR(255),
		SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50),
		MachineIP NVARCHAR(52),
		[Type] bit,
		SiteName NVARCHAR(255),
		FirstCounter int,
		FirstCounterDate datetime,
		LastCounter int,
		LastCounterDate datetime,
		Total int,
		TotalMono int,
		TotalColor int,
		TotalCopies int,
		TotalCopiesMono int,
		TotalCopiesColor int,
		TotalfaxReceived int,
		TotalfaxSent int,
		TotalScan int,
		TotalDuplex int,
		TotalDuplexMono int,
		TotalDuplexColor int,
		TotalA3 int,
		TotalA3Mono int,
		TotalA3Color int,
		PrintCostName NVARCHAR(255),
		Engaged int,
		Monitored int,
		CostFixed decimal (19,6),
		CostExtra decimal (19,6),
		Location NVARCHAR(255),
		Productivity int,
		EngagedVolume int,
		Department NVARCHAR(100),
		CounterBlackNumber int,
		CounterColorNumber int,
		PrinterDeviceID int)

	DECLARE @CountersOutput TABLE
		(PrinterDeviceID INT, 
		CounterTypeID INT,
		AdjustType TINYINT,
		ComplementType TINYINT,
		ProductionIsLife BIT,
		FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
		LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, 
		CounterTotalDif BIGINT, 
		CounterBlackDif BIGINT,
		CounterColorDif BIGINT,
		CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, 
		CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, 
		CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)

	--vou ter que pegar as impressoras antes para fazer o recalculo de cubos.
	DECLARE @Printers TABLE (PDID INT)
	INSERT INTO 
		@Printers
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID
		FROM
			[dbo].[getPrintersAndCountersBehaviorsRetrocomp](null, null, null, @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters)
		
	
	DECLARE @PDID INT = NULL
	SELECT TOP 1 @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers ORDER BY PDID
	
	WHILE (@PDID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		DECLARE @CurrentPDID INT = @PDID

		DECLARE @exec NVARCHAR(MAX)
		SET @exec  = 'EXEC [proc_CountersCubesRetrocomp_RecalcPrinter] ''' + CAST(@StartDateTime AS NVARCHAR)  + ''','''+ CAST(@EndDateTime AS NVARCHAR) + ''','  + CAST(@PDID AS NVARCHAR) 
		
		print @exec
		EXEC (@EXEC)

		--DELETE FROM @PRINTERS WHERE PDID = @PDID
		SET @PDID = NULL
		SELECT TOP 1 @PDID = PDID FROM @Printers WHERE PDID > @CurrentPDID  ORDER BY PDID
	
	END
                
	--CARREGA OS DADOS DOS CONTADORES DE PRODUÇÃO, BASEANDO-SE NO FILTRO SOLICITADO
	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersOutput
		SELECT 
			*
		FROM
			[dbo].[getPrintersCountersDataRetrocomp]
			(
			@StartDateTime,
			@EndDateTime,
			null, --@PrinterDeviceID,
			NULL, --@SiteID,
			NULL, --@SiteDivisionID,
			@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters,
			30,--@MaxLimitDaysEarlier,
			1, --@GetLatestCounterNumbers (para este relatório é preciso os ultimos contadores)
			1, --@GetJustProductionCounters (se é pra trazer só so contadores de produção)
			1)--@OnlyPrintersWithCounters)
               
	DECLARE @CountersCube TABLE 
	(PDID INT, FirstDateTimeRead DATETIME, LastDateTimeRead DATETIME, TotalPages INT, CNDif Bigint, CCNDif Bigint,
	CounterTotalLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterBlackLatestNumber BIGINT, CounterColorLatestNumber BIGINT)

	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersCube
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			FirstDateTimeRead, 
			LastDateTimeRead, 
			0, 
			CounterTotalDif,
			CounterColorDif,
			CounterTotalLatestNumber, 
			CounterBlackLatestNumber, 
			CounterColorLatestNumber
		FROM
			@CountersOutput

	--INSERIR IMPRESSORAS DE CONTRATO QUE NÃO ESTÃO AQUI.
	INSERT INTO 
		@CountersCube
		SELECT 
			PrinterDeviceID, 
			@StartDateTime, 
			@EndDateTime, 
			0, 
			0,
			0,
			0, 
			0, 
			0
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices 
		WHERE 
			EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
			EngagedStatus IN (1,3) AND 
			PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM @CountersOutput)
                
	--VERIFICA SE PRECISA ADICIONAR A CONTABILIZAÇÃO NO RELATÓRIO
	IF(@ShowBillingData = 1)
	BEGIN
		--COLOCA O TOTAL DE PÁGINAS NAS IMPRESSORAS     
		UPDATE @CountersCube SET TotalPages = ISNULL(dbo.TotalPagesCounter(FirstDateTimeRead, LastDateTimeRead, PDID), 0)
	END
	
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--- AGORA AQUI VAMOS CALCULAR OS VALORES DOS DEMAIS CONTADORES (CÓPIA, FAX, ETC)
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	--ARMAZENA NA TABELA TEMPORÁRIA AS IMPRESSORAS, OS PRIMEIROS E ÚLTIMOS CONTADORES DELAS NO PERÍODO E A DIFERENÇA ENTRE ELES
	DECLARE @OthersCountersCube TABLE 
		(PDID2 INT, 
		CTID INT,
		CNDif   BIGINT,
		CCNDif  BIGINT)
                
	INSERT INTO @OthersCountersCube
		SELECT PDID2, CTID, SUM(CNDif), SUM(CCNDif) FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayTotal) ELSE SUM(FullTotal) END AS CNDif,
				CASE WHEN BeforeDate < DATEADD(D,-30, @StartDateTime) THEN SUM(TodayColor) ELSE SUM(FullColor) END AS CCNDif,
				CC.PrinterDeviceID AS PDID2,
				CC.CounterTypeID AS CTID
			FROM 
				CubeCounterRetrocomp CC
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON CC.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
			WHERE 
				(CC.CubeDate BETWEEN @StartDateTime  AND @EndDateTime) AND --DENTRO DO PERÍODO INFORMADO
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND
				PD.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation) AND
				CC.CounterTypeID <> 1 AND CC.CounterTypeID <> 2 --TIRA FORA O GERAL E O DE IMPRESSÃO
			GROUP BY CC.PrinterDeviceID, CC.CounterTypeID, BeforeDate
		) AS TABLE1
		GROUP BY PDID2, CTID

	DELETE FROM @OthersCountersCube WHERE CNDif = 0

	DECLARE @Complementares TABLE 
		(PDID INT, 
		TotalCopies INT,
		TotalCopiesColor INT,
		TotalfaxReceived INT,
		TotalfaxSent INT,
		TotalScan INT,
		TotalDuplex INT,
		TotalDuplexColor INT,
		TotalA3 INT,
		TotalA3Color INT)

                
	INSERT INTO @Complementares 
		SELECT distinct PDID2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 

	-- cópias 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalCopies = CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copies') and PDID = PDID2

	--cópias 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalCopies = TotalCopies  + CNDif, TotalCopiesColor = TotalCopiesColor  + CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Copy') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax recebido 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxReceived = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Fax') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax recebido 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxReceived = TotalfaxReceived + CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxReceived') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax enviado
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalfaxSent = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'FaxSent') and PDID = PDID2

	--fax enviado
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalScan = CNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Scan') and PDID = PDID2

	-- duplex
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalDuplex = CNDif, TotalDuplexColor = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'Duplex') and PDID = PDID2

	-- a3 1
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalA3 = CNDif, TotalA3Color = CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3AndBiggerSizes') and PDID = PDID2

	-- a3 2
	UPDATE @Complementares
		SET TotalA3 = TotalA3 + CNDif, TotalA3Color = TotalA3Color + CCNDif
		FROM @OthersCountersCube 
		WHERE CTID IN (select CounterTypeID from countertypes where countertypename = 'A3') and PDID = PDID2

	INSERT INTO @ClosingDataList
		SELECT     
			PD.PrinterDeviceName AS PrinterDeviceName,
			PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
			PD.SerialNumber,
			'[' + PD.AddressName  + ']' AS MachineIP, 
			PD.IsLocal AS [Type],
			Sites.SiteName,
			ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber - C.CNDif,0) AS FirstCounter,                      
			C.FirstDateTimeRead AS FirstCounterDate,
			ISNULL(C.CounterTotalLatestNumber,0) AS LastCounter,
			C.LastDateTimeRead AS LastCounterDate,
			C.CNDif AS Total,                            
			(C.CNDif - C.CCNDif )AS TotalMono,
			C.CCNDif AS TotalColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) AS TotalCopies,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopies,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesMono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalCopiesColor,0) AS TotalCopiesColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalfaxReceived,0) AS TotalfaxReceived,
			ISNULL(O.TotalfaxSent,0) AS TotalfaxSent,
			ISNULL(O.TotalScan,0) AS TotalScan,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) AS TotalDuplex,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplex,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexMono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalDuplexColor,0) AS TotalDuplexColor,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) AS TotalA3,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3,0) - ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Mono,
			ISNULL(O.TotalA3Color,0) AS TotalA3Color,
			PC.CostGroupName AS PrintCostName,
			CASE PD.EngagedStatus WHEN 0 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS Engaged,
			C.TotalPages AS Monitored,
			0  AS CostFixed, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do nddPrintMaster
			0  AS CostExtra, --Não tem mais
			PD.Location,
			0 AS Productivity, --Não tem mais. Vai pegar isso do KB
			0 AS EngagedVolume, --Não tem mais
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName,'Sem departamento') AS Department,
			ISNULL(C.CounterBlackLatestNumber,0) AS CounterBlackNumber,                                                                                                     
			ISNULL(C.CounterColorLatestNumber,0) AS CounterColorNumber,                                     
			PD.PrinterDeviceID 
		FROM 
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN @CountersCube C ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = C.PDID
			INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID
			LEFT OUTER JOIN @Complementares O ON C.PDID = O.PDID
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PC ON PD.CostGroupID = PC.CostGroupID
			LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID

	SELECT * FROM @ClosingDataList

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_Reports_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_Reports_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter]
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS
BEGIN
	
	--***********************************************************************************
	-- Roger,21/03/2017
	-- Busco as ultimas leituras das impressoras dos consumíveis
	-- Roger 05/04/2017
	-- Adicionado separado os dados da impressora para exportar CSV
	-- 22/01/2019, Diego Antunes #Sprint 35 v5.43
	-- Inserido parametro SiteID que não estava sendo considerado pela SP.
	--***********************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		SU.PrinterDeviceID,        
		NR.DateTimeRead,
		NR.CounterColor,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		NR.CounterTotal,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
		SCC.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(SU.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterFullName,
		B.BrandName,
		P.PrinterDeviceName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		P.SerialNumber AS PrinterSerialNumber,
		P.AddressName,
		P.[Location]
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			NSLReadingID
		FROM
		(
			SELECT
				NSL.NSLReadingID,
				ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SU.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) N
			FROM
				NSLReadings NSL
				INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NSL.NSLReadingID
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				NSL.DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) AND --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
				((@SiteID = -1) OR (PD.SiteID = @SiteID))
		) AS F
		WHERE N = 1
	) AS BASE 
	INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU	ON BASE.NSLReadingID = SU.NSLReadingID
	INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN	ON SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
	INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN	ON SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
	INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU	ON SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
	INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC		ON SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
	INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR			ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID
	INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC			ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
	INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST			ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
	INNER JOIN PrintersDevices AS P		ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = P.PrinterDeviceID
	INNER JOIN PrintersModels AS PM		ON P.PrinterModelID = PM.PrinterModelID
	LEFT JOIN Brands AS B				ON B.BrandID=PM.BrandID
	ORDER BY
		SU.PrinterDeviceID

END

GO
```

### proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RemoveFromSite

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RemoveFromSite]
@SubNetworkID INT
AS
BEGIN
 
  	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Passa a subrede atual para o site padrão
	-- Robson, 20/02/2013
	--*******************************************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @NewSiteID INT
	SELECT @NewSiteID = SiteID FROM Sites WHERE IsDefault = 1

	UPDATE
		SubNetworks
	SET      
		SiteID = @NewSiteID
	WHERE
		SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID
		 
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@IgnoreSiteID BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
 
 	--*******************************************************************************************************************
	-- Traz todos os subnetworks, ou só os de um site, só teodos menos de um site
	-- Robson, 19/02/2013
	--*******************************************************************************************************************

	IF (@IgnoreSiteID = 0)
	BEGIN

	    IF (@SiteID <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID = @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
				ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID <> @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
	END
END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAll]
@PrinterDeviceID INT 

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 10/05/2013
	-- Retorna todos os unmonitoreds de uma impressora desde sempre
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT 
		NR.NSLReadingID,
		NR.DateTimeRead,
		NR.CounterColor,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		NR.CounterTotal,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
		SCC.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		SO.SupplyOIDName
	FROM
		SuppliesUnmonitored SU
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
		INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
		INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
		INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
		INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
		INNER JOIN SupplyOIDs SO ON SU.SupplyOIDID = SO.SupplyOIDID
	WHERE
		SU.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
	ORDER BY
		NR.DateTimeRead DESC

END
GO
```

### proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_GPV_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveAllLastestFromPrinter]  
@PrinterDeviceID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************
	--Roger,20/03/2017
	--Busco as ultimas leituras das impressoras dos consumíveis
	--***********************************************************************************
       SELECT 
             SU.PrinterDeviceID,        
             NR.DateTimeRead,
             NR.CounterColor,
             SU.LoadStatus,
             NR.CounterTotal,
             SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
             SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
             SPNU.PartNumber,
             SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
             SCC.SupplyColorName,
             ST.SupplyTypeName
       FROM
             (
                    SELECT 
                           NSLReadingID  
                    FROM 
                           (
                                  SELECT 
                                        NSL.NSLReadingID, 
                                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SU.PrinterDeviceID ORDER BY DateTimeRead DESC) N
                                  FROM
                                        NSLReadings NSL
                                        INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NSL.NSLReadingID  
                                        INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON SU.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
                                  WHERE 
                                        (@PrinterDeviceID = 0 OR SU.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) AND
                                        PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3) --SÓ AS IMPRESSORAS COM CONTADORES ATIVOS
                           ) AS F 
                    WHERE N = 1
             ) AS BASE 
             INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON base.nslreadingid = SU.nslreadingid              
             INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
             INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
             INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
             INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
             INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
             INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCC ON SU.SupplyColorID = SCC.SupplyColorID
             INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = ST.SupplyTypeID
END
GO
```

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveCountersFromPrinter]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@SupplySubFunctionTypeID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 21/03/2017
	-- Retorna todos os contadores da impressora
	-- Diego, 28/04/2017
	-- Alteração para buscar contadores de referencia de suprimento caso existam para o slot e tipo informados.

	SELECT

	ORDER BY
```

### proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveIDsFromPrinterDevice

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_NSLReadings_RetrieveIDsFromPrinterDevice]
@PrinterDeviceID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--*********************************************************************************************
	-- Robson, 19/09/2013
	-- Traz os IDS de NSL (para processamento dos unmonitored) mas só apartir da data que tem unmonitored
	-- Diego, 13/06/2017
	-- Alterado para não trazer os NSLReadingIDs de forma repetida.
	--*********************************************************************************************

	SELECT

	FROM
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PartnersConfigurations_RetrieveObjectsLevel6]

AS

BEGIN
```

### proc_IVT_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromModel

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromModel]
@PrinterModelID INT,
@PrintersModelsSlotProfileID INT = 0

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 25-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Traz todas AS impressoras de um determinado modelo e o seu SlotProfileID
	-- Diego, 13/06/2017
	-- Alterado para permitir retornar somente as impressoras que estejam com o SlotProfileID diferente do passado
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		ISNULL(PDS.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID, 0) AS 'PrintersModelsSlotProfileID'
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl PDS ON PDS.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
	WHERE
		PD.PrinterModelID = @PrinterModelID AND
		dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0 AND
		(ISNULL(PDS.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID, 0) <> @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID OR @PrintersModelsSlotProfileID = 0)

END

GO
```

### proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlots_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 25-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Remove o PrinterDeviceSlotID e joga os históricos para a Unmonitored
	--###############################################################################

		--Insere para a Unmonitored 
		INSERT INTO 
			SuppliesUnmonitored 
			([PrinterDeviceID]
           ,[NSLReadingID]
           ,[SupplyTypeID]
           ,[SupplyPhysicalNameID]
           ,[SupplySerialNumberID]
           ,LoadStatus
           ,[SupplyCapacityID]
           ,[SupplyColorID]
           ,[PartNumberID])
				SELECT 
				PDS.PrinterDeviceID, 
				PDSH.NSLReadingID, 
				PDSH.SupplyTypeID, 
				PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID, 
				PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID, 
				PDSH.LoadStatus, 
				PDSH.SupplyCapacityID, 
				PDSH.SupplyColorID, 
				PDSH.PartNumberID 
				FROM
				PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesSlots PDS ON PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID = PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID
				WHERE
				PDS.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
			
			
			--Deleta da PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
			DELETE FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
			
			--Deleta da PrintersDevicesSlots
			DELETE FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID
				

END
GO
```

### proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllForProcessing

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric_RetrieveAllForProcessing]
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT,
@SupplySubFunctionTypeID INT,
@SupplyChangeID INT = 0,
@DateStart DATETIME = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************************
	-- Diego, 27/04/2017
	-- Alteração para buscar contadores de referencia de suprimento caso existam para o slot e tipo informados.
	--**********************************************************************************************************

	IF (@SupplyChangeID = 0)
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,

			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			PDSH.LoadStatus AS LoadRealStatus,
			SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			PDSH.TotalReadings,			
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.ForceStart,
			-1 AS InternalSupplyChangeID
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 

				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID
		WHERE
			(PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID --ID do Slot
			AND PDSH.Invalid = 0 --Somente os válidos
			AND (NR.DateTimeRead >= @DateStart OR @DateStart IS NULL)) --Apartir da data passada ou todos
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead ASC --Ordem crescente de data
		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		SELECT 
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID,
			NR.DateTimeRead,

			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterColor,
				NR.CounterColor
			)
			AS CounterColor,
			COALESCE
			(
				SRC.CounterTotal,
				NR.CounterTotal
			)
			AS CounterTotal,

			SPN.SupplyPhysicalName AS PhysicalName,
			SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
			PDSH.LoadStatus,
			PDSH.LoadStatus AS LoadRealStatus,
			SC.SupplyCapacity AS Capacity,
			SPNU.PartNumber,
			PDSH.TotalReadings,			
			PDSH.SupplyChangeID,
			PDSH.ForceStart,		
			-1 AS InternalSupplyChangeID
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric PDSH
			INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  PDSH.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
			INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  PDSH.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  PDSH.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
			INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  PDSH.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings NR ON PDSH.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 

				LEFT JOIN SuppliesReferenceCounters SRC ON NR.NSLReadingID = SRC.NSLReadingID AND SRC.SupplySubFunctionTypeID = @SupplySubFunctionTypeID
		WHERE
			PDSH.PrinterDeviceSlotID = @PrinterDeviceSlotID --ID do Slot
			AND SupplyChangeID = @SupplyChangeID --ID do suprimento
			AND PDSH.Invalid = 0 --Somente os válidos
		ORDER BY
			NR.DateTimeRead ASC
	
	END
		
END

GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl_SetSlotProfileID]
```

BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Atualiza o SlotProfileId da impressora no banco (depois de ter criado os slots dela)
	-- Diego, 26/11/2018 - Sprint 32 v5.40
	-- Alterado tipo do parametro @SupplySlotProfileID para INT
	--############################################################################### proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_MoveHistoricToSlot

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_MoveHistoricToSlot]
@SupplyUnmonitoredID INT,
@PrinterDeviceSlotID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 19/09/2013
	--** Mode a leitura do supplyUnmonitored para o slot que agora é conhecido
	--************************************************************************************************

	INSERT INTO PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
		(
			PrinterDeviceSlotID,
			NSLReadingID,
			SupplyTypeID,
			SupplyPhysicalNameID,
			SupplySerialNumberID,
			LoadStatus,
			SupplyCapacityID,
			SupplyColorID,
			PartNumberID,
			SupplyOIDID,
			TotalReadings,
			SupplyChangeID,
			ForceStart,
			Invalid)
		SELECT
			@PrinterDeviceSlotID,
			NSLReadingID,
			SupplyTypeID,
			SupplyPhysicalNameID,
			SupplySerialNumberID,
			LoadStatus,
			SupplyCapacityID,
			SupplyColorID,
			PartNumberID,
			SupplyOIDID,
			1,--TotalReadings,
			NULL,--SupplyChangeID,
			0,--ForceStart,
			0--Invalid
		FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored
		WHERE
			SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID
		
		
	DELETE FROM SuppliesUnmonitored WHERE SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID
		
		
END
GO
```

### proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_Remove]
@SupplyUnmonitoredID INT = 0,
@PrinterDevicesIDs AS IntTable READONLY,
@LimitDays DATETIME = '2001-01-01 00:00:00'

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Maicon, 26/09/12, nBilling 5.0, 
	-- Remove o SuppliesUnmonitored com base no SupplyUnmonitoredID
	-- Diego, 29/06/2018
	-- Alteração para utilizar uma tabela de IDs ao invés de uma string.
	--###############################################################################

	IF(@SupplyUnmonitoredID = 0)
	BEGIN

		DELETE
			SU
		FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored AS SU
			INNER JOIN NSLReadings ON NSLReadings.NSLReadingID = SU.NSLReadingID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl ON PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrinterDeviceID = SU.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			NSLReadings.DateTimeRead < @LimitDays AND
			SU.PrinterDeviceID IN  (SELECT INTID FROM @PrinterDevicesIDs) AND
			(PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID IS NOT NULL AND PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID <> 0)

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		DELETE FROM
			SuppliesUnmonitored
		WHERE
			SupplyUnmonitoredID = @SupplyUnmonitoredID

	END

END

GO
```

### proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveSuppliesFromNSL

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_IVT_SuppliesUnmonitored_RetrieveSuppliesFromNSL]
@NSLReadingID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--************************************************************************************************
	--** Robson, 19/09/2013
	--** Traz os SuppliesUnmonitored de uma leitura nsl que nao se encaixaram em nenhum slot.
	--** Como está chamando apenas quando ainda não havia slots antes, vai trazer todos pois nenhum se encaixou
	--************************************************************************************************

	SELECT 
		SC.SupplyCapacity,
		SPNU.PartNumber,
		SPN.SupplyPhysicalName,
		SSN.SupplySerialNumber AS SerialNumber,
		SCo.SupplyColorName,
		ST.SupplyTypeName,
		SU.LoadStatus,
		SU.SupplyUnmonitoredID
	FROM
		NSLReadings NR		
		INNER JOIN SuppliesUnmonitored SU ON SU.NSLReadingID = NR.NSLReadingID 
		INNER JOIN SupplyPhysicalNames SPN ON  SU.SupplyPhysicalNameID = SPN.SupplyPhysicalNameID
		INNER JOIN SupplySerialNumbers SSN ON  SU.SupplySerialNumberID = SSN.SupplySerialNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyPartNumbers SPNU ON  SU.PartNumberID = SPNU.PartNumberID
		INNER JOIN SupplyCapacities SC ON  SU.SupplyCapacityID = SC.SupplyCapacityID		
		INNER JOIN SupplyColors SCo ON SU.SupplyColorID = Sco.SupplyColorID
		INNER JOIN SupplyTypes ST ON SU.SupplyTypeID = St.SupplyTypeID
	WHERE
		NR.NSLReadingID = @NSLReadingID
		
END
GO
```

```sql
	BEGIN

	END
```

```sql
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_Find

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_Find] 
@IP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@Mask NVARCHAR(15) =NULL,
@StrongName NVARCHAR(36) = '',
@ProductID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@StrongName <> '')
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			M.MachineID 
		FROM 
			Machines M 
		WHERE 
			M.StrongName = @StrongName
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@MachineName IS NULL )
		BEGIN
			IF (@ProductID <> -1)
			BEGIN
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				WHERE 
					MNA.IP = @IP
					AND IPR.ProductID = @ProductID
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN			
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
				WHERE 
					MNA.IP = @IP
					AND MNA.Mask = @Mask
			END
		END
		ELSE
			IF (@ProductID <> -1)
			BEGIN	
				SELECT
					M.MachineID 
				FROM 
					Machines M 
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				WHERE 
					M.MachineName = @MachineName
					AND IPR.ProductID = @ProductID
			END
			ELSE
				IF(@IP IS NOT NULL AND @Mask IS NOT NULL)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 
						M.MachineID 
					FROM 
						Machines M 
						INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
					WHERE 
						MNA.IP = @IP
						AND MNA.Mask = @Mask
						AND M.MachineName = @MachineName
				END	
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					SELECT
						M.MachineID 
					FROM 
						Machines M 
					WHERE 
						M.MachineName = @MachineName
				END
	END
END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_NetWorkAddress_Remove

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_NetWorkAddress_Remove] 
@MachineID INT,
@IP NVARCHAR(15)

AS

BEGIN

	DELETE FROM
		MachinesNetworkAddress
	WHERE 
		MachineID = @MachineID 
		AND IP = @IP

	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END
 
END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_RetrieveAll] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@Removed BIT = 0

AS
BEGIN

	SELECT 
		DISTINCT M.*, 
		OperationSystems.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,
		Sites.SiteName
	FROM
		Machines M
		LEFT JOIN Sites ON M.SiteID = Sites.siteID		
		INNER JOIN OperationSystems ON OperationSystems.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
	WHERE
		(M.SiteID = @SiteID OR @SiteID = 0) AND
		(M.Removed = 0 OR M.Removed = @Removed) 
	ORDER BY M.MachineName ASC
END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_RetrievePAAgent

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_RetrievePAAgent] 
@MachineID INT = 0,
@Days INT = -3

AS
BEGIN
                
                SELECT 
                               * 
                FROM
                
                               (SELECT DISTINCT
                                               M.*, 
                                               OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
                                               CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                                               MF.LastDateAccess,
                                               MF.ProductVersion,
                                               0 AS Actived, 
                                               1 AS UnActived  
                               FROM 
                                               Machines M
                                               LEFT JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
                                               LEFT JOIN InstalledProducts MF ON M.MachineID = MF.MachineID
                                               INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                               WHERE 
                                               MF.ProductID in (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products) AND 
                                               MF.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) AND
                                               M.MachineID = @MachineID
                               
                               UNION

                                               SELECT DISTINCT 
                                                               M.*, 
                                                               OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
                                                               CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                                                               MF.LastDateAccess,
                                                               MF.ProductVersion,
                                                               1 AS Actived,
                                                               0 AS UnActived  
                                               FROM 
                                                               Machines M
                                                               LEFT JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
                                                               LEFT JOIN InstalledProducts MF ON M.MachineID = MF.MachineID
                                                               INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                                               WHERE 
                                                               MF.ProductID in (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products) AND 
                                                               MF.LastDateAccess > DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) AND
                                                               M.MachineID = @MachineID
                                               ) AS PaGeneral
END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_SetRemoved_WithoutData

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_SetRemoved_WithoutData]
@NumberOfDays INT

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE
		Machines
	SET 
		Removed = 1
	WHERE 
		MachineID IN
		(
			SELECT
				MachineID
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts
			WHERE 
				PrinterDeviceID IS NULL
				AND DATEDIFF(dd, LastDateAccess, GETDATE()) >= @NumberOfDays
				AND MachineID NOT IN
					(
						SELECT DISTINCT 
							MachineID  
						FROM 
							InstalledProducts
						WHERE
							PrinterDeviceID IS NULL
							AND DATEDIFF(dd, LastDateAccess, GETDATE()) < @NumberOfDays
					)
		)
	
	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Machines_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Machines_Update]
@MachineID INT,
@SubNetworkID INT,
@SiteID INT,
@OperationSystemID INT,
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
@StrongName NVARCHAR(36) = ''

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @OldSiteID INT
	SELECT @OldSiteID = SiteID FROM Machines WHERE MachineID = @MachineID

	IF (@OldSiteID = @SiteID)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Machines 
		SET      
			SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID,
			OperationSystemID = @OperationSystemID,
			MachineName = @MachineName,
			StrongName = @StrongName,
			Removed = 0
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			Machines 
		SET      
			SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID,
			SiteID = @SiteID,
			OperationSystemID = @OperationSystemID,
			MachineName = @MachineName,
			StrongName = @StrongName,
			Removed = 0,
			SiteForcedByUser = 1
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID
	END
	
	--Atualiza o MachineID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 7	--MachineID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Module_Production

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_Production]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		*
	FROM (
		SELECT
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (1,2,3,4,5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS Permission,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (6,7,10,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS [Security],
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PB.PolicyBehaviorID IN (8,9,12,13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS Converter,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN p.[Enabled] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 2, 0) AS [Enabled]
		FROM Policies P INNER JOIN PoliciesBehaviorsParameters PB ON PB.PolicyID = P.PolicyID
		) AS Q1,
		(
		SELECT QuotaParameterValue AS QuotasType FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 1
		) AS Q2,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalUsers FROM Accounts
		) AS Q3,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalPrinters FROM PrintersDevices
		) AS Q4,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(AccountID)) AS UsersHasJobs, COUNT(DISTINCT(PrinterDeviceID)) AS PrintersHasJobs FROM PrintJobs WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q5,
		(
		SELECT ISNULL(MIN(PrintJobID), 0) AS MinPrintJobID, ISNULL(MAX(PrintJobID), 0) AS MaxPrintJobID FROM PrintJobs WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q6,
		(
		SELECT 0 AS TotalPrintersReleaser, COUNT(DISTINCT(PrinterDeviceID)) AS PrintersReleaserHasJobs FROM PrintJobsReleaser PJR INNER JOIN PrintJobs PJ ON PJ.PrintJobID = PJR.PrintJobID WHERE DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q7,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalAccounts FROM CostAccounts
		) AS Q8,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(CostAccountID)) AS TotalAccountsSelectable FROM CostAccountsSelectable
		) AS Q9,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS TotalMachines, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Removed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalMachinesRemoved FROM Machines
		) AS Q10,
		(
		SELECT COUNT(1) AS NPL, ISNULL(SUM(RowsCount), 0) AS NPLRows FROM FilePrintJob WHERE DateBeginProcess BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q11,
		(
		SELECT 0 AS FileInputLastID
		) AS Q12,
		(
		SELECT 
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 0 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledByUser,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 1 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledBySystem,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN (PagesMono) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 1 THEN (PagesColor) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalReleaserCancelledColor,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 0 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledByUser,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.Blocked = 1 AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledBySystem,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN (PagesMono) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN PJC.IsReleaser = 0 THEN (PagesColor) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TotalAgentCancelledColor		
		FROM PrintJobsCanceled PJC WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q13,
		(
		SELECT ISNULL(MIN(PrintJobID), 0) AS MinPrintJobCanceledID, ISNULL(MAX(PrintJobID), 0) AS MaxPrintJobCanceledID FROM PrintJobsCanceled WHERE DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		) AS Q14

END
GO
```

### proc_Module_ProductionData

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_ProductionData]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME,
@GroupByPrinter BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@GroupByPrinter = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID AS ID,
			B.BrandName + ' ' + PM.PrinterModelName AS PrinterName,
			COALESCE(PD.SerialNumber, '-') AS SerialNumber,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus AS [Enabled],
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))) AS DateInclude,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DatePrinted))) AS DatePrinted,
			COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesMono), 0) AS TotalMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor), 0) AS TotalColor,
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CAST(CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsReleaser
		FROM 
			PrintJobs PJ
			LEFT JOIN PrintJobsReleaser PJR ON PJR.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE 
			DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
			B.BrandName,
			PM.PrinterModelName,
			PD.SerialNumber,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted))),
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		ORDER BY
			PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted)))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DateInclude))) AS DateInclude,
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, PJ.DatePrinted))) AS DatePrinted,
			COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesMono), 0) AS TotalMono,
			ISNULL(SUM(PJ.PagesColor), 0) AS TotalColor,
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CAST(CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS IsReleaser
		FROM 
			PrintJobs PJ
			LEFT JOIN PrintJobsReleaser PJR ON PJR.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
		WHERE 
			DateInclude BETWEEN @StartDate AND @EndDate
		GROUP BY
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted))),
			PJ.JobTypeID,
			PJ.JobDisabled,
			CASE WHEN PJR.PrintJobID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
		ORDER BY
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DateInclude))),
			DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, DatePrinted)))
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Module_ProductionReleaserPrinters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Module_ProductionReleaserPrinters]
@StartDate DATETIME,
@EndDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	-- *****************************************************************************************
	-- Héber Savedra, 2020-09-03
	-- Busca o total de impressora do Releaser pelo novo método
	-- *****************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @StartDateZero DATETIME
	SET @StartDateZero = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @StartDate), 0)
	
	DECLARE @EndDateZero DATETIME
	SET @EndDateZero = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, DATEADD(MONTH, 1, @EndDate)), -1)

	SELECT 
		YearCollected, 
		MonthCollected,
		SUM(Amount) AS Amount
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			YEAR(DateCollected) AS YearCollected, 
			MONTH(DateCollected) AS MonthCollected, 
			MAX(Amount) AS Amount
		FROM 
			PrintJobsReleaserPrinters
		WHERE 
			DateCollected BETWEEN @StartDateZero AND @EndDateZero
			AND (LEN(StrongName) > 0)
		GROUP BY
			YEAR(DateCollected), 
			MONTH(DateCollected),
			ServerName,
			StrongName,
			HostID		
		) AS TB 
	GROUP BY
		YearCollected, 
		MonthCollected

END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Paging_RowsCount]
@Table NVARCHAR(70),
@WhereClause NVARCHAR(max) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	/*DECLARE VARIABLES*/
	DECLARE @BuildWhereClause NVARCHAR(max)

	/*SET WHERE CLAUSE */
	IF @WhereClause IS NOT NULL AND @WhereClause != ''
	BEGIN
		SET @BuildWhereClause = ' WHERE ' + @WhereClause + ' '
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SET @BuildWhereClause = ''
	END

	/*EXECUTE DYNAMIC QUERY*/	
	EXEC('SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ' + @Table + @BuildWhereClause)

END
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Permissions_Find]
@AccountID INT = 0,
@PermissionControlID SMALLINT,
@PermissionAccessID SMALLINT

AS
	
BEGIN

	IF (@AccountID = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			COUNT(1)
		FROM 
			AccountsPermissions 
		WHERE
			(PermissionControlID = @PermissionControlID AND PermissionAccessID = @PermissionAccessID)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		IF (@PermissionControlID = 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				COUNT(1)
			FROM 
				AccountsPermissions
			WHERE
				(AccountID = @AccountID OR AccountID = 0)
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				PermissionAccessID
			FROM 
				AccountsPermissions
			WHERE
				AccountID = @AccountID
		END
	END
			
END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Remove]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @PolicyMessageID INT = NULL
	DECLARE @PolicyBehaviorParameterID INT = NULL
	
	DELETE FROM
		PoliciesFeaturesParameters
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	DELETE FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	SELECT 
		@PolicyMessageID = PolicyMessageID
	FROM 
		Policies
	WHERE 
		PolicyID = @PolicyID 
	
	DELETE FROM
		Policies
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMessages
	WHERE
		PolicyMessageID = @PolicyMessageID
		
	--Atualiza o PolicyID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 12 --PolicyID
			OR PolicyControlID = 16	--PolicyBehaviorParameterID
	END	
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_Retrieve

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Retrieve]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT 
		P.PolicyID,
		P.PolicyName,
		P.JobTypeID,
		P.PolicyType,
		P.[Enabled],
		P.AccountIDOwner,
		ISNULL(P.PolicyMessageID, -1) AS PolicyMessageID,
		ISNULL(PMS.MessageText, '') AS MessageText,
		ISNULL(PMS.UseDefaultMessage, 1) AS UseDefaultMessage
	FROM 
		Policies P
		LEFT JOIN PoliciesMessages PMS ON PMS.PolicyMessageID = P.PolicyMessageID
	WHERE 
		P.PolicyID = @PolicyID
		
	SELECT
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorParameterID,
		PBP.PolicyID,
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorID,
		ISNULL(PBP.PolicyBehaviorValue, -1) AS PolicyBehaviorValue 
	FROM
		PoliciesBehaviorsParameters PBP
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	ORDER BY
		PBP.PolicyBehaviorID
		
	SELECT
		PFP.PolicyFeatureParameterID,
		PFP.PolicyID,
		PFP.PolicyFeatureID,
		PFP.PolicyCompareTypeID,
		ISNULL(PFP.Value, '') AS Value,
		ISNULL(PFP.OperatorType, 0) AS OperatorType,
		PFP.[Order]
	FROM
		PoliciesFeaturesParameters PFP
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	ORDER BY
		PFP.[Order]
		
	SELECT
		PM.PolicyMemberID,
		PM.PolicyID,
		PM.ObjectID,
		ISNULL(PM.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PolicyMemberType
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers PM
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID

END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_RetrieveAllFromObject

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_RetrieveAllFromObject]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@AccountGroupID INT = NULL,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@CostGroupID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	-- Verifica aqui se está habilitado a impressão particular ou não:
	--  Se estiver habilitado, traz todos os tipos de políticas de impressão.
	--  Se não estiver habilitado, traz apenas as políticas do tipo Corporativo ou Ambos.
	DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled BIT
	SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM PoliciesParameters WHERE ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'

	SELECT 
		P.PolicyID,
		P.PolicyName,
		PM.PolicyMemberType,
		PM.PolicyMemberID,
		CASE PM.ObjectID
			WHEN -2 THEN 1
			ELSE 0
		END AS IsForAllMembers,
		P.AccountIDOwner
	FROM 
		Policies P
		INNER JOIN PoliciesMembers PM ON PM.PolicyID = P.PolicyID
	WHERE 
		(( PM.ObjectID = -2 AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 1 AND @AccountID IS NOT NULL) -- Busca aqui regras que são para todos os usuários.
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @AccountID AND PM.PolicyMemberType IN (1, 5))
		OR (@AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = PM.ObjectID) AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 2)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = -2 AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3 AND @PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3) --Busca aqui regras que são para todas AS impressoras.
		OR (@PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE CostGroupID = PM.ObjectID) AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 4)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @AccountGroupID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 2)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @CostGroupID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 4))
		AND P.[Enabled] = 1
		AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND P.PolicyType <> 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
	
END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_RetrieveAllIDsFromObject]

@AccountGroupID INT = NULL,

BEGIN

	-- Verifica aqui se está habilitado a impressão particular ou não:
	--  Se estiver habilitado, traz todos os tipos de políticas de impressão.
	--  Se não estiver habilitado, traz apenas as políticas do tipo Corporativo ou Ambos.
	DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled BIT
	SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM PoliciesParameters WHERE ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'

	SELECT 
		P.PolicyID
	FROM 
		Policies P
		INNER JOIN PoliciesMembers PM ON PM.PolicyID = P.PolicyID
	WHERE 
		(( PM.ObjectID = -2 AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 1 AND @AccountID IS NOT NULL) -- Busca aqui regras que são para todos os usuários.
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @AccountID AND PM.PolicyMemberType IN (1, 5))
		OR (@AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM AccountsGroupsObjects WHERE AccountGroupID = PM.ObjectID) AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 2)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = -2 AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 3 AND @PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL)

		OR (@PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE CostGroupID = PM.ObjectID) AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 4)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @AccountGroupID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 2)
		OR (PM.ObjectID = @CostGroupID AND PM.PolicyMemberType = 4))
```
