### proc_Policies_RetrieveAllMembers

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_RetrieveAllMembers]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	-- ******************************************************************************************
	-- Marco Aurélio Cevey, 2013-07-13, nddPrint 5.0
	-- Esta SP retorna todos os mebros pertencentes a política de impressão parametrizada.
	-- ******************************************************************************************
	
	/*
		MemberType:
		
		AccountID = 1,
        AccountGroupID = 2,
        PrinterDeviceID = 3,
        CostGroupID = 4,
        AccountOnPrinterDevice = 5
	*/
	
	DECLARE @PolicyMembers TABLE
		(
			PolicyMemberID INT,
			ObjectID INT,
			PrinterDeviceID INT,
			MemberType TINYINT,
			MemberName NVARCHAR(485), -- Pelo que foi analisado nas concatenações, o máximo de caractéres é 485.
			MemberDescription NVARCHAR(412) -- Pelo que foi analisado nas concatenações, o máximo de caractéres é 412.
		)	
	
	DECLARE @AllAccountsMemberID INT
	DECLARE @AllPrintersDevicesMemberID INT
	
	-- Tenta Obter o Membro todos os usuários desta política de impressão
	SELECT 
		@AllAccountsMemberID = PolicyMemberID
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID AND
		PolicyMemberType = 1 AND
		ObjectID = -2
		
	-- Se encontrou o membro 'Todos os usuários', busca apenas o mesmo;
	IF (@AllAccountsMemberID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			'@@AllUsers' AS MemberName,
			'@@AppliesThisPolicyToAllUsers' AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE
			PolicyMemberID = @AllAccountsMemberID		
	END
	
	-- Tenta Obter o Membro todas as impressoras desta política de impressão
	SELECT 
		@AllPrintersDevicesMemberID = PolicyMemberID
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID AND
		PolicyMemberType = 3 AND
		ObjectID = -2
		
	-- Se encontrou o membro 'Todas as impressoras', busca apenas o mesmo.
	IF (@AllPrintersDevicesMemberID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			'@@AllPrinters' AS MemberName,
			'@@AppliesThisPolicyToAllPrinters' AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE
			PolicyMemberID = @AllPrintersDevicesMemberID		
	END
	
	-- Se não encontrou Todos os usuários, busca todos os menbros do tipo usuários,usuários na impressora e grupos de usuários 
	-- para esta política de impressão.	
	IF (@AllAccountsMemberID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Todos os membros do tipo usuário
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			ISNULL(A.FullName,A.LogonName) AS MemberName,
			D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN Accounts A ON A.AccountID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 1 
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo grupo de usuários
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			AG.AccountGroupName AS MemberName,
			D.DomainName + '\' + AG.AccountGroupName AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroups AG ON AG.AccountGroupID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AG.DomainID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 2 
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo usuário na impressora
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PM.PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			'@@AccountOnPrinterDevice,''' + A.FullName + ''','''+ PD.PrinterDeviceName + '''' AS MemberName,
			CASE SerialNumber -- formata conforme se possui serial ou não
				WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName
				ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName + ' (' + PD.SerialNumber + ')'
			END AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN Accounts A ON A.AccountID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PM.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 5 			
	END
		
	-- Se não encontrou Todas as impressoras, busca todos os menbros do tipo usuários,usuários na impressora e grupos de usuários 
	-- para esta política de impressão.	
	IF (@AllPrintersDevicesMemberID IS NULL)
	BEGIN		
		-- Todos os membros do tipo impressora
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PM.PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName AS MemberName,
			CASE PD.SerialNumber -- formata conforme se possui serial ou não
				WHEN '' THEN PD.AddressName
				ELSE PD.AddressName + ' (' + PD.SerialNumber + ')'
			END AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PM.ObjectID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 3 
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo grupo de impressoras
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID,
			PrinterDeviceID,
			PolicyMemberType,
			PDG.CostGroupName AS MemberName,
			'-' AS MemberDescription
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PDG ON PDG.CostGroupID = PM.ObjectID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 4 
	END
	
	-- Seleciona os todos oa membros desta política de impressão.
	SELECT 
		PolicyMemberID,
		ObjectID,
		PrinterDeviceID,
		MemberType,
		MemberName,
		MemberDescription 	
	FROM
		@PolicyMembers	
		
END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_RetrieveMembersByPolicy

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_RetrieveMembersByPolicy]
@PolicyID INT

AS

BEGIN

	-- ******************************************************************************************
	-- Yago Roberto, 2017-10-18, Portal 360
	-- Esta SP retorna todos os membros pertencentes a política.
	-- ******************************************************************************************
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2020-11-18, Portal 360
	-- Alteração para ignorar usuários removidos.
	-- ******************************************************************************************
	
	/*
		MemberType:
		
		UserID = 1,
        UserGroupID = 2,
        PrinterID = 3,
        PrinterGroupID = 4,
        UserOnPrinter = 5
	*/
	
	DECLARE @PolicyMembers TABLE
		(
			PolicyMemberID INT,
			UserID INT, -- AccountID
			UserName NVARCHAR(255), -- AccountName
			UserGroupID INT, -- AccountGroupID
			UserGroupName NVARCHAR(255), -- AccountGroupName
			PrinterID INT, -- PrinterDeviceID
			PrinterName NVARCHAR(255), -- PrinterDeviceName
			CostGroupID INT, -- CostGroupID
			CostGroupName NVARCHAR(255), -- CostGroupName

			MemberType TINYINT, -- PolicyMemberType
			
			Description NVARCHAR(500)
		)	
	
	DECLARE @ApplyToAllID INT
	
	-- Tenta encontrar algum membro representando 'Todos'
	SELECT 
		@ApplyToAllID = PolicyMemberID
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID AND
		ObjectID = -2
	
	-- Se não encontrou nenhum membro representando a aplicação para todos, 
	-- busca todos os outros de membros para esta política de impressão.	
	IF (@ApplyToAllID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Todos os membros do tipo usuário
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID as UserID,
			ISNULL(A.FullName, A.LogonName) as UserName,
			null as UserGroupID,
			null as UserGroupName,
			null as PrinterID,
			null as PrinterName,
			null as PrinterGroupID,
			null as PrinterGroupName,
			PolicyMemberType,
			D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName as Description
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN Accounts A ON A.AccountID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 1 
			AND A.Removed = 0
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo grupo de usuários
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			null as UserID,
			null as UserName,
			ObjectID as UserGroupID,
			AG.AccountGroupName as UserGroupName,
			null as PrinterID,
			null as PrinterName,
			null as PrinterGroupID,
			null as PrinterGroupName,
			PolicyMemberType,
			D.DomainName + '\' + AG.AccountGroupName AS Description
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroups AG ON AG.AccountGroupID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AG.DomainID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 2 
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo usuário na impressora
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			ObjectID as UserID,
			A.FullName as UserName,
			null as UserGroupID,
			null as UserGroupName,
			PM.PrinterDeviceID as PrinterID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName as PrinterName,
			null as PrinterGroupID,
			null as PrinterGroupName,
			PolicyMemberType,
			CASE SerialNumber -- formata conforme se possui serial ou não
				WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName
				ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName + ' - ' + PD.AddressName + ' (' + PD.SerialNumber + ')'
			END as Description
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN Accounts A ON A.AccountID = PM.ObjectID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = A.DomainID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PM.PrinterDeviceID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 5  
			AND A.Removed = 0	
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo impressora
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			null as UserID,
			null as UserName,
			null as UserGroupID,
			null as UserGroupName,
			ObjectID as PrinterID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName as PrinterName,
			null as PrinterGroupID,
			null as PrinterGroupName,
			PolicyMemberType,
			CASE PD.SerialNumber -- Formata conforme se possui serial ou não
				WHEN '' THEN PD.AddressName
				ELSE PD.AddressName + ' (' + PD.SerialNumber + ')'
			END as Description
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PM.ObjectID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 3 
			
		-- Todos os membros do tipo grupo de custo
		INSERT INTO
			@PolicyMembers
		SELECT
			PolicyMemberID,
			null as UserID,
			null as UserName,
			null as UserGroupID,
			null as UserGroupName,
			null as PrinterID,
			null as PrinterName,
			ObjectID as CostGroupID,
			PDG.CostGroupName as CostGroupName,
			PolicyMemberType,
			'-' as Description
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers PM
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PDG ON PDG.CostGroupID = PM.ObjectID
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID
			AND PolicyMemberType = 4 		
	END
	
	-- Seleciona os todos os membros desta política de impressão.
	SELECT 
		PolicyMemberID,
		UserID,
		UserName,
		UserGroupID,
		UserGroupName,
		PrinterID,
		PrinterName,
		CostGroupID,
		CostGroupName,
		MemberType,			
		[Description]
	FROM
		@PolicyMembers	
		
END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_SetPolicyParameter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_SetPolicyParameter]
@ParameterName NVARCHAR(50),
@ParameterValue NVARCHAR(2000)

AS

BEGIN

	--Atualiza o PolicyParameterID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 17 --PolicyParameterID
	END
	
	UPDATE
		PoliciesParameters
	SET
		ParameterValue = @ParameterValue
	WHERE	
		ParameterName = @ParameterName
		
END
GO
```

### proc_Policies_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Policies_Update]
@PolicyID INT,
@PolicyName NVARCHAR(50),
@PolicyType TINYINT,
@Enabled BIT

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE
		Policies
	SET
		PolicyName = @PolicyName,
		PolicyType = @PolicyType,
		[Enabled] = @Enabled
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	
	--Atualiza o PolicyID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 12 --PolicyID
			OR PolicyControlID = 16	--PolicyBehaviorParameterID
	END	
	
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_AccountsDomains

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_AccountsDomains]
@JustDomains BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN
 
	IF (@JustDomains = 0)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
		SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')
		
		SELECT
			AC.AccountID,
			AC.LogonName,
			ISNULL(AC.FullName, '') AS FullName,
			ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
			CASE 
				WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) 
				ELSE -1
			END  AS CostAccountID,
			dbo.AccountHasAliases(AC.AccountID) AS HasAliases,
			ISNULL(AI.ReleaserStorageQuota, -1) AS ReleaserStorageQuota,
			/*ReleaseStorageQuota: Quando o retorno é -2 a quotas está desabilitada para o usuário
			quando o retorno é -1 a cota está habilitada e usa a cota padrão.*/
			AC.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			D.DomainTypeID,
			'' AS DomainIP
			--ISNULL(DA.[Address],'') AS DomainIP
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AI.AccountID = AC.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			--LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
		WHERE
			Removed = 0
			AND	AC.AccountID IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
			) 
	
		SELECT 
			AccountGroupID, 
			AccountID
		FROM 
			AccountsGroupsObjects
	END
	ELSE
	IF (@JustDomains = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			D.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			D.DomainTypeID,
			'' AS DomainIP
			--ISNULL(DA.[Address], '') AS DomainIP
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AC.AccountID = AI.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			--LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
		WHERE
			Removed = 0
			AND	AC.AccountID IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
			)
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_CostAccountsSelectable

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_CostAccountsSelectable]

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Edit date: 17/10/2013
	-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
	-- Description: Foi encontrado um problema relacionado aos CostAccountsSelectables
	--				onde um usuário poderia referenciar um CostAccountId que não seria retornado na chamada desta procedure,
	--				e então um erro seria gerado, para contornar este problema foi adicionado um select adicional buscando
	--				os CostAccountsIds que são referenciados pelos usuários.
	--
	-- Edit date: 12/09/2019
	-- Edit author: Anderson Tabaldi
	-- Description: Alterado para buscar as contas selecionáveis da tabela CostAcountsSelectable e CostAccountsSelectableObject
	--
	-- Edit date: 03/12/2019
	-- Edit author: Rodrigo Scopel
	-- Description: Aplicado DISTINCT para remover duplicidades do JOIN

	DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	SELECT DISTINCT
		-2 AS DomainID,
		'-' AS DomainName,
		-2 AS AccountID,
		'-' AS LogonName,
		CA.CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		CostAccountsSelectable CAS
		INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
		INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = CAS.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		CASO.IsAllSelectable = 1
		
	UNION ALL
		
	SELECT DISTINCT
		D.DomainID,
		D.DomainName,
		AC.AccountID,
		AC.LogonName,
		CA.CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				Accounts AC
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.AccountID = AC.AccountID AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 1
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectable CAS ON CAS.CostAccountSelectableID = CASO.CostAccountSelectableID
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0
				
			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				CostAccountsSelectable CAS
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.CostAccountID = CASO.CostAccountID AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 2 AND CASO.FilterByChildren = 0
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0
				
			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.DomainID,
				CAS.CostAccountID
			FROM
				CostAccountsSelectable CAS
				INNER JOIN CostAccountsSelectableObjects CASO ON CASO.CostAccountSelectableID = CAS.CostAccountSelectableID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT * FROM dbo.getCostAccountChildrenTable(CASO.CostAccountID)) AND CASO.ObjectAllowedType = 2 AND CASO.FilterByChildren = 1
			WHERE
				AC.Removed = 0	
							
		) AS TB
			 INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = TB.AccountID
			 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			 LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = TB.CostAccountID
	
	UNION ALL
	
	--Workaround--
	-- Os '-3' e '-' foram adicionados apenas para que fosse possível executar um union com os demais selects,
	-- as informações relevantes para esse select abaixo são apenas: CostAccountID, CostAccountName, CostAccountCode
	SELECT DISTINCT
		-3 AS DomainID,
		'-' AS DomainName,
		-3 AS AccountID,
		'-' AS LogonName,
	
	CASE 
		WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(AC.CostAccountID, -1) 
		ELSE -1
		END  AS CostAccountID,
		CA.CostAccountName,
		CA.CostAccountCode
	FROM
		Accounts AC 
		INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON AC.CostAccountID = CA.CostAccountID
	WHERE	
		AC.Removed = 0
		AND	AC.AccountID IN
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
		)
	ORDER BY
		AccountID 
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_Groups

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_Groups]
@IsAccountsGroups BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@IsAccountsGroups = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			PDG.CostGroupID,
			PDG.CostGroupName,
			'-1' AS PaperSizeID,
			PDG.CostMono,
			PDG.CostColor,
			PDG.CostDuplexMono,
			PDG.CostDuplexColor,
			PDG.CostScan,
			PDG.CostSentFax,
			PDG.IsDefault
		FROM
			CostGroups PDG
			
		UNION 
		
		SELECT 
			PDGPS.CostGroupID,
			PDG.CostGroupName,
			PDGPS.PaperSizeID,
			PDGPS.CostMono,
			PDGPS.CostColor,
			PDGPS.CostDuplexMono,
			PDGPS.CostDuplexColor,
			0,0,
			PDG.IsDefault
		FROM
			PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize PDGPS
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PDG ON PDG.CostGroupID = PDGPS.CostGroupID
	END
	ELSE
	IF (@IsAccountsGroups = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			AG.AccountGroupID,
			AG.AccountGroupName,
			AG.DomainID
		FROM
			Accounts AC
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AGO ON AGO.AccountID = AC.AccountID
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroups AG ON AG.AccountGroupID = AGO.AccountGroupID
		WHERE
			AC.Removed = 0
			AND	AC.AccountID IN
			(
				SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
			)
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_Machines

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_Machines]

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @TBMachines TABLE
		(
			MachineID INT,
			StrongName NVARCHAR(32),
			MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
			IP1 NVARCHAR(55),
			IP2 NVARCHAR(55),
			ID INT IDENTITY
		)
		
	DECLARE @TBMachinesTemp TABLE
		(	
			MachineID INT,
			StrongName NVARCHAR(36),
			MachineName NVARCHAR(50),
			IP1 NVARCHAR(55),
			IP2 NVARCHAR(55)
		)
		
	DECLARE @MachineID INT
	DECLARE @IP1 NVARCHAR(55)
	DECLARE @IP2 NVARCHAR(55)

	INSERT INTO
		@TBMachines
	SELECT DISTINCT
		M.MachineID,
		M.StrongName,
		M.MachineName,
		MNA.IP AS IP1,
		'' AS IP2
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON MNA.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1)
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)

	INSERT INTO
		@TBMachinesTemp
	SELECT 
		M.MachineID,
		M.StrongName,
		M.MachineName,
		MNA.IP AS IP1,
		'' AS IP2
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
		INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON MNA.MachineID = M.MachineID
	WHERE
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1)
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)

	WHILE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM @TBMachinesTemp) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @IP1 = ''
		SET @IP2 = ''
		
		SELECT TOP(1) @MachineID = MachineID, @IP1 = IP1 FROM @TBMachinesTemp

		SELECT 
			TOP(1) @IP2 = IP
		FROM
			MachinesNetworkAddress
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID AND IP <> @IP1

		UPDATE 
			@TBMachines
		SET
			IP2 = @IP2
		WHERE
			MachineID = @MachineID 
			AND IP1 = @IP1
		
		DELETE FROM
			@TBMachinesTemp
		WHERE 
			MachineID = @MachineID
			AND IP1 = @IP1
	END

	DELETE
		TB1 
	FROM
		@TBMachines TB1 
	WHERE
		TB1.ID NOT IN (SELECT MIN(ID) FROM @TBMachines TB2 WHERE TB2.MachineID = TB1.MachineID)

	SELECT
		MachineID,
		StrongName,
		MachineName,
		IP1,
		IP2
	FROM 
		@TBMachines
		
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_PoliciesMessages

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_PoliciesMessages]

AS

BEGIN

	-- =============================================
	-- Edit date: 15/10/2013
	-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
	-- Description: Alterando a clausula Inner Join pelo Left Join e também adicionado o Distinct, para não
	--				haver redundâncias de registros contendo -1.

	SELECT DISTINCT
		ISNULL(PM.PolicyMessageID, -1) AS PolicyMessageID,
		CASE 
			WHEN PM.UseDefaultMessage = 1 THEN ''
			WHEN PM.UseDefaultMessage = 0 THEN PM.MessageText
		END AS MessageText
	FROM
		Policies P
		LEFT JOIN PoliciesMessages PM ON PM.PolicyMessageID = P.PolicyMessageID
		
END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_PrintersDevices

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_PrintersDevices]

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressMAC,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		IsLocal,
		IsUSBPort,
		PD.CostGroupID,
		ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		CASE EnabledBillingStatus
			WHEN 0 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
			WHEN 2 THEN CAST(1 AS BIT)
			ELSE CAST(0 AS BIT)
		END AS [Disabled],
		ForceColor,
		CAST(dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS BIT) AS IsConsolidated
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
	WHERE
		PD.CostGroupID <> (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1) 
		OR PD.PrinterDeviceID IN 
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesMembers(2)
		)
		OR PD.ForceColor <> 0
		OR EnabledBillingStatus IN (0, 2)

END
GO
```

### proc_PoliciesControls_RetrieveUpdatedAccounts

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PoliciesControls_RetrieveUpdatedAccounts]
@PolicyControlAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN
  
 	--########################################################################
	-- Data: 03-06-2014;		
	-- Autor: Rafael Borges Machado;
	-- Task: #716;
	-- Descrição: retorna duas tabelas, 
	-- a primeira tabela retorna os usuários 'ATUALIZADOS'.
	-- a segunda, retorna os groups ids dos usuários que estão na primeira tabela. 
	--########################################################################

	--########################################################################
	-- Usuários atualizados.
	--########################################################################
	DECLARE @IsCostAccountSelectable NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @IsCostAccountSelectable = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	SELECT
		AC.AccountID,
		AC.LogonName,
		ISNULL(AC.FullName, '') AS FullName,
		ISNULL(AC.Email, '') AS Email,
		CASE 
			WHEN @IsCostAccountSelectable = 3 THEN ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) 
			ELSE -1
		END  AS CostAccountID,
		dbo.AccountHasAliases(AC.AccountID) AS HasAliases,
		ISNULL(AI.ReleaserStorageQuota, -1) AS ReleaserStorageQuota,
		/*ReleaseStorageQuota: Quando o retorno é -2 as quotas estão desabilitadas para o usuário
		quando o retorno é -1 a cota está habilitada e usa a cota padrão.*/
		AC.DomainID,
		D.DomainName,
		D.DomainTypeID,
		ISNULL(DA.[Address],'') AS DomainIP
	FROM
		Accounts AC
		LEFT JOIN AccountsInfo AI ON AI.AccountID = AC.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		LEFT JOIN DomainsAddresses DA ON DA.DomainID = D.DomainID			
	WHERE
		Removed = 0
		AND	AC.AccountID IN
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT ObjectID FROM dbo.getPoliciesAccountsCache()
		)
		AND AC.AccountID IN (SELECT 
									DISTINCT PCA.AccountID
								FROM 
									PoliciesControlsAccounts PCA
								WHERE 
									IsRemoved = 0 
									AND PolicyControlAccountID > @PolicyControlAccountID
									AND IsRegularCache = 1) 
		
	SELECT 
		AccountGroupID, 
		AccountID
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects
	WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT 
							DISTINCT PCA.AccountID
						FROM 
							PoliciesControlsAccounts PCA
						WHERE 
							IsRemoved = 0 
							AND PolicyControlAccountID > @PolicyControlAccountID
							AND IsRegularCache = 1)	
			
END
GO
```

### proc_PrE_PrintersDevices_Retrieve

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrE_PrintersDevices_Retrieve]
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50)= NULL,
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@PrinterModelID INT = NULL,
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(20) = NULL

AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************
	--*** Encontra uma impressora com esses dados chaves (ou ID).
	--*** Robson 18/02/2013
	--*** Adicionado a coluna FirmwareVersion no retorno.
	--*** Rafael Machado 06/10/2017
	--***********************************************************************************************

	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceIDFound INT
	
	IF (@PrinterDeviceID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Se foi passado o ID nao precisa vasculhar no banco
		SET @PrinterDeviceIDFound = @PrinterDeviceID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound = [dbo].[preGetPrinterDeviceID](@AddressName, @AddressPort, @PrinterModelID, @SerialNumber, @AddressMAC)
	END

	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		PD.AddressMAC,
		PD.PrinterModelID,
		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PM.CorrectName,
		PD.IsLocal,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.SiteID,
		PD.Location,
		PD.ForceColor,
		PD.TrustOrigin,
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
		PD.EngagedStatus,
		ISNULL(PDSC.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,0) AS PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,
		ISNULL(PDC.PrinterDeviceMainID,-1) AS PrinterDeviceMainID,
		PD.FirmwareVersion
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD		
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl PDSC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDSC.PrinterDeviceID 
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesConsolidation PDC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDC.PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
	WHERE 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceIDFound	

END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrE_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAll]

		B.BrandName,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PM.CorrectName,
		PD.IsLocal,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.SiteID,
		PD.Location,
		PD.ForceColor,
		PD.TrustOrigin,
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus,

		ISNULL(PDSC.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,0) AS PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,
```

### proc_PrE_PrintersDevices_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrE_PrintersDevices_Update]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@PrinterDeviceName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@PrinterModelID INT = NULL,
@IsLocal BIT = NULL,
@IsUSBPort BIT = NULL,
@Location NVARCHAR(255) = NULL,
@EnabledCounterStatus INT = NULL,
@FirmwareVersion NVARCHAR(255) = NULL

AS    

BEGIN

	--**********************************************************************************************
	-- Rafael Machado, 04/08/2017
	-- Adicionado @FirmwareVersion
	--**********************************************************************************************
	
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Anderson Tabaldi
	-- Update date: 12/09/2019
	-- Description:	Incluída data de alteração da impressora
	-- =============================================

	-- atualiza os campos individualmente
	DECLARE @SQL NVARCHAR(1000)

	SET @SQL  = 'UPDATE PrintersDevices SET  '
      
	IF(@PrinterDeviceName IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		--LIMPAR PrinterDeviceName
		SET @PrinterDeviceName = REPLACE (@PrinterDeviceName,'''','''''')

		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'PrinterDeviceName = ''' + @PrinterDeviceName +  ''', '  		

	END
      
	IF(@SerialNumber IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'SerialNumber = ''' + @SerialNumber +  ''', '

	IF(@AddressName IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'AddressName = ''' + @AddressName + ''', '

	IF(@AddressPort IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'AddressPort = ''' + @AddressPort + ''', '

	IF(@AddressMAC IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'AddressMAC = ''' + @AddressMAC + ''', '
            
	IF(@PrinterModelID IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'PrinterModelID = ' + CAST(@PrinterModelID AS NVARCHAR) + ', '            

	IF(@IsLocal IS NOT NULL )
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'IsLocal = ' + CAST (@IsLocal AS NVARCHAR) + ', '
            
	IF(@IsUSBPort IS NOT NULL )
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'IsUSBPort = ' + CAST (@IsUSBPort AS NVARCHAR) + ', '           

	IF(@FirmwareVersion IS NOT NULL)
		SET @SQL = @SQL + 'FirmwareVersion = ''' + @FirmwareVersion + ''', '

	IF(@Location IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
            
		--LIMPAR LOCATION
		SET @Location = REPLACE (@Location,'''','''''')
      
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'Location = ''' + @Location + ''', '
            
	END

	IF(@EnabledCounterStatus IS NOT NULL )
		SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'EnabledCounterStatus = ' + CAST (@EnabledCounterStatus AS NVARCHAR) + ', '
		
	SET @SQL  = @SQL + 'UpdatedDate = ''' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETUTCDATE(), 25) + ''', '

	IF (@SQL  = 'UPDATE PrintersDevices SET  ')
		RETURN

	SELECT @SQL = LEFT(@SQL, len(@SQL) - 1)

	SET @SQL  = @SQL + ' WHERE PrinterDeviceID = ' + CAST(@PrinterDeviceID AS NVARCHAR)
	
	EXEC(@SQL)

	--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
			AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
				PoliciesControls
		SET
				PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
				PolicyControlID = 5     --PrinterDeviceID
	END
      
END
GO
```

### proc_PrintApplications_IsInUseByAPrintPolicy

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintApplications_IsInUseByAPrintPolicy]
@PrintApplicationID INT

AS
	
BEGIN
	-- ************************************************************************************
	-- Marco, 2013-05-08
	-- Retorna se um aplicativo de impressão é usado ou não por uma política de impressão.
    -- ************************************************************************************
	
	IF ( EXISTS ( SELECT 
						PFP.PolicyFeatureParameterID 
				  FROM 
						PoliciesFeaturesParameters PFP 
				  WHERE 
						PFP.PolicyFeatureID = 2 
						AND CAST( PFP.Value AS INT)= @PrintApplicationID)
		)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
	END 
END
GO
```

### proc_PrintApplications_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintApplications_Remove]
@PrintApplicationID INT

AS

BEGIN

	UPDATE
		PrintJobs
	SET 
		PrintApplicationID = 0 
	WHERE 
		PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
		
	UPDATE
		PrintJobsCanceled
	SET 
		PrintApplicationID = 0 
	WHERE 
		PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
		
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintApplicationsRules 
	WHERE 
		PrintApplicationID =  @PrintApplicationID	
	
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintApplications 
	WHERE 
		PrintApplicationID =  @PrintApplicationID 
		
	--Atualiza o ApplicationID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 10 --ApplicationID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintApplications_Rules_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintApplications_Rules_RetrieveAll]
@PrintApplicationRuleID INT = -1,
@OrderByHits BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PrintApplicationRuleID AS PrintApplicationRuleID,
		PrintApplicationID AS PrintApplicationID,
		FindString AS FindString,
		ISNULL(BeginNameFind, 0) AS BeginNameFind,
		ISNULL(EndNameFind, 0) AS EndNameFind,
		ISNULL(FoundStringRemove, 0) AS FoundStringRemove,
		Hits AS Hits,
		RuleType AS RuleType
	FROM
		PrintApplicationsRules
	WHERE
		(@PrintApplicationRuleID = -1 OR PrintApplicationRuleID = @PrintApplicationRuleID)
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN @OrderByHits = 1 THEN Hits END DESC,
		PrintApplicationRuleID ASC
		
END
GO
```

### proc_PrintApplications_Rules_RetrieveAllFromApplication

```sql

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintApplications_Rules_RetrieveAllFromApplication]
@PrintApplicationID INT

AS

BEGIN
	
	SELECT
		PrintApplicationRuleID,
		PrintApplicationID,
		FindString,
		CASE BeginNameFind
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@Yes'
			WHEN 0 THEN '@@No'
		END AS BeginNameFind,
		CASE EndNameFind
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@Yes'
			WHEN 0 THEN '@@No'
		END AS EndNameFind,
		CASE FoundStringRemove
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@Yes'
			WHEN 0 THEN '@@No'
		END AS FoundStringRemove,
		CASE RuleType
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@No'
			WHEN 2 THEN '@@Yes'
		END AS Wildcard,
		Hits
	FROM 
		PrintApplicationsRules
	WHERE 
		PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_GroupsRules_RetrieveDevices

```sql

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_GroupsRules_RetrieveDevices]
@GroupRule NVARCHAR(100),
@PrintersDefaultGroup BIT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
	WHERE
		((PM.PrinterModelName LIKE '%' + @GroupRule + '%') OR (PM.CorrectName <> '' AND PM.CorrectName LIKE '%' + @GroupRule + '%'))
		AND
		(
			(@PrintersDefaultGroup = 1 AND CostGroupID = (SELECT CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1))
			OR
			(@PrintersDefaultGroup = 0)
		)	

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_Remove] 
@PrinterDeviceID INT 

AS

BEGIN

	-- =========================================================================================
	-- Maicon Pereira 28/05/2014
	-- Description:	Remover do banco a impressora e todos os dados relacionados à ela. 	
	-- Douglas Macedo 18/04/2019 #41 5.49
	-- Description:	Acrescentada remoção dos dados da tabela PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges. 
	-- =========================================================================================

	
	--Apaga os dados de auditoria relacionados à impressoras e que sejam da impressora a ser deletada do sistema
	DELETE FROM 
		Auditings 
	WHERE 
		AuditingActionID in(13,14,15,47,48) 
		AND ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os produtos instalados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		InstalledProducts 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de alteração de endereço ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAddressNameChanges 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados de politicas ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
	WHERE 
		ObjectID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND PolicyMemberType = 3

	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		AND PolicyMemberType = 5
				
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da PrintJObs e da tabela BureauJobs
	
	--Cria tabela auxiliar para guardar os PrintJobIDs 
	DECLARE @PrintJobIDList TABLE (PrintJobID INT)
	--Cria variavel para verificação no laço de repetição
	DECLARE @CountPrintJobIDs INTEGER 
	
	
	--Pega os 100 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobs where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Pega o total de itens na tabela
	SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	
	--Enquanto houver itens na tabela entra nesse laço de repetição
	WHILE(@CountPrintJobIDs > 0)
	BEGIN
	
		--Apaga os dados da BureauJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			BureauJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)

		--Apaga os dados da QuotasPrintJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			QuotasPrintJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			
			
		--Apaga os dados da StampLogonJobs
		DELETE FROM 
			StampLogonJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)			

		--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs	
		DELETE FROM 
			PrintJobs 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
		--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
		DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
		
		--Pega os dados dos próximos PrintJobIDs a serem excluidos
		INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobs where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		--Atualiza o valor da variavel do laço de repetição
		SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	END
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintJobsCanceled
		
	--Pega os 100 primeiros printjobids da impressora e armazena nessa tabela 			
	INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobsCanceled where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Pega o total de itens na tabela
	SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	
	--Enquanto houver itens na tabela entra nesse laço de repetição
	WHILE(@CountPrintJobIDs > 0)
	BEGIN
	
		--Apaga os dados da PrintJobs	
		DELETE FROM 
			PrintJobsCanceled 
		WHERE 
			PrintJobID IN (SELECT PrintJobID FROM @PrintJobIDList)
				
		--Limpa a tabela de PrintJobIDs				
		DELETE FROM @PrintJobIDList
		
		--Pega os dados dos próximos PrintJobIDs a serem excluidos
		INSERT INTO @PrintJobIDList 
			SELECT TOP 100 PrintJobID FROM PrintJobsCanceled where PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

		--Atualiza o valor da variavel do laço de repetição
		SELECT @CountPrintJobIDs = COUNT(1) FROM @PrintJobIDList
	END
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas de processamento ligadas a impressora
	
	--ProccessQueuesTypes
	--PrinterConsolidation = 7,
	--PrinterDeviceSetDisable = 9,
	--PrinterDeviceSetEnable = 10,
	--PrinterDeviceSite = 11,
        
	DELETE FROM 
		ProcessQueues 
	WHERE 
		ProcessQueueType IN (7,9,10,11) 
		AND ObjectQueueID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga as filas ligadas a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersQueues 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os debitos de quotas ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		QuotasDebits 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os suprimentos não monitorados ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		SuppliesUnmonitored 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	---------------------IMPRESSORAS-----------------------------------------------------
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID	

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesConsolidation
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesConsolidation 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceMainID = @PrinterDeviceID	
		OR PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesContractInfo
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesContractInfo 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID		
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela Counters
	DELETE FROM
		Counters
	WHERE
		CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersAuditing
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersAuditing 
	WHERE 
		CounterReadingID IN (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela CountersReadings
	
	DELETE FROM 
		CountersReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------					
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesCountersPlotter 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	--Cria tabelas auxiliares para armazenar IDs			
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotID INT)
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList TABLE (PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID INT)
		
	--Insere os IDs dos slots relacionados a impressora 	
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
			
	--Insere os IDs históricos dos slots relacionados a impressora 				
	INSERT INTO @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList 
		SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID FROM PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric WHERE PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
			
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoricAuditings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotHistoricID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList)
		
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSlots
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSlots 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceSlotID IN ( SELECT * FROM @PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList)
		
	--Limpa tabelas
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsIDList
		
	DELETE FROM 
		@PrinterDeviceSlotsHistoricIDList

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados de leitura de NSL ligados a impressora
	DELETE FROM 
		NSLReadings 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
		
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	--Apaga os dados da tabela PrintersDevices
	DELETE FROM 
		PrintersDevices 
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
	
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
END

GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_Retrieve

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_Retrieve]
@PrinterDeviceID INT = NULL,
@AddressName NVARCHAR(50)= NULL,
@AddressPort NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@Model NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
@SerialNumber NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@AddressMAC NVARCHAR(20) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--Força os parâmetros para ''
	IF (@AddressName IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressName = ''
	END
	
	IF (@AddressPort IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressPort = ''
	END
	
	IF (@Model IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @Model = ''
	END
	
	IF (@SerialNumber IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @SerialNumber = ''
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@SerialNumber IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 0))
		BEGIN
			SET @SerialNumber = ''
		END
	END
	
	IF (@AddressMAC IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @AddressMAC = ''
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@AddressMAC IN (SELECT InvalidData FROM InvalidPrinterKeys WHERE IsMac = 1))
		BEGIN
			SET @AddressMAC = ''
		END
	END
	
	--Força o parâmetro para -1
	IF (@PrinterDeviceID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @PrinterDeviceID = -1
	END
	
	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceIDFound INT

	SELECT @PrinterDeviceIDFound = [dbo].[GetPrinterDeviceID](@PrinterDeviceID, @AddressName, @AddressPort, @Model, @SerialNumber, @AddressMAC)

	SELECT 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
		PM.PrinterModelID,
		B.BrandName AS Brand,
		PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
		PD.IsLocal,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.SiteID,
		ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
		PD.Location,
		PD.CostGroupID,
		ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		PD.ForceColor,
		PD.TrustOrigin,
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
		PD.EngagedStatus,		
		ISNULL(PDC.PrinterDeviceMainID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceMainID,
		CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
			THEN '@@Local' 
			ELSE '@@Network' 
		END AS DeviceTypeDescription
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		LEFT JOIN PrintersDevicesConsolidation PDC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDC.PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
	WHERE 
		PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceIDFound	

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAll]
@LastDateJob SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@NetWorkPrinter BIT = NULL,
@Removed INT = 0, 
@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters BIT = 0,
@FilterType BIT = NULL -- 0 = Jobs; 1 = Contadores
 
AS

BEGIN

	IF (@LastDateJob IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		IF (@NetWorkPrinter = 1 OR @NetWorkPrinter = 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT DISTINCT
				PD.*, 
				PC.CostGroupName,
				1 AS cont,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultName,  
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultType,
				dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated  
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
				INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
			WHERE
				((@NetWorkPrinter = 1 AND PD.IsLocal = 1) OR (@NetWorkPrinter = 0 AND PD.IsLocal = 0))
				--AND (PD.Removed = 0 OR pd.Removed = @Removed)
				AND ((@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 1 AND PD.EngagedStatus IN (1, 3))
				OR (@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 0))
			ORDER BY
				PD.PrinterDeviceName ASC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
				PD.AddressName,
				PD.AddressPort,
				ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
				B.BrandName AS Brand,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				PD.IsLocal,
				PD.IsUSBPort,
				PD.SiteID,
				S.SiteName,
				ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
				ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
				PD.Location,
				PD.CostGroupID,
				PC.CostGroupName,
				ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
				PD.ForceColor,
				PD.TrustOrigin,
				PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
				PD.EngagedStatus,
				CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
					THEN '@@Local' 
					ELSE '@@Network' 
				END AS TypePrinterID,				
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultName,  
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultType,
				dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated,
				1 AS Cont
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
				INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
				LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
				INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
			WHERE
				--(PD.Removed = 0 OR pd.Removed = @Removed)
				((@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 1 AND PD.EngagedStatus IN (1, 3))
				OR (@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 0))
			ORDER BY 
				PD.PrinterDeviceName ASC
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT DISTINCT
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName,
			ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
			PD.AddressName,
			PD.AddressPort,
			ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
			B.BrandName AS Brand,
			PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
			PD.IsLocal,
			PD.IsUSBPort,
			PD.SiteID,
			S.SiteName,
			ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '-') AS SiteDivisionName,
			PD.Location,
			PD.CostGroupID,
			PC.CostGroupName,
			ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
			PD.ForceColor,
			PD.TrustOrigin,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
			PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
			PD.EngagedStatus,
			CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
				THEN '@@Local' 
				ELSE '@@Network' 
			END AS TypePrinterID,				
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultName,  
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterType2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceDefaultType,
			dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated,
			1 AS Cont
		FROM
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
			INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
			LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE
			--(PD.Removed = 0 OR PD.Removed = @Removed)
			((@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 1 AND PD.EngagedStatus IN (1, 3))
			OR (@ShowOnlyEngangedPrinters = 0))
			AND 
			(
				((@FilterType = 0 OR @FilterType IS NULL)
				AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM CubePrinter WHERE Data >= @LastDateJob))
				OR 
				((@FilterType = 1 OR @FilterType IS NULL)
				AND (PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3) AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM CountersReadings WHERE DateTimeRead >= @LastDateJob)))
			)
		ORDER BY
			PD.PrinterDeviceName ASC
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromMachine

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromMachine] 
@MachineID INT = 0,
@EnabledBillingStatus INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT DISTINCT
		* 
	FROM
		(
			--Não consolidadas
			SELECT
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
				PD.AddressName,
				PD.AddressPort,
				ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
				B.BrandName AS Brand,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				PD.IsLocal,
				CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1 THEN '@@Local' ELSE '@@Network' END AS TypePrinterID,
				PD.IsUSBPort,
				S.SiteName,
				ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '') AS SiteDivisionName,  
				PD.Location,
				PD.CostGroupID,
				PC.CostGroupName, 
				ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
				PD.ForceColor,
				PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
				dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated
			FROM 
				PrintersDevices PD
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
				INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
				INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
				LEFT OUTER JOIN Sites S on PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID
			WHERE
				(PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersQueues WHERE MachineID = @MachineID))
				AND dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0
	
			UNION

			--Consoliadas principais
			SELECT 
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
				PD.AddressName,
				PD.AddressPort,
				ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
				B.BrandName AS Brand,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				PD.IsLocal,
				CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1 THEN '@@Local' ELSE '@@Network' END AS TypePrinterID,
				PD.IsUSBPort,
				S.SiteName,
				ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '') AS SiteDivisionName,  
				PD.Location,
				PD.CostGroupID,
				PC.CostGroupName, 
				ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
				PD.ForceColor,
				PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
				dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated
			FROM
				PrintersDevices PD
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
				INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
				INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
				LEFT OUTER JOIN Sites S on PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID
			WHERE
				PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceMainID FROM PrintersDevices PD INNER JOIN PrintersDevicesConsolidation PDC ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PDC.PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID
									   WHERE (PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersQueues WHERE MachineID = @MachineID)) AND dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 1)
		) AS TB
	WHERE
		(@EnabledBillingStatus = 0 OR EnabledBillingStatus IN (0, 2))
		OR (@EnabledBillingStatus = 1 OR EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3))

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromSite

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromSite] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@EnabledBillingStatus BIT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	SELECT DISTINCT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.AddressPort,
		PD.AddressMAC,
		B.BrandName AS Brand,
		PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
		PD.IsLocal,
		CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1 THEN '@@Local' ELSE '@@Network' END AS TypePrinterID,
		PD.IsUSBPort,
		PD.SiteID, 
		S.SiteName,
		PD.Location,
		PD.CostGroupID,
		PC.CostGroupName, 
		ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
		PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
		PD.ForceColor,
		PD.TrustOrigin,
		PD.EngagedStatus
	FROM
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
		LEFT  JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
	WHERE
		PD.SiteID = @SiteID
		AND
		(
			(@EnabledBillingStatus = 0 OR PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (0, 2))
			OR (@EnabledBillingStatus = 1 OR PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3))
		)
	ORDER BY 
		PD.PrinterDevicename ASC

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromSiteLessSiteDivision

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveAllFromSiteLessSiteDivision]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@SiteDivisionID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT    
		*
	FROM        
		(	
			SELECT DISTINCT 			
				PD.PrinterDeviceID,
				PD.PrinterDeviceName,
				ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
				PD.AddressName,
				PD.AddressPort,
				B.BrandName AS Brand,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
				PD.IsLocal,
				CASE PD.IsLocal WHEN '1' THEN '@@Local' ELSE '@@Network' END AS PrinterDeviceType, 
				PD.IsUSBPort,
				PD.SiteID, 
				S.SiteName,
				PD.SiteDivisionID, 
				ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '') AS SiteDivisionName,  
				PD.Location,
				PD.CostGroupID,
				PC.CostGroupName, 
				ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
				PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
				dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS Consolidated
			FROM          
				PrintersDevices PD
				INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
				LEFT OUTER JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID
				INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
				INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
			WHERE
				PD.SiteID = @SiteID
			GROUP BY 
				PD.PrinterDeviceID, 
				PD.PrinterDeviceName, 
				PD.AddressName, 
				PD.AddressPort, 
				PD.CostGroupID,
				PC.CostGroupName,
				PD.CostAccountID,
				PD.Location, 
				B.BrandName,
				S.SiteName, 
				PD.SiteID, 
				SD.SiteDivisionName,
				PD.SiteDivisionID, 
				PD.SerialNumber, 
				PM.PrinterModelName, 
				PD.IsLocal,
				PD.IsUSBPort,
				PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
				PD.EnabledCounterStatus
		) AS P
	WHERE
		P.Consolidated = 0
		AND ((@SiteDivisionID = 0) AND P.SiteDivisionID IS NOT NULL)
		OR ((@SiteDivisionID <> 0) AND (SiteDivisionID <> @SiteDivisionID OR P.SiteDivisionID IS NULL))
		AND (P.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3))
	ORDER BY 
		P.PrinterDeviceName ASC

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveSuggestedDuplicated

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_RetrieveSuggestedDuplicated]
@MainPrinterID INT,
@IsConsolidatedBringSelf BIT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@IsConsolidatedBringSelf = 0) 
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Port NVARCHAR(50)
		DECLARE @Address NVARCHAR(50)
		DECLARE @IsLocal BIT
	
		SELECT
			@Port = AddressPort,
			@Address = AddressName,
			@IsLocal = IsLocal
		FROM
			PrintersDevices 
		WHERE
			PrinterDeviceID = @MainPrinterID 
			AND EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)

		SELECT 
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName,
			ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
			PD.AddressName,
			PD.AddressPort,
			ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
			B.BrandName AS Brand,
			PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
			PD.IsLocal,
			PD.IsUSBPort,
			PD.SiteID,
			ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
			PD.Location,
			PD.CostGroupID,
			ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
			PD.ForceColor,
			PD.TrustOrigin,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
			PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
			PD.EngagedStatus,
			CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
				THEN '@@Local' 
				ELSE '@@Network' 
			END AS DeviceTypeDescription
		FROM
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE
			((@IsLocal = 1 AND AddressPort = @Port) OR @IsLocal = 0) 
			AND (AddressName = @Address) 
			AND dbo.IsMainConsolidate(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0 
			AND dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0 
			AND (PD.PrinterDeviceID <> @MainPrinterID )
			AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 
			PD.PrinterDeviceID,
			PD.PrinterDeviceName,
			ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber,
			PD.AddressName,
			PD.AddressPort,
			ISNULL(PD.AddressMAC, '') AS AddressMAC,
			B.BrandName AS Brand,
			PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
			PD.IsLocal,
			PD.IsUSBPort,
			PD.SiteID,
			ISNULL(PD.SiteDivisionID, -1) AS SiteDivisionID,
			PD.Location,
			PD.CostGroupID,
			ISNULL(PD.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
			PD.ForceColor,
			PD.TrustOrigin,
			PD.EnabledBillingStatus,
			PD.EnabledCounterStatus,
			PD.EngagedStatus,
			CASE WHEN PD.IsLocal = 1
				THEN '@@Local' 
				ELSE '@@Network' 
			END AS DeviceTypeDescription
		FROM
			PrintersDevices PD
			INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE
			PD.PrinterDeviceID = @MainPrinterID
			AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersDevices_SetForceColor

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_SetForceColor]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@Value INT

AS	

BEGIN

	UPDATE 
		PrintersDevices 
	SET 
		ForceColor = @Value
	WHERE 
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	--Atualiza o PrinterDeviceID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 5	--PrinterDeviceID
	END
	
END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevices_SetPrinterDeviceGroup]

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

				PoliciesControls
			SET

			WHERE

		END
	
		SELECT 1		
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

	END
	
END
```

### proc_PrintersDevicesConsolidation_RetrieveAll_Grid

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersDevicesConsolidation_RetrieveAll_Grid]
@IsRetrievePrintersMain BIT

AS

BEGIN

      SELECT DISTINCT
            PD.PrinterDeviceID, 
            PD.PrinterDeviceName, 
            ISNULL(PD.SerialNumber, '') AS SerialNumber, 
            PD.AddressName, 
            PD.AddressPort, 
            PC.CostGroupName,
            B.BrandName,
            PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
            S.SiteID,
            S.SiteName,
            SD.SiteDivisionID,
            ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, '') AS SiteDivisionName, 
            ISNULL(PD.Location, '') AS Location,
            PD.IsLocal,
            dbo.[GetPrinterDeviceConsolidationBillingStatus](PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS EnabledBillingStatus
      FROM         
            PrintersDevices PD
            INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
            INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
            INNER JOIN CostGroups PC on PC.CostGroupID = PD.CostGroupID
            INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID 
            LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON PD.SiteDivisionID = SD.SiteDivisionID
      WHERE
            (
                  (@IsRetrievePrintersMain = 1 AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceMainID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))
                  OR 
                  (@IsRetrievePrintersMain = 0 AND PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation))
            )
END
GO
```

### proc_CostGroups_Remove

```sql

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostGroups_Remove] 
@CostGroupID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DELETE FROM
		PrintersDevicesGroupsPapersSize
	WHERE
		CostGroupID = @CostGroupID
		
	-- Deleta este membro das politicas de impressão
	DELETE FROM 
		PoliciesMembers 
	WHERE 
		PolicyMemberType = 4 
		AND CAST(ObjectID AS INT) = @CostGroupID
		
	DELETE FROM
		CostGroups
	WHERE
		CostGroupID = @CostGroupID
		

	--Atualiza o CostGroupID na PoliciesControls, qdo for Enterprise e tenha qualquer licença de Controle de Impressão
	IF (((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'IsProfessionalVersion') = 0)
		   AND ((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'n-ControlGeneralLic') = 1))
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 8 --CostGroupID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_CostGroups_RetrievePrinters

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_CostGroups_RetrievePrinters]
@CostGroupID INT

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PrinterModelName AS Model,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName, 
		PD.AddressName, 
		CASE PD.IsLocal 
			WHEN 1 THEN '@@Local' 
			ELSE '@@Network' 
		END AS TypePrinterID
	FROM 
		PrintersDevices PD
		INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
	WHERE 
		PD.CostGroupID = @CostGroupID 
		AND PD.EnabledBillingStatus IN (1, 3)
		AND dbo.IsConsolidated(PD.PrinterDeviceID) = 0
	GROUP BY
		PD.PrinterDeviceID,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PD.PrinterDeviceName,
		PD.AddressName,
		PD.IsLocal

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersModels_ExistsName

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersModels_ExistsName]
@BrandID INT = NULL,
@BrandName NVARCHAR(100) = NULL,
@PrinterModelName NVARCHAR(100)

AS
BEGIN

	--##########################################################################
	-- Robson, 09-09-12, nBilling 5.0
	-- Alterado para buscar também pelo nome do fabricante
	--##########################################################################
	

	IF (@BrandName IS NULL AND @BrandID IS NULL )
	BEGIN
		RAISERROR('ONE BRAND PARAMETER MUST BE INFORMED', 16, 1)
		RETURN
	END
	
	IF (LTRIM(@PrinterModelName) = '')
	BEGIN
		SET @PrinterModelName = 'Unknown'
	END	
	
	
	IF (@BrandName IS NULL)
	BEGIN
	
		---BUSCA PELO ID DO FABRICANTE
		SELECT
			ISNULL(PrinterModelID, 0)
		FROM
			PrintersModels
		WHERE
			BrandID = @BrandID
			AND PrinterModelName = @PrinterModelName
	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
	
		IF (LTRIM(@BrandName) = '')
		BEGIN
			SET @BrandName = 'Unknown'
		END		
		
		---BUSCA PELO NOME DO FABRICANTE
		SELECT
			ISNULL(PrinterModelID, 0)
		FROM
			PrintersModels PM 
			INNER JOIN Brands B ON PM.BrandID = B.BrandID
		WHERE
			PM.PrinterModelName = @PrinterModelName
			AND B.BrandName = @BrandName	
	
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_PrintersModels_RetrieveAllModels

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersModels_RetrieveAllModels]

AS
BEGIN

	--###############################################################################
	-- Diego, 12/06/2017
	-- Retorna todos os modelos cadastrados na empresa.
	--###############################################################################

	SELECT
		PM.PrinterModelID,
		PM.PrinterModelName,
		PM.BrandID,
		B.BrandName,		
		ISNULL(PM.CorrectName,'') AS CorrectName,
		ISNULL(PM.PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,0) AS PrintersModelsSlotProfileID,
		ISNULL(PM.PrinterModelKnownID,0) AS PrinterModelKnownID
	FROM
```

```sql
BEGIN

	SELECT DISTINCT
		PQ.*,
		PQT.PrinterQueueTypeName AS QueueTypeDescription,

		INNER JOIN PrinterQueueTypes PQT ON PQT.PrinterQueueTypeID = PQ.PrinterQueueTypeID

END
```

### proc_PrintersQueues_RetrieveID

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintersQueues_RetrieveID]
@ShareName NVARCHAR(255),
@MachineName NVARCHAR(50) = NULL,
@IP NVARCHAR(55) = NULL,
@Mask NVARCHAR(15) = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @PrinterDeviceID INT

	SELECT TOP 1
		--M.MachineName, 		
		@PrinterDeviceID = PQ.PrinterDeviceID
	FROM 
		PrintersQueues PQ
		INNER JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID
		INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
	WHERE
		PQ.Removed = 0
		AND PQ.ShareName = @ShareName
		AND (@MachineName IS NULL OR M.MachineName = @MachineName)
		AND (@IP IS NULL OR MNA.IP = @IP)
		AND (@Mask IS NULL OR MNA.Mask = @Mask)

	SELECT @PrinterDeviceID = ISNULL(@PrinterDeviceID, -1)
	
	IF (@PrinterDeviceID = -1)
	BEGIN
		IF (@MachineName IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@PrinterDeviceID = PQ.PrinterDeviceID
			FROM 
				PrintersQueues PQ
				INNER JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID
				INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
			WHERE
				PQ.Removed = 0
				AND PQ.ShareName = @ShareName
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueName like '\\' + @IP + '\%'
/*
			SELECT TOP 1
				@PrinterDeviceID = PQ.PrinterDeviceID
			FROM 
				PrintersQueues pq
			WHERE
				PQ.Removed = 0
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueName = '\\' + @IP + '\' + @ShareName
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueTypeID = 4
*/
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1
				@PrinterDeviceID = PQ.PrinterDeviceID
			FROM 
				PrintersQueues PQ
				INNER JOIN Machines M ON PQ.MachineID = M.MachineID
				INNER JOIN MachinesNetworkAddress MNA ON M.MachineID = MNA.MachineID
			WHERE
				PQ.Removed = 0
				AND PQ.ShareName = @ShareName
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueName like '\\' + @MachineName + '\%'
/*
			SELECT TOP 1
				@PrinterDeviceID = PQ.PrinterDeviceID
			FROM 
				PrintersQueues pq
			WHERE
				PQ.Removed = 0
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueName = '\\' + @MachineName + '\' + @ShareName
				AND PQ.PrinterQueueTypeID = 4
				*/
		END
	END
	
	SELECT ISNULL(@PrinterDeviceID, -1)	

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintJobs_ExistsJobsToDomain

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_ExistsJobsToDomain] 
@DomainID INT
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @Total INT
	DECLARE @IsRemovable INT
	SET @Total = 0
	SET @IsRemovable = 0

	--ve se por acaso não tem só o usuário com AS únicas permissões
	DECLARE @TotalAdmins INT 
	SET @TotalAdmins = 0

	SELECT 
		@TotalAdmins = COUNT(1) 
	FROM
		(
			SELECT DISTINCT
				AccountID
			FROM 
				AccountsPermissions
			WHERE 
				AccountID NOT IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
				AND PermissionAccessID = 9
				AND PermissionControlID = 2
		) AS T

	IF (@TotalAdmins = 0)
	BEGIN--quer dizer que todos os admins estão nesse dominio, então não deixa remover
		SET @IsRemovable = 1
		--SELECT 1
		--RETURN
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT  
			@Total = COUNT(1)
		FROM 
			PrintJobs PJ
			LEFT OUTER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
		WHERE
			AC.DomainID = @DomainID

		SELECT  
			@Total = @Total + COUNT(1)
		FROM 
			PrintJobsCanceled PJC
			LEFT OUTER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJC.AccountID
		WHERE
			AC.DomainID = @DomainID

		SELECT  
			@Total = @Total + COUNT(1)
		FROM 
			Auditings AD
			LEFT OUTER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = AD.AccountID
		WHERE
			AC.DomainID = @DomainID

		IF (@Total = 0)
		BEGIN			
			SET @IsRemovable = 0			
--			SELECT 0
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @IsRemovable = 1
--			SELECT 1
		END
	END

	IF @IsRemovable = 0
	BEGIN 
		DELETE FROM DomainsAddresses WHERE DomainID = @DomainID
		DELETE FROM AccountsAliases  WHERE AccountID IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
		DELETE FROM AccountsAliases  WHERE AccountIDMain IN (SELECT AccountID FROM Accounts WHERE DomainID = @DomainID)
	END

	SELECT @IsRemovable

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveBureau

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveBureau] 
@PrintJobID INT = 0

AS

BEGIN

	SELECT
		SUM(PPJ.PagesMono +  PPJ.PagesColor) AS Pages, 
		CASE PagesMono WHEN 0 THEN 'Color' ELSE 'Mono' END AS Color,
		SUM(PPJ.CostMono + PPJ.CostColor) AS Cost,
		PrintWays.PrintWayName,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName,  
		PrintQualities.PrintQualityName, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName, 
		--CostCenters.CostCenterName, 
		[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](PPJ.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
		PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName, 
		PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName, 
		Accounts.LogonName,
		Domains.DomainName,
		BureauResources.BureauResourceName,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Cost AS CostBureau,
		PPJ.DatePrinted AS [Date],
		BureauJobs.AdditionalInformation,
		BureauJobs.Notes,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Quantity
	FROM
		PrintJobs PPJ
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON (PPJ.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID)  
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON (PPJ.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID)
		INNER JOIN PrintQualities ON (PPJ.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID)
		INNER JOIN PapersSize ON (PPJ.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID)
		INNER JOIN Accounts ON (PPJ.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID)
		--LEFT JOIN CostCenters ON (PPJ.CostCenterID = CostCenters.CostCenterID)
		INNER JOIN PrintWays ON (PPJ.PrintWayID = PrintWays.PrintWayID)
		LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON (PPJ.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID)  
		LEFT JOIN Machines ON (PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID) 
		INNER JOIN Domains ON (Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID)
		LEFT JOIN BureauJobs ON (PPJ.PrintJobID = BureauJobs.PrintJobID)
		INNER JOIN BureauResourcesJobs ON (PPJ.PrintJobID = BureauResourcesJobs.PrintJobID)
		INNER JOIN BureauResources ON (BureauResourcesJobs.BureauResourceID = BureauResources.BureauResourceID)
	WHERE
		PPJ.PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	GROUP BY
		PPJ.PagesMono, 
		PPJ.CostMono, 
		PPJ.CostAccountID,
		PrintWays.PrintWayName, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintQualities.PrintQualityName,
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName, 
		--CostCenters.CostCenterName, 
		PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,
		PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,
		Accounts.LogonName,
		Domains.DomainName,
		PPJ.DatePrinted,
		BureauResources.BureauResourceName,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Cost,
		BureauJobs.AdditionalInformation,
		BureauJobs.Notes,
		BureauResourcesJobs.Quantity

END
GO
```
