### proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveToWebService

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_RetrieveToWebService]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@Summarize BIT = 0,
@FilterDateType BIT = 0 --0 = Por data da impressão 1 = Por data de inclusão

AS

BEGIN

	--#######################################################
	-- 02-06-2014 - Rafael,
	--	Procedure utilizada pelo WebService nJWS_5
	--
	-- 2021-04-01, Héber Savedra
	-- Removido o agrupamento incorreto do campo PagesMono
	--#######################################################

	--#######################################################
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--#######################################################

	DECLARE @AccountID INT
	SET @AccountID = -1
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT
	SET @CostAccountID = -1

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--#######################################################
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	--########################################################

	DECLARE @strWhereDate NVARCHAR (200)	
	DECLARE @strEndDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 
	DECLARE @strStartDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 

	SET @strStartDateTime = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) 

	SET @strEndDateTime   = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @EndDateTime)	AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) 

	IF @FilterDateType = 0
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @FilterDateType = 1
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END

	IF @Summarize = 1
	BEGIN
		EXEC ('	
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)
	
			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
						SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')
				END
			END

			SELECT
				* 
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT  
						Accounts.LogonName AS LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName AS FullName,
						[Domains].DomainName AS DomainName,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS CostAccount,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountCode , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS CostAccountCode,
						ISNULL(Machines.MachineName,''-'') AS Machine, 
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(Machines.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS MachineIP, 
						REPLACE(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS PrinterName,
						--PrintersDevices.AddressPort AS Porta_da_Impressora, 
						PrintersDevices.AddressName AS PrinterAddress,
						ISNULL(SerialNumber, ''-'') AS SerialNumber,
						CASE         
							WHEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) > 0  THEN 1 -- Mono
							ELSE 0 -- Color
						END AS IsColor,
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN 0 --Simplex
							ELSE 1 --Duplex
						END AS IsDuplex,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName AS PrintQuality,
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS PaperSize,
						JobOrigins.OriginName AS JobOrigim, 
						JobTypes.TypeName AS JobType,
						SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
						SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
						SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono) AS CostMono,
						SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor) AS CostColor
					FROM
						PrintJobs 
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
						INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
						INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
						LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
						LEFT JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
						INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
						LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
						LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
						LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND ' + @strWhereDate + '  
						(('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
						('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))
					GROUP BY 
						Accounts.LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName,
						Domains.DomainName,
						CostAccounts.CostAccountName,
						CostAccounts.CostAccountCode,
						Machines.MachineName,
						Machines.MachineID, 
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,
						PrintersDevices.AddressName,
						PrintersDevices.SerialNumber,
						PrintJobs.PrintWayID,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName,    
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName,
						JobOrigins.OriginName,
						JobTypes.TypeName) AS Details
					ORDER BY
						Details.FullName ASC
		');
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		EXEC ('	
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)

			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
						SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')
				END
			END
	
			SELECT
				* 
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT  
						Accounts.LogonName AS LogonName,
						Accounts.FullName AS FullName,
						[Domains].DomainName AS DomainName,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS CostAccount,
						ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountCode , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS CostAccountCode,
						ISNULL(Machines.MachineName,''-'') AS Machine, 
						ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(Machines.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS MachineIP, 
						REPLACE(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS Printer,
						PrintersDevices.AddressPort AS PrinterPort, 
						Brands.BrandName AS PrinterBrand,
						REPLACE(PrintersModels.PrinterModelName,'';'','','') AS PrinterModel,
						PrintersDevices.AddressName AS PrinterAddress,
						CASE WHEN PrintersDevices.IsLocal = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS PrinterType,
						ISNULL(SerialNumber, ''-'') AS SerialNumber,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,''-'') AS PrinterQueue,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Port,''-'') AS PrinterQueuePort,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.ShareName,dbo.GetString(1)) AS SharedQueue,
						ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Driver,''-'') AS Driver,
						Sites.SiteName AS [Site],
						ISNULL(SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionName, ''-'') AS Department, 
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 1 -- Mono
							ELSE 0 -- Color
						END AS IsColor,	
						CASE         
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN 0 --Simplex
							ELSE 1 --Duplex
						END AS IsDuplex,
						CASE
							WHEN PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID IS NULL THEN 0
							ELSE 1 
						END AS IsLogicalTrust,
						PrintQualities.PrintQualityName AS PrintQuality,
						PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName AS PrintApplication, 
						PrintJobs.SpoolSize AS SpoolSize,
						PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS PaperSize,
						JobOrigins.OriginName AS JobOrigin, 
						JobTypes.TypeName AS JobType,
						PrintJobs.DatePrinted AS DatePrinted,
						PrintJobs.DateInclude AS DateIncluded, 
						PrintJobs.PagesColor  AS PagesColor,
						PrintJobs.PagesMono AS PagesMono,
						PrintJobs.CostMono AS CostMono,
						PrintJobs.CostColor AS CostColor,
						PrintJobs.Title AS Title
					FROM
						PrintJobs 
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
						INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
						INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
						INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
						INNER JOIN Brands ON PrintersModels.BrandID = Brands.BrandID
						LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
						LEFT JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
						INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
						LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
						LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
						LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
						LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
						LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND ' + @strWhereDate + '  
    					(('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
						('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
						('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))
				) AS Details
			ORDER BY Details.FullName ASC
	');
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_PrintJobs_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_PrintJobs_Update]
@PrintJobID bigint,
@PrinterQueueID int = null,
@PrinterDeviceID int = null,
@AccountID int = null,
@PaperSizeID int = null,
@PrintQualityID int = null,
@JobOriginID smallint= null,
@PrintApplicationID int = null,
@PrintWayID int = null,
@PagesColor int = null,
@PagesMono int = null,
@SpoolSize float = null,
@Title NVARCHAR(150) = null,
@DatePrinted datetime = null,
@Cost money = null,
@ProjectID int = null,
@WasLastPageColor bit = 0

AS

BEGIN
	IF @ProjectID = 0
	BEGIN
		SET @ProjectID = null
	END

	IF( @AccountID is null )
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID,
			PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID,
			PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID,
			PrintQualityID = @PrintQualityID,
			JobOriginID = @JobOriginID,
			PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID,
			PrintWayID = @PrintWayID,
			PagesColor = @PagesColor,
			PagesMono = @PagesMono,
			SpoolSize = @SpoolSize, 
			CostMono  = ISNULL(dbo.TotalCostCalcMono (@PrinterDeviceID, @PrintWayID, @PaperSizeID, @PagesColor, @PagesMono, @WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID), 0),
			CostColor = ISNULL(dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceID, @PrintWayID, @PaperSizeID, @PagesColor, @PagesMono, @WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID), 0),
			DatePrinted = @DatePrinted,
			DateInclude = GETDATE(),
			CostAccountID = dbo.GetCostAccountIDWithPeriod(@AccountID, 0, '2001-1-1')
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			AccountID = @AccountID,
			Title = @Title
		WHERE
			PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
	END
	
	--DELETE FROM
	--	SAPPrintJobs
	--WHERE
	--	PrintJobID = @PrintJobID

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_DescribeAction

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_DescribeAction]

AS

BEGIN

DECLARE @ProcessQueueID INT
DECLARE @ProcessQueueType SMALLINT
DECLARE @ObjectQueueID INT
DECLARE @DateIncluded SMALLDATETIME
DECLARE @Status SMALLINT
DECLARE @ErrorDescription NVARCHAR(200)
DECLARE @LastDateUpdated DATETIME
DECLARE @LastPeriodUpdated SMALLDATETIME
DECLARE @Period NVARCHAR(1)

DECLARE @Text NVARCHAR(max)
DECLARE @DateIncludedMod SMALLDATETIME
DECLARE @CounterProcesses INT
DECLARE @CounterProcessesText NVARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @ErrorText NVARCHAR(300)

SELECT @ProcessQueueID = ProcessQueueID, @ProcessQueueType = ProcessQueueType, @ObjectQueueID = ObjectQueueID, @DateIncluded = DateIncluded,@Status = Status, @ErrorDescription = ErrorDescription, @LastDateUpdated = LastDateUpdated, @LastPeriodUpdated = LastPeriodUpdated, @Period = Period
FROM (
	SELECT *, 1 AS control FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueType IN (9,10)
	UNION 
	SELECT *, 2 AS control FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueType  in (11,13,14)
	UNION 
	SELECT *, 3 AS control  FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueType IN (1,2,4,5,6,7,8) 
) AS G
ORDER BY Control desc, DateIncluded	desc

--=====-- Converter DateIncluded em texto (dias, horas e minutos)
DECLARE @TextDateTime NVARCHAR(max)
DECLARE @Days INT
DECLARE @Hours INT
DECLARE @AbsHours INT
DECLARE @Minutes INT

SET @TextDateTime = 'há '

SELECT @Days  = DATEDIFF(mi, @DateIncluded, GetDate()) / 1440
IF (@Days >= 2)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@Days AS NVARCHAR) + ' dias '
ELSE IF (@Days = 1)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@Days AS NVARCHAR) + ' dia '

SELECT @Hours  = DATEDIFF(mi, @DateIncluded, GetDate()) / 60
SET @AbsHours = @Hours - (@Days * 24)
IF ((@Days > 0) AND (@AbsHours > 0))
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + 'e '
IF (@AbsHours >= 2)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@AbsHours AS NVARCHAR) + ' horas '
ELSE IF (@AbsHours = 1)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@AbsHours AS NVARCHAR) + ' hora '
ELSE IF (@AbsHours = 0)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime

SELECT @Minutes  = DATEDIFF(ss, @DateIncluded, GetDate()) / 60 - (@Hours * 60)
IF (((@Days > 0) OR (@AbsHours > 0)) AND (@Minutes > 0))
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + 'e '
IF (@Minutes >= 2)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@Minutes AS NVARCHAR) + ' minutos ' 
IF (@Minutes = 1)
	SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + cast(@Minutes AS NVARCHAR) + ' minuto ' 

SET @TextDateTime = @TextDateTime + 'atrás.'
--=====-- Converter DateIncluded em texto (dias, horas e minutos)

--=====--
-- Verifica o período e subtrai os dias correspondentes
IF (@Period = 'd')
BEGIN
	SET @DateIncludedMod = Dateadd(d,-1,@DateIncluded)
END
ELSE IF (@Period = 's')
BEGIN
	SET @DateIncludedMod = Dateadd(d,-7,@DateIncluded)
END
ELSE IF (@Period = 'm')
BEGIN
	SET @DateIncludedMod = Dateadd(m,-1,@DateIncluded)
END

-- Conta os processos restantes
SELECT @CounterProcesses = (COUNT(*) - 1) FROM PROCESSQUEUES
IF (@CounterProcesses > 1)
	SET @CounterProcessesText  = ' Restando ' + Cast(@CounterProcesses AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' filas para processar.'
ELSE IF (@CounterProcesses = 1)
	SET @CounterProcessesText  = ' Restando ' + Cast(@CounterProcesses AS NVARCHAR(10)) + ' fila para processar.'
ELSE 
	SET @CounterProcessesText  = ' Essa é a última fila pendente.'

-- Verifica o status e processa os texto conforme cada status
IF (@Status = 1)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = 'Aguardando o início da fila que '
	SET @TextDateTime = '. Esse processo foi incluído ' + @TextDateTime + @CounterProcessesText
END
ELSE IF (@Status = 2)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = 'Processando a fila que '
	SET @TextDateTime = '. Atualizando cubos de ' + convert(NVARCHAR(10),@DateIncludedMod,103) + ' até ' + convert(NVARCHAR(10),@DateIncluded,103) + '.' + @CounterProcessesText
END
ELSE IF (@Status = 3)
BEGIN
	SET @ErrorText = ' O erro ocorrido foi: ""' + @ErrorDescription + '""'
	SET @TextDateTime = '. Esse processo foi incluído ' + @TextDateTime + @CounterProcessesText + @ErrorText
END

-- Dados da impressora
DECLARE @PrinterText NVARCHAR(1000)
IF (@ProcessQueueType >= 6)
BEGIN
  	SELECT @PrinterText = PrinterDeviceName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectQueueID
	SELECT @PrinterText = @PrinterText + '- ' + AddressName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectQueueID
END
--=====--

-- ApplicationRules
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 1)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'está atualizando a regra de aplicativo: ""'

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que está atualizaria a regra de aplicativo: ""'
	END	

	SELECT @Text = @Text + FindString FROM PrintApplicationsRules WHERE PrintApplicationID = @ObjectQueueID
	SELECT @text = @text + '""'

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

---- CostValue
--IF (@ProcessQueueType = 2)
--BEGIN
--	SET @Text = @Text + 'atualiza o valor dos jobs do custo: '

--	IF (@Status = 3)
--	BEGIN
--		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que atualizaria o valor dos jobs do custo: '
--	END	

--	SELECT @Text = @Text + PrintCostName FROM PrintCosts WHERE PrintCostID = @ObjectQueueID

--	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
--END

---- CostCenterAccount
--IF (@ProcessQueueType = 4)
--BEGIN
--	SELECT @Text = @Text + 'move os jobs do usuário: ' + a.FullName, @Text = @Text + ' para o centro de custo: ' + cc.CostCenterName FROM CostCenters cc INNER JOIN Accounts a ON cc.CostCenterID = a.CostCenterID WHERE a.AccountID = @ObjectQueueID

--	IF (@Status = 3)
--	BEGIN
--		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que moveria os jobs do usuário: ' + a.FullName, @Text = @Text + ' para o centro de custo: ' + cc.CostCenterName FROM CostCenters cc INNER JOIN Accounts a ON cc.CostCenterID = a.CostCenterID WHERE a.AccountID = @ObjectQueueID
--	END	

--	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
--END

-- CostCenterAccountHistoric
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 5)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'atualiza o histórico dos centros de custos do usuário: '

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que atualizaria o histórico dos centros de custos do usuário: '
	END

	SELECT @Text = @Text + FullName FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @ObjectQueueID
	
	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

---- PrinterCost
--IF (@ProcessQueueType = 6)
--BEGIN
--	SET @Text = @Text + 'está atualizando o valor dos jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText

--	IF (@Status = 3)
--	BEGIN
--		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que estaria atualizando o valor dos jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText
--	END

--	SELECT @text = @text + ' para o custo: ' + PC.PrintCostName FROM PrintersDevices PD INNER JOIN PrintCosts PC ON PD.PrintCostID = PC.PrintCostID WHERE PD.PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectQueueID
	
--	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
--END

-- PrinterConsolidation
DECLARE @PrinterMainID INT
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 7)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'consolida a impressora: ' + @PrinterText

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que consolidaria a impressora: ' + @PrinterText
	END

	SELECT @PrinterMainID = PrinterDeviceMainID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation WHERE PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @ObjectQueueID
	SELECT @text = @text + ' para a impressora: ' + PrinterDeviceName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterMainID
	SELECT @text = @text + '- ' + AddressName FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterMainID + ' '

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- ForcePrintColor
DECLARE @ForcedColor INT
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 8)
BEGIN
	SELECT @ForcedColor = ForceColor FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectQueueID

	IF (@ForcedColor = 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = @Text + 'seta com AS cores normais '
		IF (@Status = 3)
		BEGIN
			SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que setaria com AS cores normais '
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@ForcedColor = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = @Text + 'força para a cor: mono '
		IF (@Status = 3)
		BEGIN
			SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que forçaria para a cor: mono '
		END
	END
	ELSE IF (@ForcedColor = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = @Text + 'força para a cor: color '
		IF (@Status = 3)
		BEGIN
			SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que forçaria para a cor: color '
		END
	END

	SET @Text = @Text + 'os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- PrinterDeviceSetDisable
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 9)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'desabilita os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que desabilitaria os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText
	END

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

IF (@ProcessQueueType = 10)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'habilita os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que habilitaria os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText
	END

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- PrinterDeviceSite
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 11)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'atualiza os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SET @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que atualizaria os jobs da impressora: ' + @PrinterText
	END

	SELECT @text = @text + ' para o site: ' + S.SiteName FROM PrintersDevices PD INNER JOIN Sites S ON PD.SiteID = S.SiteID WHERE PD.PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectQueueID
	
	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- Projetos
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 12)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'atualiza o projeto do job: '

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que atualizaria o projeto do job: '
	END	

	SELECT @Text = @Text + cast(@ObjectQueueID AS NVARCHAR)

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- WorkTime
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 13)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'atualiza o horário de trabalho'

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que atualizaria o horário de trabalho.'
	END	

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

-- AliasesSync
IF (@ProcessQueueType = 14)
BEGIN
	SET @Text = @Text + 'sincroniza os aliases'

	IF (@Status = 3)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @Text = 'Ocorreu um erro na fila que sincronizaria os aliases.'
	END	

	SET @Text = @Text + @TextDateTime
END

SELECT @Text AS DescribeAction--, @ProcessQueueID AS Processo

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_IncrementPolicyMemberCaches

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_IncrementPolicyMemberCaches]
@ProcessQueueID INT,
@PolicyID INT
AS
BEGIN
	--Se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

	-- Incrementa o cache para os membros de uma política, de acordo com o tipo dos membros.
	UPDATE
		PoliciesControls
	SET
		PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
	WHERE
		PolicyControlID = 14 --PolicyMemberID

	-- Se é para todos os membros, não precisa incrementar os outros caches
	IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM PoliciesMembers WHERE PolicyID = @PolicyID AND PolicyMemberID = -2))
	BEGIN
		RETURN
	END

	-- Utilizado para atualizar o cache ao alterar os membros de uma política ou ao criar uma nova política. 
	DECLARE @AnyAccount BIT = 0
	SELECT 
		@AnyAccount = 1
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	AND
		(PolicyMemberType = 1 --Usuário
	OR
		PolicyMemberType = 2 --Grupo de usuário
	OR
		PolicyMemberType = 5) --Usuário na impressora

	DECLARE @AnyPrinter BIT = 0
	SELECT
		@AnyPrinter = 1
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	AND
		(PolicyMemberType = 3 --Impressora
	OR
		PolicyMemberType = 4 --Grupo de impressora
	OR 
		PolicyMemberType = 5) --Usuário na impressora

	IF(@AnyAccount = 1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 1 --AccountId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 2 --DomainId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 4 --AccountGroupId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 18 --AccountAliaseId
	END

	IF(@AnyPrinter = 1)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			PoliciesControls
		SET
			PolicyControlNumber = PolicyControlNumber + 1
		WHERE
			PolicyControlID = 5 --PrinterDeviceId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 6 --PrinterQueueId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 7 --MachineId
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 8 --CostGroupID
		OR
			PolicyControlID = 19 --PrinterDeviceConsolidationId
	END

	DECLARE @PolicyMembers TABLE(UserId INT)
	INSERT INTO
		@PolicyMembers
	SELECT
		ObjectID
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	AND
		(PolicyMemberType = 1
	OR
		PolicyMemberType = 5)

	--Apaga caches desnecessários
	DELETE
		PoliciesControlsAccounts
	WHERE
		IsRemoved = 0
	AND
		IsRemovedCache = 1
	AND 
		AccountID IN (SELECT UserId FROM @PolicyMembers)

	--Apaga caches duplicados
	DELETE
		PoliciesControlsAccounts
	WHERE
		IsRegularCache = 1
	AND
		IsCredentialCache = 0
	AND
		IsRemovedCache = 0
	AND 
		AccountID IN (SELECT UserId FROM @PolicyMembers)

	--Incrementa o controle de cache de usuários afetados na política
	INSERT INTO
		PoliciesControlsAccounts (AccountID, IsRegularCache, IsCredentialCache, IsRemovedCache, IsRemoved)
	SELECT
		ObjectId,
		1,
		0,
		0,
		0
	FROM 
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE
		PolicyID = @PolicyID
	AND
		(PolicyMemberType = 1
	OR
		PolicyMemberType = 5)

	DECLARE @UserGroups TABLE(UserGroupId INT)
	INSERT INTO
		@UserGroups
	SELECT
		ObjectId
	FROM
		PoliciesMembers
	WHERE 
		PolicyID = @PolicyID

	WHILE(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @UserGroups))
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @UserGroupId INT
		SELECT TOP 1 @UserGroupId = UserGroupId FROM @UserGroups

		EXEC proc_360_PoliciesControlsAccounts_CreateByUserGroupID @UserGroupId, 1
		
		DELETE TOP (1) FROM @UserGroups
	END
	
	DELETE FROM
		ProcessQueues
	WHERE
		ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID  
END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_MultipleInsert

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_MultipleInsert]
@DomainID INT = NULL,
@AccountGroupID INT = NULL,
@ObjectQueueField INT,
@QueueType INT

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@QueueType <> 7)
	BEGIN
		--Só é possível ter uma fila de atualização para todos
		--menos a consolidação da impressora
		DELETE FROM
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE 
			ProcessQueueType = @QueueType 
			AND ObjectQueueID = COALESCE(@DomainID, @AccountGroupID)
	END

	DECLARE @Period CHAR
	SET @Period = dbo.GetProcessQueuePeriod(GETDATE(), @QueueType, COALESCE(@DomainID, @AccountGroupID))

	IF (@Period = 'n')
	BEGIN
		RETURN 0
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@DomainID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID,
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			SELECT 
				@QueueType,
				Ac.AccountID,
				@ObjectQueueField,
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				'',
				GETDATE(),
				NULL,
				@Period
			FROM 
				Accounts AS AC
				INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AS AGO ON AGO.AccountID = AC.AccountID 
			WHERE 
				AGO.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
				AND AC.Removed = 0 
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AC.AccountID) = 1
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				ProcessQueues
				(
					ProcessQueueType, 
					ObjectQueueID, 
					ObjectQueueField,
					DateIncluded, 
					[Status], 
					ErrorDescription,
					LastDateUpdated,
					LastPeriodUpdated,
					Period
				)	
			SELECT 
				@QueueType,
				AccountID,
				@ObjectQueueField,
				GETDATE(),
				1,
				'',
				GETDATE(),
				NULL,
				@Period
			FROM 
				Accounts
			WHERE
				DomainID = @DomainID
				AND Removed = 0
				AND dbo.IsMainAliaseOrNotInAliase(AccountID) = 1
		END
	END
	
	SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY()
	
END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_Retrieve

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_Retrieve] 
@ProcessQueueID INT = NULL,
@ProcessQueueObjectType INT = NULL,
@ObjectID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	IF (@ProcessQueueID IS NOT NULL) 
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			ProcessQueueID,
			ProcessQueueType,
			ObjectQueueID,
			ObjectQueueField,
			DateIncluded,
			[Status],
			ErrorDescription,
			LastDateUpdated,
			LastPeriodUpdated,
			Period
		FROM 
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE 
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1 
			ProcessQueueID,
			ProcessQueueType,
			ObjectQueueID,
			ObjectQueueField,
			DateIncluded,
			[Status],
			ErrorDescription,
			LastDateUpdated,
			LastPeriodUpdated,
			Period
		FROM 
			ProcessQueues 
		WHERE
			((@ProcessQueueObjectType = 1 AND ProcessQueueType IN (7, 8, 9, 6, 11, 10))	-- Impressora: Consolidação, forçar cor, desabilitar, custo e site
			OR (@ProcessQueueObjectType = 2 AND ProcessQueueType IN (4, 5, 16, 17))		-- Usuário: Conta, histórico de conta, códigos PIN e requisição de senha
			OR (@ProcessQueueObjectType = 3 AND ProcessQueueType = 2)					-- Grupos de impressoras: Custo
			OR (@ProcessQueueObjectType = 4 AND ProcessQueueType = 1)					-- Aplicativos: Regras
			OR (@ProcessQueueObjectType = 5 AND ProcessQueueType = 15))					-- Conta: Configuração de conta
			AND ObjectQueueID = @ObjectID 
		ORDER BY 
			ProcessQueueID ASC 
	END

END
GO
```

```sql
AS

BEGIN

	SELECT TOP 1
		ProcessQueueID,
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetAccountAliases

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetAccountAliases]
@AccountID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS
BEGIN

	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
		RETURN 

	DECLARE @AccountIDMain INT

	SELECT
		@AccountIDMain = AccountIDMain
	FROM
		AccountsAliases
	WHERE
		AccountID = @AccountID

	IF (@AccountIDMain IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE
			PrintJobs
		SET
			AccountID = @AccountIDMain
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID AND
			(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
			( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
			( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

		UPDATE
			PrintJobsCanceled
		SET
			AccountID = @AccountIDMain
		WHERE
			AccountID = @AccountID AND
			(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
			( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
			( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountHistoricObject

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountHistoricObject]
@ObjectID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS
BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

	DECLARE @Table TABLE (Query NVARCHAR(max), StartDate DATETIME)
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	IF(@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE CostAccountsHistorics SET StartDate = '2001-01-02' WHERE StartDate <= '2001-01-01' AND  ObjectID = @ObjectID

		IF (@StartDate IS NULL) --indica que são todos os jobs de uma data pra frente
		BEGIN
			--pega tanto o ultimo historico antes dessa data quanto os possíveis históricos depois da data final
			INSERT INTO
				@Table 
			SELECT  
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND PrinterDeviceID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' + 
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL)' +
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM
			(
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate >= @EndDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
					
				UNION
				
				SELECT ObjectID, CostAccountID, StartDate FROM 
				(
					SELECT TOP 1 * FROM 
					(
						SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate--força ter o primeiro registro com NULL
							UNION
						SELECT * FROM(SELECT TOP 1 ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @EndDate  AND ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate DESC) AS T
					) AS O ORDER BY StartDate DESC
				) AS R
			) AS T
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate
		END
		ELSE IF (@EndDate IS NULL) --indica que são todos os jobs de uma data pra tras
		BEGIN
			-- pega todos os históricos anteriores a primeira data inicial + um registro forçado de costcenter = NULL por primeiro
			INSERT INTO
				@Table
			SELECT 
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND PrinterDeviceID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted <  ''' + CAST(YEAR(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL)' +
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM 
			(
				SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate 
					
				UNION 
				
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR), StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
			) AS D
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate		
		END
		ELSE --existe um intervalo
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@Table 
			SELECT  
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND DatePrinted < ''' + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND PrinterDeviceID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL)' + 
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM
			(
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @EndDate AND StartDate >= @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
					
				UNION 
				
				SELECT ObjectID, CostAccountID, StartDate FROM 
				(
					SELECT TOP 1 * FROM 
					(
						SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate--força ter o primeiro registro com NULL
							UNION
						SELECT * FROM(SELECT TOP 1 ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate < @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate DESC) AS T
					) AS O ORDER BY StartDate DESC
				) AS R
			) AS T
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		UPDATE CostAccountsHistorics SET StartDate = '2001-01-02' WHERE StartDate <= '2001-01-01' AND ObjectID = @ObjectID 

		IF (@StartDate IS NULL) --indica que são todos os jobs de uma data pra frente
		BEGIN
			--pega tanto o ultimo historico antes dessa data quanto os possíveis históricos depois da data final
			INSERT INTO
				@Table 
			SELECT  
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND AccountID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' + 
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL) ' +
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM
			(
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate >= @EndDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
					
				UNION 
				
				SELECT ObjectID, CostAccountID, StartDate FROM 
				(
					SELECT TOP 1 * FROM 
					(
						SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate--força ter o primeiro registro com NULL
							UNION
						SELECT * FROM(SELECT TOP 1 ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @EndDate  AND ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate DESC) AS T
					) AS O ORDER BY StartDate DESC
				) AS R
			)AS T
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate
		END
		ELSE IF (@EndDate IS NULL) --indica que são todos os jobs de uma data pra tras
		BEGIN
			-- pega todos os históricos anteriores a primeira data inicial + um registro forçado de costcenter = NULL por primeiro
			INSERT INTO
				@Table
			SELECT 
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND AccountID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted <  ''' + CAST(YEAR(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@startDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL)' +
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM 
			(
				SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate 
					UNION 
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR), StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
			) AS D
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate		
		END
		ELSE --existe um intervalo
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@Table 
			SELECT  
				'UPDATE PrintJobs SET CostAccountID = ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' WHERE DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND DatePrinted < ''' + CAST(YEAR(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND AccountID = ' + CAST(ObjectID AS NVARCHAR) + 
				' AND DatePrinted >= ''' + CAST(YEAR(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@StartDate) AS NVARCHAR) + '''' +
				' AND (CostAccountID <> ' + CAST(CostAccountID AS NVARCHAR)  + ' OR CostAccountID IS NULL)' +
				' AND IsCorporative = 1' --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
				, StartDate
			FROM
			(
				SELECT ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate <= @EndDate AND StartDate >= @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID
				
				UNION 
				
				SELECT ObjectID, CostAccountID, StartDate FROM 
				(
					SELECT TOP 1 * FROM 
					(
						SELECT @ObjectID AS ObjectID, '-1' AS CostAccountID , '2001-01-01' AS StartDate--força ter o primeiro registro com NULL
							UNION
						SELECT * FROM(SELECT TOP 1 ObjectID, CAST(ISNULL(CostAccountID,-1) AS NVARCHAR) AS CostAccountID, StartDate FROM CostAccountsHistorics WHERE StartDate < @StartDate AND ObjectID = @ObjectID ORDER BY StartDate DESC) AS T
					) AS O ORDER BY StartDate DESC
				) AS R
			) AS T
			ORDER BY 
				StartDate
		END
	END
	
	DELETE FROM @Table WHERE Query IS NULL

	--executa AS queries que encontrou
	WHILE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM @Table) <> 0
	BEGIN 
		DECLARE @Query NVARCHAR(max)
		DECLARE @QueryPJ NVARCHAR(max)
		DECLARE @QueryPJC NVARCHAR(max)

		SELECT @Query = (SELECT TOP 1 Query FROM @TABLE ORDER BY StartDate) --pega a primeira query

		SELECT @QueryPJ = REPLACE (@Query,'CostAccountID <> -1','CostAccountID IS NOT NULL')
		SELECT @QueryPJ = REPLACE (@QueryPJ,'CostAccountID = -1','CostAccountID = NULL')
		SELECT @QueryPJC = REPLACE (@QueryPJ,'PrintJobs','PrintJobsCanceled')

		--print @QueryPJ
		--print @QueryPJC
		
		EXEC (@QueryPJ) --executa a query da PrintJobs
		EXEC (@QueryPJC) --executa a query da PrintJobsCancelled

		DELETE FROM @Table WHERE Query = @Query
	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			[Status] = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountJobsUpdate

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountJobsUpdate]
@CostAccountJobUpdateID INT,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @PrintJobID INT
	DECLARE @NewCostAccountID BIGINT
	
	SELECT
		@PrintJobID = PrintJobID,
		@NewCostAccountID =  NewCostAccountID
	FROM
		CostAccountsJobsUpdate
	WHERE
		CostAccountJobUpdateID = @CostAccountJobUpdateID

	UPDATE
		PrintJobs
	SET
		CostAccountID = @NewCostAccountID
	WHERE
		PrintJobID = @PrintJobID
		AND IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados

	DELETE FROM
		CostAccountsJobsUpdate
	WHERE
		CostAccountJobUpdateID = @CostAccountJobUpdateID

	DELETE FROM
		ProcessQueues 
	WHERE
		ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountObject

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountObject]
@ObjectID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
		RETURN 

	DECLARE @CostAccountsType INT --1: Usuários, 2: Impressoras e 3: Contas selecionáveis
	SELECT @CostAccountsType = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType'
	
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT	
	
	IF(@CostAccountsType = 2)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			@CostAccountID = CostAccountID
		FROM
			PrintersDevices
		WHERE
			PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID

		IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

			UPDATE
				PrintJobsCanceled
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL) AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
				AND IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados

			UPDATE
				PrintJobsCanceled
			SET
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL) AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
				AND IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
		END	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN 
		SELECT
			@CostAccountID = CostAccountID
		FROM
			Accounts
		WHERE
			AccountID = @ObjectID

		IF (@CostAccountID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

			UPDATE
				PrintJobsCanceled
			SET
				CostAccountID = NULL
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ObjectID AND CostAccountID IS NOT NULL AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL) AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
				AND IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados

			UPDATE
				PrintJobsCanceled
			SET
				CostAccountID = @CostAccountID
			WHERE
				AccountID = @ObjectID AND (CostAccountID <> @CostAccountID OR CostAccountID IS NULL) AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
				AND IsCorporative = 1 --Somente os trabalhos corporativos podem ser alterados
		END	
	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountType

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetCostAccountType]
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN
	--Se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID)
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

    IF EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueType = 21)
    BEGIN
        RAISERROR('There is an object in queue that needs to be executed before. ProcessType 21', 17, 1)
    END

	UPDATE
		PrintJobs
	SET
		CostAccountID = NULL
	WHERE
		(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
		( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
		( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
	
	UPDATE
		PrintJobsCanceled
	SET
		CostAccountID = NULL
	WHERE
		(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
		( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
		( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
	
	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			[Status] = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
		Update PrintersDevicesConfigurations set CostAccountID=null
        DELETE FROM CostAccounts
    END
END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrintApplication

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrintApplication]
@PrintApplicationRuleID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @PrintApplicationID INT
	DECLARE @FindString NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @BeginNameFind BIT
	DECLARE @EndNameFind BIT
	DECLARE @FoundStringRemove BIT
	DECLARE @RuleType TINYINT

	SET @PrintApplicationID  = -1

	SELECT
		@PrintApplicationID = ISNULL(PA.PrintApplicationID, -1),
		@FindString = ISNULL(PAR.FindString, ''),
		@BeginNameFind = ISNULL(PAR.BeginNameFind, 0),
		@EndNameFind = ISNULL(PAR.EndNameFind, 0),
		@FoundStringRemove = ISNULL(PAR.FoundStringRemove, 0),
		@RuleType = ISNULL(PAR.RuleType, 1)
	FROM
		PrintApplicationsRules PAR 
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PAR.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
	WHERE
		PAR.PrintApplicationRuleID = @PrintApplicationRuleID

	IF (@PrintApplicationID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		IF (@RuleType = 1) --Tipo tradicional
		BEGIN
			--prevendo alterações forçadas de banco, caso o registro não exista mais já cai fora
			IF(@BeginNameFind = 1)
			BEGIN 
				IF(@FoundStringRemove = 1)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE
						PrintJobs
					SET
						Title = RIGHT(Title, LEN(Title) - LEN(@FindString)),
						PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
					WHERE
						 LEFT(Title,LEN(@FindString)) = @FindString 
						 AND PrintApplicationID <> @PrintApplicationID 
						 AND (
								((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
								OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
								OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate))
							 )
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE
						PrintJobs
					SET
						PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
					WHERE
						 LEFT(Title,LEN(@FindString)) = @FindString 
						 AND PrintApplicationID <> @PrintApplicationID 
						 AND (
								((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
								OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
								OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate))
							 )
				END
			END

			IF(@EndNameFind = 1)
			BEGIN 
				IF(@FoundStringRemove = 1)
				BEGIN
					UPDATE
						PrintJobs
					SET
						Title = LEFT(Title, LEN(Title) - LEN(@FindString)),
						PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
					WHERE
						 RIGHT(Title,LEN(@FindString)) = @FindString 
						 AND PrintApplicationID <> @PrintApplicationID 
						 AND (
								((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
								OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
								OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate))
							 )
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE
						PrintJobs
					SET
						PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
					WHERE
						 RIGHT(Title,LEN(@FindString)) = @FindString 
						 AND PrintApplicationID <> @PrintApplicationID 
						 AND (
								((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
								OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
								OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate))
							 )
				END
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN --Tipo coringa
			SET @FindString = REPLACE(@FindString, '*', '%')
			SET @FindString = REPLACE(@FindString, '?', '_')
		
			UPDATE
				PrintJobs
			SET
				PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID
			WHERE
				Title LIKE @FindString 
				AND PrintApplicationID <> @PrintApplicationID 
				AND (
						((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate))
						OR (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND (DatePrinted < @EndDate))
						OR ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate))
					)
		END
	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrintCost

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrintCost]
@CostGroupID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN
	END

	DECLARE @Aux INT
	SELECT @Aux = CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE CostGroupID = @CostGroupID

	IF (@Aux IS NOT NULL) --teste pra ver se existe 
	BEGIN 

		UPDATE 
			PrintJobs 
		SET 
			CostMono  = dbo.TotalCostCalcMono (PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID),
			CostColor = dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID)
		WHERE
			JobOriginID <> 7 AND PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE CostGroupID = @CostGroupID) AND
			(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
			( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
			( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

	END 

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		
		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = ISNULL(@EndDate,'2005-12-31')
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceConsolidation

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceConsolidation]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS
BEGIN

      --*******************************************************************************************************
      --** Robson, 01/03/2013
      --** Revisto para a versão 5.0
	  --** Rafael Machado 10/09/2015
	  --** Removendo os trechos onde registros eram removidos das finadas tabelas CubeCounterGeneral e CubeCounter.
      --** Diego Antunes, 01/02/2016
      --** Alterado para na consolidação somente desabilitar os históricos e não remover slots e outros dados,
      --** pois ao desconsolidar a impressora e reabilitar sua monitoração estava duplicando os slots.
	  --** Diego Antunes, 30/03/2017
	  --** Correção para remover os CountersAuditing caso existam para permitir a remoção dos CountersReadings.
      --*******************************************************************************************************

      DECLARE @PrinterDeviceMainID INT  = -1   
      DECLARE @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID INT 

      --Busca o ID da impressora principal
      SELECT 
            @PrinterDeviceMainID = PrinterDeviceMainID
      FROM
            PrintersDevicesConsolidation
      WHERE
            PrinterDeviceConsolidatedID = @PrinterDeviceID

      --Busca o site da impressora principal
      SELECT @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID = SiteID FROM PrintersDevices WHERE PrinterDeviceID =  @PrinterDeviceMainID

      IF (@PrinterDeviceMainID <> -1)
      BEGIN
            IF (@StartDate IS NULL) --os contadores e suprimentos atualiza só na primeira rodada
            BEGIN

					DELETE FROM
						Counters
					WHERE
						CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)

					DELETE FROM
						CountersAuditing
					WHERE
						CounterReadingID in (SELECT CounterReadingID FROM CountersReadings WHERE PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID)
		
					DELETE FROM 
						CountersReadings 
					WHERE 
						PrinterDeviceid = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  --""suprimentos""
                  --Diego Antunes 01/02/2016 - Alterado para na consolidação somente desabilitar os históricos e não remover slots e outros dados,
                  --pois ao desconsolidar a impressora e reabilitar sua monitoração estava duplicando os slots.
                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  
                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
                  UPDATE
                        PrintersDevicesSlotsHistoric
                  SET
                        Invalid = 1             
                  WHERE
                        PrinterDeviceSlotID IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceSlotID FROM PrintersDevicesSlots WHERE PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
                  
                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSlots
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    SuppliesUnmonitored
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --DELETE FROM
                  --    PrintersDevicesSuppliesControl
                  --WHERE
                  --    PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

                  --****************************************************************************************************************************
                  
                  --Troca para o grupo padrão a impressora escrava e  Tira a impressora do contrato, forçando como se fosse o usuário
                  DECLARE @PrinterGroupID INT
                  SELECT @PrinterGroupID = CostGroupID FROM CostGroups WHERE IsDefault = 1

                  UPDATE
                        PrintersDevices
                  SET 
                        CostGroupID = @PrinterGroupID,
                        EngagedStatus = 2 --false do usuário
                  WHERE 
                        PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID --? IN (SELECT PrinterDeviceConsolidateDID FROM PrintersDevicesConsolidation)
                        -- ? AND PrintCostID <> @PrintCostID                 
            END
      
            --prevendo alterações forçadas de banco, caso o registro não exista mais já cai fora
            UPDATE 
                  PrintJobs 
            SET 
                  PrinterdeviceID = @PrinterDeviceMainID,
                  CostMono  = dbo.TotalCostCalcMono (@PrinterDeviceMainID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID),
                  CostColor = dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceMainID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, PagesColor, PagesMono, WasLastPageColor, JobTypeID),
                  SiteID = @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID
            WHERE
                  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID
                  AND JobOriginID <> 7
                  AND (((@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate)) 
                  OR  (((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate))
                  OR    ((@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

            UPDATE 
                  PrintJobs 
            SET 
                  PrinterdeviceID = @PrinterDeviceMainID,
                  SiteID = @PrinterDeviceMainSiteID
            WHERE
                  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID AND JobOriginID = 7 AND
                  (( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
                  ( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
                  ( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))

      END

      IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
      BEGIN
            UPDATE
                  ProcessQueues 
            SET
                  Status = 2,
                  LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
                  LastPeriodUpdated = ISNULL(@EndDate,'2005-12-31')
            WHERE
                  ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
      END

END

GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceForcedColor

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_SetPrinterDeviceForcedColor]
@PrinterDeviceID INT,
@StartDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@EndDate SMALLDATETIME = NULL,
@ProcessQueueID INT

AS

BEGIN

	--se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
		RETURN 

	DECLARE @ForcedColorID INT

	SELECT
		@ForcedColorID = ISNULL(ForceColor,-1)
	FROM
		PrintersDevices
	WHERE
		PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID

	IF (@ForcedColorID <> -1)
	BEGIN

		IF (@ForcedColorID = 1)
		BEGIN

			UPDATE 
				PrintJobs 
			SET 
				PagesMono  = (PagesMono + PagesColor),
				PagesColor = 0,	
				CostMono   = dbo.TotalCostCalcMono(@PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, 0, (PagesMono + PagesColor), 0, JobTypeID),
				CostColor  = 0
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID  = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END
		ELSE IF (@ForcedColorID = 2)
		BEGIN
	 
			UPDATE 
				PrintJobs 
			SET 
				PagesColor = (PagesMono + PagesColor),
				PagesMono  = 0,	
				CostColor  = dbo.TotalCostCalcColor(@PrinterDeviceID, PrintWayID, PaperSizeID, (PagesMono + PagesColor), 0, 1, JobTypeID),
				CostMono   = 0
			WHERE
				PrinterDeviceID  = @PrinterDeviceID AND
				(( (@StartDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted >= @EndDate) ) OR
				( ((@StartDate IS NOT NULL) AND (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)) AND (DatePrinted >= @StartDate) AND(DatePrinted < @EndDate)) OR
				( (@EndDate IS NULL) AND (DatePrinted < @StartDate)))
		END

	END

	IF (@EndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN

		UPDATE
			ProcessQueues 
		SET
			Status = 2,
			LastDateUpdated = GetDate(), 
			LastPeriodUpdated = @EndDate
		WHERE
			ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_ProcessQueues_UpdateUserChangedDate

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_ProcessQueues_UpdateUserChangedDate]
@ProcessQueueID INT,
@PolicyID INT
AS
BEGIN

	--Se por acaso esse processqueueid não existe mais é pq outra já foi criada e ta aguardando o processamento, entao nem perde mais tempo aqui
	IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT ProcessQueueID FROM ProcessQueues WHERE ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID))
	BEGIN
		RETURN 
	END

	UPDATE
		Accounts
	SET 
		ChangedDate = GETUTCDATE()
	WHERE
		AccountID IN 
		(SELECT 
			ObjectId
		FROM
			PoliciesMembers
		WHERE
			PolicyID = @PolicyID 
		AND
			(PolicyMemberType = 1
		OR
			PolicyMemberType = 5))
			
	DELETE FROM
		ProcessQueues
	WHERE
		ProcessQueueID = @ProcessQueueID
END
GO
```

### proc_Products_RetrieveAllInactiveClients

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Products_RetrieveAllInactiveClients] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@OnlyDPS BIT = 0,
@UnActived BIT = 0,
@Date DATETIME  = '1-1-1',
@Days INT = 3,
@OrderBy INT = 1

AS

BEGIN

	IF(@OnlyDPS = 0)
    BEGIN
		IF (@UnActived =1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				* 
			FROM 
				(SELECT DISTINCT
					M.*, 
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
					CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
					IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion, 
					0 AS Actived, 
					1 AS UnActived 
				FROM
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
				WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @Date 
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE())
					AND	(@SiteID = 0 OR S.SiteID = @SiteID)
				) AS Details
            ORDER BY
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 ) THEN Details.MachineName END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 ) THEN Details.IP END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 ) THEN Details.LastDateAccess END ASC
		END
        ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT 
				* 
			FROM
	            (SELECT DISTINCT 
					M.*,
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
                    CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                    IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion,
					0 AS Actived, 
					1 AS UnActived  
				FROM 
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0 
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
					AND (@SiteID = 0 OR S.SiteID = @SiteID)

                UNION

                SELECT DISTINCT 
					M.*, 
					OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem,  
					CASE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE  dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
                    IPR.LastDateAccess,
					IPR.ProductVersion,
					1 AS Actived, 
					0 AS UnActived  
				FROM 
					Machines M
					INNER JOIN Sites S ON M.SiteID = S.SiteID
					INNER JOIN InstalledProducts IPR ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
					INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON OS.OperationSystemID = M.OperationSystemID
                WHERE 
					M.Removed = 0
					AND IPR.ProductID IN (SELECT ProductID FROM vw_Products)
					AND IPR.LastDateAccess > DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE())
					AND (@SiteID = 0 OR S.Siteid = @SiteID)        
				) AS PaGeneral
			ORDER BY
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 ) THEN PaGeneral.MachineName END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 ) THEN PaGeneral.IP END ASC,
				CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 ) THEN PaGeneral.LastDateAccess END ASC
		END
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances]

AS

BEGIN

		-- =============================================
		-- Edit date: 07/11/2013
		-- Edit author:	Rafael Machado
		-- Description: CostAccountType Users = 1,PrintersDevices = 2, SelectableCostAccount = 3
		--	Foi adicionado um case no select dos balanços, quando o tipo da conta for selecionavél(tipo 3),
		--	será verificado se o costAccountID é nulo, se o mesmo for nulo será informado -1 do contrário 
		--	o CostAccountID informado será o que está atribuido.
		--	Se o tipo da conta for 1 ou 2, o CostAccountID informado será -1.
		-- Edit date: 28/11/2013
		--		Adicionando um where no último select para não retornar os usuários que foram deletados
		-- Edit date: 23/05/2014
		--	Adicionando duas clausulas no where do último select, para filtrar as cotas.
		--	Se as cotas privadas não estiverem habilitadas retornará apenas as cotas corporativas.
		--	Se as cotas privadas estiverem habilitadas retornará tanto as cotas corporativas como também as privadas.
		
					
	DECLARE @TBBalances TABLE
		(
			AccountID INT,
			CostAccountID INT,
			TotalPages INT,
			PagesMono INT,
			PagesColor INT,
			MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6),
			UnlimitedQuotas BIT,
			IsCorporative BIT
		)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBBalances
	SELECT
		AccountID,
		CostAccountID, -- TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,		
		SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
		SUM(PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
		SUM(PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
		SUM(MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
		UnlimitedQuotas, 
		IsCorporative 
	FROM 
		dbo.[GetQuotasAccounts_RetrieveAllBalances]()
	GROUP BY
		AccountID,
		IsCorporative,
		CostAccountID,
		UnlimitedQuotas

	--Verifica se as cotas estão compartilhadas
	DECLARE @Shared BIT
	SELECT @Shared = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS BIT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 3 --SharedQuotas
 
	-------------------------------
	-- CostAccountType
	-- Users = 1,
	-- PrintersDevices = 2,
	-- SelectableCostAccount = 3
	--------------------------------
	DECLARE @CostAccountType NVARCHAR(1)
	SET @CostAccountType = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType')

	--Se estiver utilizando cotas compartilhadas
	IF (@Shared = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			TB.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName,
			SUM(TB.TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
			SUM(TB.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
			SUM(TB.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
			SUM(TB.MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
			TB.IsCorporative
		FROM
			@TBBalances TB
			INNER JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = TB.CostAccountID
		WHERE TB.IsCorporative = '1'
		GROUP BY 
			TB.CostAccountID,
			CA.CostAccountName,
			TB.IsCorporative
		ORDER BY
			CostAccountID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		
		DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled INT
		SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = ParameterValue FROM PoliciesParameters where ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'
	
		--Retorna os balanços
		SELECT
			D.DomainID,
			D.DomainName,
			TB.AccountID,
			AC.LogonName,
			ISNULL(AC.Email, '-') AS Email,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserNameDefault,
			CASE 
				WHEN @CostAccountType = 3 THEN ISNULL(TB.CostAccountID, -1) 
				ELSE -1
			END  AS CostAccountID,
			dbo.GetCostAccountName(CA.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TB.UnlimitedQuotas,
			TB.TotalPages,
			TB.PagesMono,
			TB.PagesColor,
			TB.MoneyValue,
			TB.IsCorporative
		FROM
			@TBBalances TB
			INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = TB.AccountID
			INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
			LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts CA ON CA.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
		WHERE
			AC.Removed = 0
			AND (
			(@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND IsCorporative = 1) OR /*Cotas privadas desabilitadas -> busca apenas cotas corporativas*/
			(@BillingPrivateEnabled  = 1 AND IsCorporative IN (0,1)) /*Cotas privadas habilitadas -> busca os dois tipos de cotas*/
			)
		ORDER BY
			UserNameDefault
	END	
	
END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveBalance]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	--Caso não tenha o crédito padrão adiciona
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @TotalPages INT, @PagesMono INT, @PagesColor INT, @MoneyValue DECIMAL (19, 6), @IsCorporative INT, @OperatorID INT
	
	DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
	SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
	
	SELECT
		@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
		@TotalPages = TotalPages,
		@PagesMono  = PagesMono,
		@PagesColor = PagesColor,
		@MoneyValue = MoneyValue,
		@IsCorporative = IsCorporative,
		@OperatorID = OperatorID
	FROM 
		QuotasRules
	WHERE 
		IsDefaultQuota = 1
		AND [Enabled]  = 1
	
	IF (@QuotaRuleID IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID) AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)))
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
		SELECT
				@QuotaRuleID,
				@AccountID,
				@CostAccountID,
				@DateTimeNow,
				@TotalPages,
				@PagesMono,
				@PagesColor,
				@MoneyValue,
				0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
				NULL,
				@IsCorporative,
				@OperatorID,
				1 --[Enabled]
	END
		
	DECLARE @TBAccountsGroups TABLE (AccountGroupID INT)
	
	INSERT INTO
		@TBAccountsGroups
	SELECT
		AccountGroupID
	FROM 
		AccountsGroupsObjects 
	WHERE
		AccountID = @AccountID
	
	--Verifica se existe alguma regra dos grupos que o usuário pertence
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups) AND [Enabled] = 1)
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @TBRulesGroups TABLE (QuotaRuleID INT)
			SET @QuotaRuleID = -1
				
			--Busca as regras (de crédito) desse grupo
			INSERT INTO
				@TBRulesGroups
			SELECT
				QuotaRuleID
			FROM
				QuotasRules
			WHERE
				[Enabled] = 1
				AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
				AND AccountGroupID IN (SELECT AccountGroupID FROM @TBAccountsGroups)
				
			--Remove pelo ID da regra, os créditos que o usuário já recebeu
			DELETE FROM
				@TBRulesGroups
			WHERE
				QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID IN (SELECT QuotaRuleID FROM @TBRulesGroups) AND AccountID = @AccountID)
		
			WHILE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @TBRulesGroups)
			BEGIN
				SELECT TOP 1
					@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID
				FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
					
				--Insere o crédito
				INSERT INTO QuotasCredits (QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime, TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue, FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled])
				SELECT
					@QuotaRuleID,
					@AccountID,
					NULL, --CostAccountID,
					GETDATE(),
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
					FinishDate,
					IsCorporative,
					OperatorID,
					1 --[Enabled]
				FROM
					QuotasRules
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
				IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
				BEGIN
					SELECT 0
					ROLLBACK TRAN
					RETURN
				END	
		
				DELETE FROM
					@TBRulesGroups
				WHERE
					QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			END
		END
	END
		
	--Busca o balanço
	SELECT 
		(SUM(TotalPages) - SUM(ExpenseTotalPages)) AS TotalPages,
		(SUM(PagesMono)  - SUM(ExpensePagesMono))  AS PagesMono,
		(SUM(PagesColor) - SUM(ExpensePagesColor)) AS PagesColor,
		(SUM(MoneyValue) - SUM(ExpenseMoneyValue)) AS MoneyValue,
		IsCorporative
	FROM
		QuotasCredits
	WHERE 
		(@AccountID IS NULL OR AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND [Enabled] = 1
	GROUP BY
		IsCorporative
	
END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveDebitBalance

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasAccounts_RetrieveDebitBalance]
@AccountID INT = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	--Busca os créditos negativos
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaCreditID,
		ISNULL(QC.AccountID, -1) AS AccountID,
		ISNULL(QC.CostAccountID, -1) AS CostAccountID,
		QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QC.IsCorporative,
		QC.OperatorID,
		
		QD.QuotaHostID,
		QD.QuotaDebitHostID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrintJobID, -1) AS PrintJobID,
		ISNULL(QD.PrinterDeviceID, -1) AS PrinterDeviceID,
		QD.UsedDateTime		
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasDebits QD ON QD.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
	WHERE
		QC.OperatorID = 1
		AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
		AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND QC.AccountID IN (
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (TotalPages - ExpenseTotalPages) > 0
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND ((PagesMono - ExpensePagesMono) > 0 OR (PagesColor - ExpensePagesColor) > 0)
			UNION
			SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM QuotasCredits QC WHERE QC.OperatorID <> 1 AND [Enabled] = 1 AND (MoneyValue - ExpenseMoneyValue) > 0
		)

END
GO
```
