### proc_QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes_ValidateCardCode

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes_ValidateCardCode]
@CardCode NVARCHAR(12)

AS

BEGIN
	
	-- ***************************************************************************************
	-- Marco, 2013-08-28
	-- Valida se o código do cartão é valido (se o mesmo existe),se o cartão não venceu 
	-- ou já foi utilizado, retornando o seguinte status da validação: 
	--  0 - Válido 
	--	1 - Inválido
	--  2 - Expirado 
	--  3 - Utilizado
	-- ***************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @ValidationStatus TINYINT
	DECLARE @CardCodeID INT
	DECLARE @ExpirationDate DATETIME
	DECLARE @QuotaCreditID INT
	
	-- Por padrão seta como inválido.
	SET @ValidationStatus = 1
	
	SELECT 
		@CardCodeID = QPCC.CardCodeID,
		@ExpirationDate = QPCB.ExpirationDate,
		@QuotaCreditID = QPCC.QuotaCreditID
	FROM
		QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes QPCC
		INNER JOIN QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches QPCB ON QPCC.BatchID = QPCB.BatchID
	WHERE
		QPCC.CardCode = @CardCode 
	
	-- Se encontrou o código, valida o código	
	IF (@CardCodeID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		-- Se tem crédito atribuido, então o código de cartão ja foi utilizado.
		IF (@QuotaCreditID IS NOT NULL)
		BEGIN
			-- Seta como utilizado.
			SET @ValidationStatus = 3
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Se não expirou a data, é valido.
			IF (@ExpirationDate > GETDATE())
			BEGIN
				-- Seta como válido
				SET @ValidationStatus = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				-- Seta  como expirado
				SET @ValidationStatus = 2
			END
		END
	END
	
	SELECT @ValidationStatus
	
END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasRules_ProcessCredits

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_ProcessCredits]
@DateProcess DATETIME
--@AccountID INT = NULL,
--@CostAccountID INT = NULL,
--@AccountGroupID INT = NULL

AS

BEGIN

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	DECLARE @TBQuotasRules TABLE
		(
			QuotaRuleID INT,
			QuotaPeriodID INT,
			RepeatTimes INT,
			RepeatedTimes INT,
			IsExpire BIT,
			Updated BIT
		)
	
	--Busca todas as regras habilitadas, com o último processamento e próxima adição dos créditos igual a data indicada
	INSERT INTO
		@TBQuotasRules
	SELECT
		QR.QuotaRuleID,
		QP.QuotaPeriodID,
		QP.RepeatTimes,
		QP.RepeatedTimes,
		QP.IsExpire,
		0 --Updated
	FROM
		QuotasRules QR
		INNER JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
	WHERE
		[Enabled] = 1
		AND (QP.LastDateRepeated IS NULL OR QP.LastDateRepeated < @DateProcess)
		AND (QP.NextDate = @DateProcess)
		--AND (@AccountID IS NULL OR QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
		--AND (@CostAccountID IS NULL OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		--AND (@AccountGroupID IS NULL OR QR.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID)
	
	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	DECLARE @QuotaRuleID INT, @QuotaPeriodID INT, @RepeatTimes INT, @RepeatedTimes INT, @IsExpire BIT
	
	--Processa cada regra
	WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM @TBQuotasRules WHERE Updated = 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 1
			@QuotaRuleID = QuotaRuleID,
			@QuotaPeriodID = QuotaPeriodID,
			@RepeatTimes = RepeatTimes,
			@RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes,
			@IsExpire = IsExpire
		FROM 
	
		@TBQuotasRules 
		WHERE
			Updated = 0
		
		--Se for com expiração dos créditos, desabilita todos os créditos recebidos por essa regra
		IF (@IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
			INSERT INTO
	
			QuotasExpires
				(
					QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
				)
			SELECT
					QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
					QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
					QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
			FROM
				QuotasCredits QC
			WHERE
				QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN	
				RETURN
			END	
			
			--Desabilita todos os créditos dessa regra, pois já foi criado as expirações necessárias
			UPDATE QuotasCredits SET [Enabled] = 0,	DisabledDate = GETDATE() WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
				
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
			
	RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		--Caso tenha repetido as vezes necessárias e a regra era para expirar, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes AND @IsExpire = 1)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0			
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		
			CONTINUE
		END
		
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		SET @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que não são de grupo e não é a padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
	
			ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND AccountGroupID IS NULL
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			
		--Insere os créditos para a regra padrão
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT DISTINCT
			QR.QuotaRuleID, QC.AccountID, QR.CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			QR.TotalPages, QR.PagesMono, QR.PagesColor, QR.MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			QR.FinishDate, QR.IsCorporative, QR.OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QR.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NOT NULL
			AND QR.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.IsDefaultQuota = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Insere os créditos para as regras que são de grupo
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasCredits
			(
				QuotaRuleID, AccountID, CostAccountID, CreatedDateTime,
				TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
				ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue,
				FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, [Enabled]
			)
		SELECT
			QuotaRuleID, AGO.AccountID, CostAccountID, @DateTimeNow,
			TotalPages, PagesMono, PagesColor, MoneyValue,
			0, 0, 0, 0, --Expenses
			FinishDate, IsCorporative, OperatorID, 1 --[Enabled]
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroups AG ON AG.AccountGroupID = QR.AccountGroupID
			INNER JOIN AccountsGroupsObjects AGO ON AGO.AccountGroupID = AG.AccountGroupID
		WHERE
			QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END	
		
		--Atualiza a data do próximo crédito e número de repetições
		UPDATE
			QuotasPeriods
		SET		
			LastDateRepeated = NextDate,
			NextDate = dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(PeriodType, PeriodQuantity, StartDay, NextDate),
			RepeatedTimes = RepeatedTimes + 1
		WHERE
			QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN

			RETURN
		END	
			
		--Caso tenha repetido AS vezes necessárias e a regra era para manter os créditos, somente vai desabilitar essa regra
		IF (@RepeatTimes > 0 AND @RepeatTimes <= @RepeatedTimes + 1 AND @IsExpire = 0)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE QuotasRules SET [Enabled] = 0 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
			
			UPDATE QuotasPeriods SET NextDate = NULL WHERE QuotaPeriodID = @QuotaPeriodID
			
			IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
			BEGIN
				SELECT 0
				ROLLBACK TRAN
				RETURN
			END	
		END
		
		UPDATE @TBQuotasRules SET Updated = 1 WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
	END
	
	--Processa os créditos expirados dos usuários
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasCredits WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND QuotaRuleID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasExpires
			(
				QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QC.QuotaRuleID IS NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QuotasCredits
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0,
			DisabledDate = GETDATE()
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND QuotaRuleID IS NULL
		
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	--Processa os créditos expirados dos grupos
	IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM QuotasRules WHERE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(FinishDate AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME) <= @DateProcess AND [Enabled] = 1 AND AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
		INSERT INTO
			QuotasExpires
			(
				QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
			)
		SELECT
				QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
				QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
				QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess

			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
			
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita todos os créditos que tenham data de expiração anterior a data indicada
		UPDATE
			QC
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0,
			DisabledDate = GETDATE()
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			INNER JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QC.FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
			AND QR.AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
					
		IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
		
		--Desabilita a regra também, já que ela expirou
		UPDATE
			QuotasRules
		SET
			[Enabled] = 0
		WHERE
			FinishDate <= @DateProcess
			AND [Enabled] = 1
			AND AccountGroupID IS NOT NULL
			AND QuotaPeriodID IS NULL
		
	
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT 0
			ROLLBACK TRAN
			RETURN
		END
	END

	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	SELECT 1

END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasRules_Remove

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_Remove] 
@QuotaRuleID INT

AS

BEGIN

	BEGIN TRAN ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	UPDATE
		QuotasCredits
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0,
		DisabledDate = GETDATE()
	WHERE
		QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		
	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
		
	--Insere os créditos de expiração (para zerar os créditos não gastos)
	INSERT INTO
		QuotasExpires
		(
			QuotaCreditID, CreatedDateTime, ExpenseTotalPages, ExpensePagesMono, ExpensePagesColor, ExpenseMoneyValue
		)
	SELECT
		QC.QuotaCreditID, GETDATE(),
		QC.TotalPages - QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.PagesMono - QC.ExpensePagesMono, 
		QC.PagesColor - QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.MoneyValue - QC.ExpenseMoneyValue
	FROM
		QuotasCredits QC
	WHERE
		QC.QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID
		AND QC.QuotaCreditID NOT IN (SELECT QuotaCreditID FROM QuotasExpires WHERE QuotaCreditID IN (SELECT QuotaCreditID FROM QuotasCredits WHERE QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID))

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	UPDATE
		QuotasRules 
	SET
		[Enabled] = 0
	WHERE
		QuotaRuleID = @QuotaRuleID

	IF (@@ERROR <> 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0
		ROLLBACK TRAN
		RETURN
	END	
	
	COMMIT --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

END
GO
```

### proc_QuotasRules_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_QuotasRules_RetrieveAll]
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountGroupID INT = -1,
@JustQuotasRules BIT,
@Enabled BIT

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @BillingPrivateEnabled BIT
	SELECT @BillingPrivateEnabled = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM PoliciesParameters WHERE ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled'

	IF (@AccountGroupID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QR.QuotaRuleID,
			QR.AccountID,
			QR.CostAccountID,
			QR.TotalPages,
			QR.PagesMono,
			QR.PagesColor,
			QR.MoneyValue,
			QR.IsCorporative,
			QR.FinishDate,
			QP.PeriodType,
			QP.PeriodQuantity,
			QP.NextDate,
			CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN '-'
				ELSE CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) 
			END AS Recurrences,
			QP.IsExpire,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNull(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNull(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			QR.AccountGroupID = @AccountGroupID
			AND [Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			AND ((@JustQuotasRules = 0 AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NULL) OR (@JustQuotasRules = 1 AND QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NOT NULL))
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QR.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			CreatedDateTime DESC
		
		RETURN
	END

	IF (@JustQuotasRules = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QR.QuotaRuleID,
			QR.AccountID,
			QR.CostAccountID,
			QR.TotalPages,
			QR.PagesMono,
			QR.PagesColor,
			QR.MoneyValue,
			QR.IsCorporative,
			QP.PeriodType,
			QP.PeriodQuantity,
			QP.NextDate,
			CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN '-'
				ELSE CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) 
			END AS Recurrences,
			QP.IsExpire,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNull(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNull(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasRules QR
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		WHERE
			(@AccountID = -1 OR QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
			AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
			AND [Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QR.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			CreatedDateTime DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			QC.QuotaCreditID,
			QC.AccountID,
			QC.CostAccountID,
			QC.TotalPages,
			QC.PagesMono,
			QC.PagesColor,
			QC.MoneyValue,
			CASE
				WHEN QE.CreatedDateTime IS NOT NULL THEN QE.CreatedDateTime
				WHEN QC.FinishDate IS NOT NULL THEN QC.FinishDate
				WHEN QP.NextDate IS NULL THEN NULL
				ELSE dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(QP.PeriodType, QP.PeriodQuantity, QP.StartDay, QC.CreatedDateTime)
			END AS FinishDate,
			--COALESCE(QC.FinishDate, dbo.GetQuotasNextDate(0, 1, 0, QC.CreatedDateTime), QP.NextDate) AS FinishDate,
			--QC.FinishDate,
			ISNULL(QR.IsDefaultQuota, 0) AS IsDefaultQuota,
			QC.IsCorporative,
			QO.OperatorName,
			ISNULL(QIC.QuotaIdentifyCodeID,-1) AS QuotaIdentifyCodeID,
			ISNULL(QIC.IdentifyCode,'-') AS IdentifyCode
		FROM
			QuotasCredits QC
			LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID AND QP.IsExpire = 1
			LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
			LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON (QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID OR QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID)
			LEFT JOIN QuotasExpires QE ON QE.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		WHERE
			(@AccountID = -1 OR QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
			AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
			AND QC.[Enabled] = @Enabled
			AND QC.OperatorID <> 1 --Não exibe os créditos quando o usuário fica negativo
			AND ((@BillingPrivateEnabled = 0 AND QC.IsCorporative = 1) OR (@BillingPrivateEnabled = 1))
		ORDER BY 
			QC.CreatedDateTime DESC
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCube

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_Counters_RetrieveCube]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME, 
@MaxLimitDaysEarlier INT = 30
AS
BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	--- Maicon Pereira, 26/10/2015
	--  SP para cubo de contadores 360 
	--  Versão Contratos
	--  ROGER 07/03/2019 Adicionado chava primary key para melhorar o desempenho da procedure #38 5.46
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	--Pega os ultimos contadores dentro do periodo
	DECLARE @LastCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
	
	INSERT INTO @LastCounters 
		SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
		FROM CountersReadings CR
		RIGHT OUTER JOIN
			(
				SELECT 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
					MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
				FROM 
					CountersReadings CR
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
				WHERE 
					DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND
					DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime  AND
					CR.Removed = 0 AND
					PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)
				GROUP BY 
					CR.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS TableAux
			ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 
		
		
		--Pega os primeiros contadores do periodo somente das impressoras que tem registros dentro do limite maximo anterior
		DECLARE @FirstCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CRID INT, DTR DATETIME)
				
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MAX(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @StartDateTime and 
						DateTimeRead >= DATEADD(DD,(@MaxLimitDaysEarlier*-1),@StartDateTime) AND
						PD.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND
						PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1,3)
					GROUP BY 
						CR.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 

		--Agora pega os primeiros contadores dentro do intervalo das impressoras que tem contadores finais mas não tem iniciais anteriores ao periodo
		DECLARE @IntervalCounters TABLE (PDID INT, CTRIDLC INT, DTR DATETIME)
		INSERT INTO @IntervalCounters 
			SELECT CR.PrinterDeviceID, CR.CounterReadingID , CR.DateTimeRead
			FROM CountersReadings CR
			RIGHT OUTER JOIN
				(
					SELECT 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID,  
						MIN(DateTimeRead) AS DateTimeRead 
					FROM 
						CountersReadings CR
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD1 ON PD1.PrinterDeviceID =  CR.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE 
						DateTimeRead <= @EndDateTime AND 
						DateTimeRead >= @StartDateTime AND
						CR.Removed = 0 AND 						
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID IN (SELECT PDID FROM @LastCounters) AND
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID NOT IN (SELECT PDID FROM @FirstCounters)  
					GROUP BY 
						PD1.PrinterDeviceID
				) AS TableAux
				ON CR.DateTimeRead = TableAux.DateTimeRead AND CR.PrinterDeviceID = TableAux.PrinterDeviceID 

		--Junto as duas tabelas de valores iniciais
		INSERT INTO @FirstCounters 
			SELECT * from @IntervalCounters 
			
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @IntervalCounters 		

		DECLARE @FirstCountersReadings TABLE (ID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,PDID INT, CTRID INT,DTR DATETIME, CTID INT, MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @FirstCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			cast(CAST(FC.PDID AS NVARCHAR(255)) + '0' + CAST(C.CounterTypeID AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS BIGINT) AS ID,
			FC.PDID,
			FC.CRID,  
			FC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @FirstCounters FC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = FC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @FirstCounters
		
		DECLARE @LastCountersReadings TABLE (ID BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, PDID INT, CTRID INT, DTR DATETIME,CTID INT ,MONO INT, COLOR INT, TOTAL INT )
		
		INSERT INTO @LastCountersReadings 
		SELECT
			cast(CAST(LC.PDID AS NVARCHAR(255)) + '0' + CAST(C.CounterTypeID AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS BIGINT) AS ID,
			LC.PDID,
			LC.CRID,  
			LC.DTR ,
			C.CounterTypeID,
			C.CounterMono,
			C.CounterColor,
			C.CounterTotal
			FROM @LastCounters LC
		INNER JOIN Counters C ON C.CounterReadingID = LC.CRID
		
		--Limpo a tabela
		DELETE FROM @LastCounters
		IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM @LastCountersReadings))
		BEGIN
		
		SELECT 
			Sites.SiteName AS [Site],
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(LCR.PDID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
			CTG.CounterGroupName,
			CASE WHEN CT.CounterTypeID = 1 THEN 'Life' ELSE CT.[CounterTypeName] END AS CounterTypeDescription,
			PD.SerialNumber,
			CASE PD.EngagedStatus WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS Engaged,
			ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, 'NoDepartament') AS SiteDivision,
			ISNULL(SUM(LCR.MONO-FCR.MONO), 0) AS TotalMono, 
			ISNULL(SUM(LCR.COLOR-FCR.COLOR), 0) AS TotalColor, 
			ISNULL(SUM(LCR.TOTAL-FCR.TOTAL), 0) AS Total
			--sum(LCR.MONO), 
			--sum(FCR.MONO), 
			--sum(LCR.COLOR), 
			--sum(FCR.COLOR), 
			--sum(LCR.TOTAL), 
			--sum(FCR.TOTAL)
		FROM
			@LastCountersReadings LCR
			LEFT JOIN @FirstCountersReadings FCR on LCR.ID = FCR.ID
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON  LCR.PDID = PD.PrinterDeviceID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypes CT ON LCR.CTID = CT.CounterTypeID
			INNER JOIN Sites ON PD.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
			LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
			INNER JOIN CounterTypeGroups CTG ON CT.CounterGroupID = CTG.CounterGroupID
		GROUP BY 
			LCR.PDID,
			Sites.SiteName,
			SD.SiteDivisionName,
			PrinterDeviceName, 
			CounterGroupName, 
			CT.CounterTypeID,
			CT.[CounterTypeName], 			
			EngagedStatus,
			PD.SerialNumber
		ORDER BY 
			Sites.SiteName,
			SD.SiteDivisionName,
			PrinterDeviceName,
			CounterGroupName,
			CT.[CounterTypeName],			
			Engaged,
			PD.SerialNumber
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			-- Retorna uma linha em branco para o cubo
			SELECT 
			'NoSite' AS [Site],
			'NoPrinter' AS PrinterDeviceName,
			'NoGroup' AS CounterGroupName,
			'NoType' AS CounterTypeDescription,
			'NoSerialNumber' AS SerialNumber,
			0 AS Engaged,
			'NoDepartament' AS SiteDivision,
			0 AS TotalMono, 
			0 AS TotalColor, 
			0 AS Total
		END

END
 
GO
```

### proc_Reports_CountExportAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_CountExportAll]
@MachineID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID SMALLINT = -1,
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SumarizeAll BIT = 0,
@ShowInfCostAccounts BIT = 0,
@ShowInfPrinters BIT = 0,
@ShowInfQueues BIT = 0,
@DateTypeFilter SMALLINT= -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0, 
@CostAccountID SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @strCostAccounts NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @strPrintersDevices NVARCHAR(1000)
	DECLARE @strPrintersQueues NVARCHAR(1000)
	DECLARE @strGroupCostAccounts NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @strGroupPrintersDevices NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @strGroupPrintersQueues NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @strWhereDate NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @Color NVARCHAR(100) 
	DECLARE @Mono NVARCHAR(100) 
	DECLARE @strEndDateTime NVARCHAR(100) 
	DECLARE @strStartDateTime NVARCHAR(100) 

	DECLARE @ShowInfCostsReports NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @Mono = '-1'
	SET @Color =  '-1'

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
		 SET @Mono = '1'
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
		 SET @Color = '1'

	SET @strStartDateTime = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @StartDateTime) AS char(4)) + '-' + cast(DATEPART(mm, @StartDateTime) AS char(2)) + '-' + cast(DATEPART(dd, @StartDateTime)AS char(2))+ ' ' + cast(DATEPART(hh, @StartDateTime) AS char(2))+ ':' + cast(DATEPART(mi, @StartDateTime) AS char(2))+ ':' + cast(DATEPART(ss, @StartDateTime) AS char(2)) 

	SET @strEndDateTime = cast(DATEPART(yyyy, @EndDateTime) AS char(4)) + '-' + cast(DATEPART(mm, @EndDateTime) AS char(2)) + '-' + cast(DATEPART(dd, @EndDateTime)AS char(2))+ ' ' + cast(DATEPART(hh, @EndDateTime) AS char(2))+ ':' + cast(DATEPART(mi, @EndDateTime) AS char(2))+ ':' + cast(DATEPART(ss, @EndDateTime) AS char(2)) 

	IF @DateTypeFilter = 1
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @DateTypeFilter = 2
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @DateTypeFilter = 3
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END

	IF @SumarizeAll = 1
	--Traz os dados de forma detalhada 
	BEGIN
	EXEC('
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)
			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')END

			 SELECT  
				COUNT(*)
			 FROM  
				   PrintJobs with (nolock) 
				   INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
				   INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
				   INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
				   INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
				   INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
				   LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
				   LEFT JOIN Machines AS m2 ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = m2.MachineID 
				   INNER JOIN  Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
				   LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				   LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
				   LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
				   LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
			 WHERE
				   (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
				   ('+ @MachineID +' = -1 OR m2.MachineID = '+ @MachineID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrinterDeviceID +' = -1 OR PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID = '+ @PrinterDeviceID +' ) AND' + @strWhereDate + '                
				   ('+ @Color +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @Mono +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @PaperSizeID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = '+ @PaperSizeID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrintApplicationID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = '+ @PrintApplicationID +') AND 
				   ('+ @PrintWayID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = '+ @PrintWayID +') AND
				   ('+ @JobOriginID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = '+ @JobOriginID +') AND
				   (('+ @JobTypeID +' =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) ) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = '+ @JobTypeID +') AND
				   ('+ @SiteID +' =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID = '+ @SiteID +')  AND 
				   ('+ @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters +' =0 OR PrintersDevices.EngagedStatus = '+ @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters +')AND
    			   (('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
				   ('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))')
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT 0 --no resumido nao é verificado(pelo menos  por enquanto)
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_ExportAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_ExportAll]
@Language NVARCHAR(5) = 'pt-BR',
@MachineID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID SMALLINT = -1,
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SumarizeAll BIT = 0,
@ShowInfCostAccounts BIT = 0,
@ShowInfPrinters BIT = 0,
@ShowInfQueues BIT = 0,
@DateTypeFilter SMALLINT= -1,
@ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters BIT = 0, 
@CostAccountID SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Incluído a coluna 'Confianca_Logica'
	-- Héber Savedra, 2012-07-27
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Incluído o parâmetro de idioma
	-- Rodrigo Scopel, 2018-10-25
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Incluído tradução para o idioma Italiano
	-- Anderson Tabaldi, 2018-12-21
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Incluído tradução para o idioma Francês
	-- Lucas Gustavo, 2020-07-16
	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Incluído 'Finalidade_de_Impressao'
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2020-09-10
	--***********************************************************************************************************
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--/// fim das aalterações da 4.2

	---
	--- TRADUÇÕES DOS CAMPOS
	---
	DECLARE @PrintQualityHigh NVARCHAR(50) = 'Alta'
	DECLARE @PrintQualityNormal NVARCHAR(50) = 'Média'
	DECLARE @PrintQualityLow NVARCHAR(50) = 'Baixa'
	DECLARE @PrintQualityDraft NVARCHAR(50) = 'Rascunho'

	DECLARE @ApplicationNotepad NVARCHAR(50) = 'Bloco de Notas'
	DECLARE @ApplicationUndefined NVARCHAR(50) = 'Indefinido'

	DECLARE @JobTypePrint NVARCHAR(50) = 'Impressão'
	DECLARE @JobTypeCopy NVARCHAR(50) = 'Cópia'

	---
	--- FIM DAS TRADUÇÕES DAS COLUNAS
	--- 

	DECLARE @strCostAccounts NVARCHAR (200)
	DECLARE @strPrintersDevices NVARCHAR (1000)
	DECLARE @strPrintersQueues NVARCHAR (1000)
	DECLARE @strGroupCostAccounts NVARCHAR (200)
	DECLARE @strGroupPrintersDevices NVARCHAR (300)
	DECLARE @strGroupPrintersQueues NVARCHAR (200)
	DECLARE @strWhereDate NVARCHAR (200)
	DECLARE @strCaseFinality NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @Color NVARCHAR (100) 
	DECLARE @Mono NVARCHAR (100) 
	DECLARE @strEndDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 
	DECLARE @strStartDateTime NVARCHAR (100) 

	DECLARE @ShowInfCostsReports NVARCHAR(200)

	SET @Mono  = '-1'
	SET @Color = '-1'

	SELECT 
		@strCaseFinality = 
		CASE (SELECT ParameterValue FROM PoliciesParameters WHERE ParameterName = 'BillingPrivateEnabled')
			WHEN 1 THEN
'		CASE PrintJobs.IsCorporative
						WHEN ''0'' THEN ''' + @FinalityCorporate + '''
						WHEN ''1'' THEN ''' + @FinalityPrivate + '''
				   END AS ' + @ColumnFinality + ','
			ELSE ''
		END
	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = '1'
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = '1'
	END

	SET @strStartDateTime = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @StartDateTime) AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @StartDateTime)	AS CHAR(2)) 

	SET @strEndDateTime   = CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, @EndDateTime)	AS CHAR(4)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mm, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + '-' +
							CAST(DATEPART(dd, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ' ' +
							CAST(DATEPART(hh, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(mi, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) + ':' +
							CAST(DATEPART(ss, @EndDateTime)		AS CHAR(2)) 

	IF @DateTypeFilter = 1
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @DateTypeFilter = 2
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	ELSE IF @DateTypeFilter = 3
	BEGIN
		 SET @strWhereDate = '  (PrintJobs.DatePrinted  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND (PrintJobs.DateInclude  BETWEEN '''+ @strStartDateTime +''' AND '''+ @strEndDateTime +''')  AND '
	END
	
	IF @ShowInfPrinters = 1
	BEGIN
		SET @strPrintersDevices  = ' PrintersDevices.AddressPort AS ' + @ColumnPrinterPort + ', ' +
								   ' REPLACE(PrintersModels.PrinterModelName,'';'','','') AS ' + @ColumModel + ', '+
								   ' PrintersDevices.AddressName AS ' + @ColumnAddress + ', ' +
								   ' CASE WHEN PrintersDevices.IsLocal = 1 THEN ''' + @DeviceLocal + ''' ELSE ''' + @DeviceNetwork + ''' END AS ' + @ColumnType + ', ' +
								   ' ISNULL(SerialNumber, ''-'') AS ' + @ColumnSerialNumber + ', ' +
								   ' ISNULL(AddressMAC, ''-'') AS ' + @ColumnMacAddress + ', ' +
								   ' Sites.SiteName AS ' + @ColumnSiteName + ', ' +
								   ' ISNULL(SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionName, ''-'') AS ' + @ColumnDapartmentName + ', '
		
		SET @strGroupPrintersDevices =	' PrintersDevices.AddressName, PrintersDevices.AddressPort, PrintersModels.PrinterModelName, ' +
										' PrintersDevices.IsLocal, PrintersDevices.SerialNumber, PrintersDevices.AddressMAC, ' +
										' Sites.SiteID, Sites.SiteName, SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID, SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionName, '
	END

	IF @ShowInfQueues = 1 
	BEGIN
		 SET @strPrintersQueues = ' ISNULL(PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName,''-'') AS ' + @ColumnQueueName + ', ' +
			   ' ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Driver,''-'') AS ' + @ColumnDriver + ', ' + 
			   ' ISNULL(PrintersQueues.Port,''-'') AS ' + @ColumnQueuePort + ', ' +
			   ' ISNULL(PrintersQueues.ShareName,dbo.GetString(1) ) AS ' + @ColumnSharing + ', ' 
		 SET @strGroupPrintersQueues = ' PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueName, PrintersQueues.Driver, PrintersQueues.Port, ' +
			   ' PrintersQueues.ShareName, '
	END

	IF @ShowInfCostAccounts = 1
	BEGIN
		 SET @strCostAccounts = ' ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountCode , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS ' + @ColumnCode + ', '
		 SET @strGroupCostAccounts  = ' CostAccounts.CostAccountCode, '
	END

	IF @SumarizeAll = 1
	BEGIN

		IF (@PrintColorID = -1)
			--SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' PrintJobs.CostColor AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
			--				PrintJobs.CostMono AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = '  REPLACE(CAST(PrintJobs.CostColor AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
							 REPLACE(CAST(PrintJobs.CostMono AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '						
		ELSE
			IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
				SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' ''-'' AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
	 							REPLACE(CAST(PrintJobs.CostMono AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
	 							--PrintJobs.CostMono AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
			ELSE
				IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
					--SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' PrintJobs.CostColor  AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
					SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' REPLACE(CAST(PrintJobs.CostColor AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
	 								''-'' AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@PrintColorID = -1)
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = '  REPLACE(CAST(SUM(CostColor) AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
							 REPLACE(CAST(SUM(CostMono) AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
							 
		ELSE
			IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
				SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' ''-'' AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
	 							REPLACE(CAST(SUM(CostMono) AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','') AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
			ELSE
				IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
					SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' REPLACE(CAST(SUM(CostColor) AS NVARCHAR ),''.'','','')  AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
	 								''-'' AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '
	END

	IF(@AccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts BIT

		SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToAccounts'
		
		IF(@ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' 0 AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
							0 AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '

		END
	END

	IF(@CostAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToManagers BIT

		SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToManagers = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToManagers'

		IF(@ShowCostsReportsToManagers = 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = ' 0 AS ' + @ColumnCostColor + ',
							0 AS ' + @ColumnCostMono + ', '

		END
	END

	IF @SumarizeAll = 1
	--Traz os dados de forma detalhada 
	BEGIN
	exec('
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)
			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')END
	   SELECT * 
	   FROM 
			 (
			 SELECT  
				   --USUARIO
						 Accounts.LogonName AS ' + @ColumnLogonName + ', 
				   Accounts.FullName  AS ' + @ColumFullName + ', 
				   Domains.DomainName AS ' + @ColumnDomain + ', 
				   ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS ' + @ColumnAccount + ', '
				   + @strCostAccounts +
				   ' --COMPUTADOR
				   ISNULL(m2.MachineName,''-'') AS ' + @ColumnComputer + ', 
				   ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(m2.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS ' + @ColumnIP + ',

				   --IMPRESSORAS
				   replace(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS ' + @ColumnPrinterName + ', ' 
				   + @strPrintersDevices 
				   + @strPrintersQueues +
				   ' CASE         
						 WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN dbo.GetString(5)
				   ELSE
						 ''' + @PrintColor + '''
				   END AS ' + @ColumnColor + ',
				   CASE PrintQualities.PrintQualityName
				   		WHEN ''Alta'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityHigh + '''
						WHEN ''Média'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityNormal + '''
						WHEN ''Baixa'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityLow + '''
						WHEN ''Rascunho'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityDraft + '''
						ELSE PrintQualities.PrintQualityName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnQuality + ',
				   CASE PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName
				   		WHEN ''Bloco de Notas'' THEN ''' + @ApplicationNotepad + '''
						WHEN ''Indefinido'' THEN ''' + @ApplicationUndefined + '''
						ELSE PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnApplcation + ',
				   PrintJobs.SpoolSize AS ' + @ColumnSize + ',
				   CASE         
						 WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN dbo.GetString(2)
				   ELSE
						 dbo.GetString(3)
				   END AS ' + @ColumnDuplex + ',
   				CASE ' + @PrintColorID + '
					WHEN -1 THEN CAST(PrintJobs.PagesColor AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 1 THEN ''-''
					WHEN 2 THEN CAST(PrintJobs.PagesColor AS NVARCHAR )
				END AS ' + @ColumnPagesColor + ',
				CASE  ' + @PrintColorID + ' 
					WHEN -1 THEN CAST(PrintJobs.PagesMono AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 1 THEN CAST(PrintJobs.PagesMono AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 2 THEN ''-''
				END AS ' + @ColumnPagesMono + ',
				   ' + @ShowInfCostsReports + '
				   PrintJobs.DatePrinted AS ' + @ColumnPrintDate + ',
				   PrintJobs.DateInclude AS ' + @ColumnInsertionDate + ', 
				   PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS ' + @ColumnPaper + ' ,
				   CASE JobOrigins.OriginName
				   		WHEN ''Impressão direta'' THEN ''' + @JobOriginDirect + '''
						ELSE JobOrigins.OriginName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnOrigin + ',
				   ' + @strCaseFinality + '
				   CASE JobTypes.TypeName
						WHEN ''Impressão'' THEN ''' + @JobTypePrint + '''
						WHEN ''Cópia'' THEN ''' + @JobTypeCopy + '''
						WHEN ''Fax Recebido'' THEN ''' + @JobTypeFax + '''
						ELSE JobTypes.TypeName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnPrintJobType + ',
				   CASE
						WHEN PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID IS NULL THEN 0
						ELSE 1 
					END AS ' + @ColumnLogicalTrust + ',
				   PrintJobs.Title AS ' + @ColumnTitle + '
			 FROM  
				   PrintJobs 
				   INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
				   INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID  
				   INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
				   INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
				   INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
				   INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
				   LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
				   LEFT JOIN Machines AS m2 ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = m2.MachineID 
				   INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
				   LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
				   LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				   LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
				   LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
				   LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
			 WHERE
				   (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
				   ('+ @MachineID +' = -1 OR m2.MachineID = '+ @MachineID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrinterDeviceID +' = -1 OR PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID = '+ @PrinterDeviceID +' ) AND' + @strWhereDate + '                
				   ('+ @Color +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @Mono +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @PaperSizeID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = '+ @PaperSizeID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrintApplicationID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = '+ @PrintApplicationID +') AND 
				   ('+ @PrintWayID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = '+ @PrintWayID +') AND
				   ('+ @JobOriginID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = '+ @JobOriginID +') AND
				   (('+ @JobTypeID +' =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) ) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = '+ @JobTypeID +') AND
				   ('+ @SiteID +' =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID = '+ @SiteID +')  AND 
				   ('+ @SiteDivisionID +' =-1 OR  PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = '+ @SiteDivisionID +')  AND 
				   ('+ @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters +' = 0 OR (PrintersDevices.EngagedStatus = ' + @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters + ' OR PrintersDevices.EngagedStatus = 3)) AND
    			   (('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
				   ('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))

			 ) AS Details
	   ORDER BY Details.' + @ColumFullName + ' asc'
	);
	END
	ELSE
	--Traz os dados sumarizados
	BEGIN

	exec ('	
			DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT)
			IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 1)
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](' +@CostAccountID+ ')
			END
			ELSE
				IF (' + @buildListType + ' = 2)
				BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
					SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](' + @AccountIDOwner + ')END
	SELECT * 
	   FROM 
			 (
			 SELECT  
				   --USUARIO
				   Accounts.LogonName AS ' + @ColumnLogonName + ', 
				   Accounts.FullName  AS ' + @ColumFullName + ', 
				   Domains.DomainName AS ' + @ColumnDomain + ', 
				   ISNULL(CostAccounts.CostAccountName , dbo.GetString(1) )AS ' + @ColumnAccount + ', '
				   + @strCostAccounts +
				   ' --COMPUTADOR
				   ISNULL(m2.MachineName,''-'') AS ' + @ColumnComputer + ', 
				   ISNULL(dbo.GetIP(m2.MachineID) , dbo.GetString(1) ) AS ' + @ColumnIP + ',
				   --IMPRESSORAS
				   replace(PrintersDevices.PrinterDevicename,'';'','','') AS ' + @ColumnPrinterName + ', ' 
				   + @strPrintersDevices 
				   + @strPrintersQueues +
				   '--PrintJobs.Title AS ' + @ColumnTitle + ',
				   CASE         
						 WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN dbo.GetString(5)
				   ELSE
						''' + @PrintColor + '''
				   END AS ' + @ColumnColor + ',
				   CASE PrintQualities.PrintQualityName
				   		WHEN ''Alta'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityHigh + '''
						WHEN ''Média'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityNormal + '''
						WHEN ''Baixa'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityLow + '''
						WHEN ''Rascunho'' THEN ''' + @PrintQualityDraft + '''
						ELSE PrintQualities.PrintQualityName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnQuality + ',
				   CASE         
						 WHEN PrintJobs.PrintWayID = 0  THEN dbo.GetString(2)
				   ELSE
						 dbo.GetString(3)
				   END AS ' + @ColumnDuplex + ',
   				CASE ' + @PrintColorID + '
					WHEN -1 THEN CAST(SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 1 THEN ''-''
					WHEN 2 THEN CAST(SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS NVARCHAR )
				END AS ' + @ColumnPagesColor + ',
				CASE  ' + @PrintColorID + ' 
					WHEN -1 THEN CAST(SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 1 THEN CAST(SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS NVARCHAR )
					WHEN 2 THEN ''-''
				END AS ' + @ColumnPagesMono + ',
				   ' + @ShowInfCostsReports + '
				   --PrintJobs.DatePrinted AS Data, 
				   PapersSize.PaperSizeName AS ' + @ColumnPaper + ' ,
				   CASE JobOrigins.OriginName
				   		WHEN ''Impressão direta'' THEN ''' + @JobOriginDirect + '''
						ELSE JobOrigins.OriginName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnOrigin + ',
				   ' + @strCaseFinality + '
				   CASE JobTypes.TypeName
						WHEN ''Impressão'' THEN ''' + @JobTypePrint + '''
						WHEN ''Cópia'' THEN ''' + @JobTypeCopy + '''
						WHEN ''Fax Recebido'' THEN ''' + @JobTypeFax + '''
						ELSE JobTypes.TypeName
				   END AS ' + @ColumnPrintJobType + '
			 FROM  
				   PrintJobs 
				   INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
				   INNER JOIN Domains ON Domains.DomainID = Accounts.DomainID  
				   INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
				   INNER JOIN PapersSize ON PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
				   INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
				   INNER JOIN PrintersModels ON PrintersModels.PrinterModelID = PrintersDevices.PrinterModelID
				   LEFT JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
				   LEFT JOIN Machines AS m2 ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = m2.MachineID 
				   INNER JOIN Sites ON PrintJobs.SiteID = Sites.SiteID 
				   LEFT JOIN SitesDivisions ON PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = SitesDivisions.SiteDivisionID 
				   LEFT JOIN CostAccounts ON printjobs.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				   LEFT JOIN JobOrigins ON PrintJobs.JobOriginID = JobOrigins.JobOriginID 
				   LEFT JOIN JobTypes ON PrintJobs.JobTypeID = JobTypes.JobTypeID 
				   LEFT JOIN PrintQualities ON PrintJobs.PrintQualityID = PrintQualities.PrintQualityID 
			 WHERE
				   (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
				   ('+ @MachineID +' = -1 OR m2.MachineID = '+ @MachineID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrinterDeviceID +' = -1 OR PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID = '+ @PrinterDeviceID +' ) AND ' + @strWhereDate + '                
				   ('+ @Color +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @Mono +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
				   ('+ @PaperSizeID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = '+ @PaperSizeID +') AND
				   ('+ @PrintApplicationID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = '+ @PrintApplicationID +') AND 
				   ('+ @PrintWayID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = '+ @PrintWayID +') AND
				   ('+ @JobOriginID +' =-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = '+ @JobOriginID +') AND
				   (('+ @JobTypeID +' =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) ) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = '+ @JobTypeID +') AND
				   ('+ @SiteID +' =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID = '+ @SiteID +') AND
				   ('+ @SiteDivisionID +' =-1 OR  PrintersDevices.SiteDivisionID = '+ @SiteDivisionID +')  AND 
				   ('+ @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters +' =0 OR (PrintersDevices.EngagedStatus = '+ @ShowOnlyEngagedPrinters +' OR PrintersDevices.EngagedStatus = 3))AND
    			   (('+@UseORMethod+'= 0 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')AND 
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))))OR
				   ('+@UseORMethod+'= 1 AND(('+@AccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.AccountID = '+@AccountID+')OR
				   ('+@CostAccountID+' = -1 OR PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList)))))
			 GROUP BY 
				Accounts.LogonName,Accounts.FullName,Domains.DomainName,CostAccounts.CostAccountName,
				   m2.MachineName, m2.MachineID ,m2.MachineName,PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,PrintJobs.PagesColor,
				   PrintQualities.PrintQualityName, PrintJobs.PrintWayID, PapersSize.PaperSizeName, 
				   '+  @strGroupCostAccounts + @strGroupPrintersDevices + @strGroupPrintersQueues+' JobOrigins.OriginName, JobTypes.TypeName,
				   PrintJobs.IsCorporative
			 ) AS Details
	   ORDER BY Details.' + @ColumFullName + ' asc'
	);
	END
END

GO
```

### proc_Reports_ExportBureau

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_ExportBureau]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @ShowInfCostsReports INT
	
	SET @ShowInfCostsReports = 1
	
	IF(@AccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts BIT

		SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToAccounts'
		
		IF(@ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = 0
		END
	END

	IF(@CostAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToManagers BIT

		SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToManagers = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToManagers'

		IF(@ShowCostsReportsToManagers = 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @ShowInfCostsReports = 0
		END
	END
	
	SELECT     
		ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '-') AS 'Codigo da Conta',
		ISNULL(CC.CostAccountName, '-') AS 'Conta',
		D.DomainName AS Dominio,
		A.LogonName AS Logon,
		A.FullName AS 'Nome Completo',
		BR.BureauResourceName AS Recurso,
		CASE WHEN @ShowInfCostsReports = 0
			THEN '-'
			ELSE REPLACE(CAST(CUBO.Cost AS NVARCHAR),'.',',')
		END AS Custo
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				BRJ.BureauResourceID,
				BRJ.Cost,
				PJ.CostAccountID,
				PJ.AccountID,
				PJ.DatePrinted
			FROM
				BureauResourcesJobs AS BRJ
				INNER JOIN PrintJobs AS PJ ON BRJ.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
			WHERE      
				(PJ.JobOriginID = 7) 
				AND (PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND 
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				))
		) AS CUBO
		INNER JOIN BureauResources AS BR ON CUBO.BureauResourceID = BR.BureauResourceID
		LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts AS CC ON CUBO.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		INNER JOIN Accounts AS A ON CUBO.AccountID = A.AccountID 
		INNER JOIN [Domains] AS D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
	WHERE
		(@CostAccountID =-1 OR CC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID) AND 
		(@AccountID =-1 OR A.AccountID =  @AccountID )

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveAuditingActionsSummary

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveAuditingActionsSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AuditingActionTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@LoginType INT = 1,
@AuditingActionID INT = 1
AS
BEGIN

	IF(@LoginType = 1)
	BEGIN
	
		SELECT 
			Domains.DomainName,  
			Accounts.FullName,
			Auditings.ActionDate, 
			Auditings.AuditingActionID,
			AuditingActions.AuditingName AS AuditingDescription,
			Auditings.AffectedDescription,
			'1' AS Counter	
		FROM 
			Auditings
			INNER JOIN Accounts ON Auditings.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
			INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID
			INNER JOIN AuditingActions ON Auditings.AuditingActionID = AuditingActions.AuditingActionID
		WHERE
			Auditings.ActionDate between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
			AND ((@AccountID = -1) OR Auditings.AccountID = @AccountID)
			AND Auditings.AccountID IS NOT NULL 
			AND ((@AuditingActionID = 2) OR Auditings.AuditingActionID  = 1)
		ORDER BY 
			Auditings.ActionDate DESC
			
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN 

		SELECT * FROM (
			SELECT 
				Auditings.PartnerName AS DomainName,  
				Auditings.PartnerAccount AS FullName,  
				Auditings.ActionDate, 
				Auditings.AuditingActionID,
				AuditingActions.AuditingName AS AuditingDescription,
				Auditings.AffectedDescription,
				'1' AS Counter	
			FROM 
				Auditings
				INNER JOIN AuditingActions ON Auditings.AuditingActionID = AuditingActions.AuditingActionID
			WHERE
				Auditings.ActionDate between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
				AND ((@AccountID = -1) OR Auditings.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND Auditings.AccountID IS NULL 
				AND ((@AuditingActionID = 2) OR Auditings.AuditingActionID  = 1)
				
			UNION
			
			SELECT 
				Domains.DomainName,  
				Accounts.FullName,
				Auditings.ActionDate, 
				Auditings.AuditingActionID,
				AuditingActions.AuditingName AS AuditingDescription,
				Auditings.AffectedDescription,
				'1' AS Counter	
			FROM 
				Auditings
				INNER JOIN Accounts ON Auditings.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
				INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID
				INNER JOIN AuditingActions ON Auditings.AuditingActionID = AuditingActions.AuditingActionID
			WHERE
				Auditings.ActionDate between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
				AND ((@AccountID = -1) OR Auditings.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND  Auditings.AccountID IS NOT NULL 
				AND ((@AuditingActionID = 2) OR Auditings.AuditingActionID  = 1)
		
		) AS tableAuditings
		ORDER BY 
			tableAuditings.ActionDate DESC
	END	

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveComputersDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveComputersDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = - 1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@MachineID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters--*************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
 		SET @Color = 1
 	END

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,
		JobOriginID,
		GroupName, 
		Title, 
		DatePrinted,
		PagesColor,
		PagesMono,
		Pages, 
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID , 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName,
		1 AS [Counter],
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PrintJobs.PrintJobID,
				PrintJobs.JobOriginID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID)  AS GroupName,
				PrintJobs.Title, 
				PrintJobs.DatePrinted,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
					WHEN 1 THEN -1
					WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono
     				WHEN 1 THEN  PrintJobs.PagesMono
	      			WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono
     				WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.CostMono
	      			WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
					WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE 'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PrintJobs.PrintWayID, 
				PrintApplicationID,
				PaperSizeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs 
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
				LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues ON PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = PrintersQueues.PrinterQueueID 
				LEFT  JOIN Machines ON PrintersQueues.MachineID = Machines.MachineID 
			WHERE
				(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND
				(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) 
				AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
				AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) )OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) 
				AND ((@MachineID = 0 AND  Machines.MachineID IS NULL) 
				OR (@MachineID =-1 OR  Machines.MachineID= @MachineID)) 
				AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				))
		) AS Details
			 INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID			
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@ProjectID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @HasCostAccountID BIT --0: Não Passou Centro de Custo; 1: Passou Centro de Custo
	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	IF (@CostAccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		--nesse caso sempre tem que ter o CC. Então se não tem é pq quer os jobs sem CC
		SET @HasCostAccountID = 0
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SET @HasCostAccountID = 1		
	END
	
	print @CostAccountID
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
		SET @Mono = 1
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
		SET @Color = 1

	SELECT 
		Details.PrintJobID,
		Details.JobOriginID,
		Details.GroupName, 
		Details.Title , 
		Details.DatePrinted , 
		Details.PagesColor,
		Details.PagesMono,
		Details.Pages,  
		Details.PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName , 
		Details.PrintColorName,
		Details.PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS Counter,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM (
		SELECT 
			PrintJobs.PrintJobID,
			PrintJobs.JobOriginID,
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID) AS GroupName, 
			--PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName AS GroupName, 
			PrintJobs.AccountID,
			PrintJobs.Title , 
			PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID , 
			PrintJobs.PaperSizeID, 
			PrintJobs.DatePrinted,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
				WHEN 1 THEN -1
				WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
			END AS PagesColor,
			CASE @PrintColorID 
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
				WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
				WHEN 2 THEN -1
			END AS PagesMono,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono
	     		WHEN 1 THEN  PrintJobs.PagesMono
		      	WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor 
			END AS Pages,
			CASE @PrintColorID
				WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono
	     			WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.CostMono
		      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor
			END AS PrintCost,
			CASE  
				WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
				ELSE 'Mono'
			END AS PrintColorName,
			PrintJobs.PrintWayID
		FROM         
			PrintJobs 
			INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID 
		WHERE
			(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND
			(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
			AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
			AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
			AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
			AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
			AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
			AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
			AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) )OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
			AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
			AND (@PrinterDeviceID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
			AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)
						AND 
						(
							(@HasCostAccountID = 0 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL) 
							OR 
							(@HasCostAccountID =1 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
						)
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			
						OR
						(
							(@HasCostAccountID = 0 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL) 
								OR 
							(@HasCostAccountID =1 AND PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
						)
					)

				))
		 ) AS Details
			INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
			INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
	ORDER BY
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
	CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC
		
END
GO
```
