### proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountWithoutDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE  PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCostAccountWithoutDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeId  SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID FROM @Parameters --*****************

--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
		DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

		SET @Mono = - 1
		SET @Color =  -1

		 IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
			SET @Mono = 1
		ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
 			SET @Color = 1

	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2)
	BEGIN
	
			 SELECT *
				
				 FROM  ( 
				
					SELECT     
						0 AS CostAccountID, 	
						'@@PrintersWithoutACostAccount' AS CostAccountName,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName + ' (' + PrintersDevices.AddressName + ':'+  PrintersDevices.AddressPort +')' AS PrinterDeviceName,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter 
					FROM         
						PrintJobs
						INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND		
						(@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
						(@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
						(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
						(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						(@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
						(@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
						(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL ) AND 
						(@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							(
								(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
								(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL)
							)

					GROUP BY 
 						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName,PrintersDevices.AddressName,PrintersDevices.AddressPort, PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS CostAccountsSummary 
			  
				ORDER BY
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
END
ELSE
BEGIN 
						 SELECT *
				
				 FROM  ( 
				
					SELECT     
						0 AS CostAccountID, 	
						'@@UsersWithoutACostAccount' AS CostAccountName,
						Accounts.AccountID,
						Accounts.FullName +'  (' + Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'  AS AccountName,
						--SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor) AS PagesColor, 
						--SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono) AS PagesMono,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM( PrintJobs.CostMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter 
					FROM         
						PrintJobs
						INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
						INNER JOIN Domains ON Domains.DomainID = Accounts.DomainID
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) AND 
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND		
						(@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) AND
						(@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) AND
						(@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) AND
						(@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) AND 
						(@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) AND
						(@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) AND 
						((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID) AND
						(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL ) AND 
						(@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							(
								(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
								(PrintJobs.CostAccountID IS NULL)
							)

					GROUP BY 
 						Domains.DomainName, Accounts.AccountID, Accounts.FullName, Accounts.LogonName--, CostAccounts.CostAccountID, CostAccounts.CostAccountName 
			) AS CostAccountsSummary 
			  
				ORDER BY
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountName) END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
				 CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
		
END

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveCubeBureau

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCubeBureau] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT 
		ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CB.CostAccountID), 'No Account Cost') AS CostAccountName,
		BR.BureauResourceName,
		DATEPART(YEAR,  DatePrinted) AS [YEAR],
		DATEPART(MONTH, DatePrinted) AS [MONTH],
		D.DomainName,
		AC.LogonName,
		S.SiteName AS [Site],
		ISNULL(M.MachineName,'No Machine') AS MachineName, 
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName, 
		ISNULL(PQ.PrinterQueueName,'No Printer Queue') AS PrinterQueueName,
		CB.Quantity,
		CAST(CB.Cost AS NUMERIC(16,2)) AS Cost,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, 'No Departament') AS SiteDivision
	FROM
		(
			SELECT 
				BRJ.BureauResourceID,
				SUM(BRJ.Cost) AS Cost,
				SUM(BRJ.Quantity) AS Quantity,
				PJ.CostAccountID, 
				PJ.AccountID,
				PJ.DatePrinted,
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PJ.PrinterQueueID
			FROM 
				BureauResourcesJobs BRJ
				INNER JOIN PrintJobs PJ ON BRJ.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
			WHERE
				PJ.JobOriginID = 7
				AND PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
				AND PJ.JobDisabled = 0
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				((
					@UseORMethod= 0 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						AND
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				)
				OR
				(
					@UseORMethod= 1 
					AND
					(
						(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
						OR
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
					)
				))
			GROUP BY
				BRJ.BureauResourceID,			
				PJ.CostAccountID, 
				PJ.AccountID,
				PJ.DatePrinted,
				PJ.PrinterDeviceID,
				PJ.PrinterQueueID
		)
	AS  CB
		INNER JOIN BureauResources BR ON BR.BureauResourceID = CB.BureauResourceID
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = CB.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CB.PrinterDeviceID
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues  PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = CB.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = PD.SiteID
		LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID
	ORDER BY 
		CostAccountName, 
		BureauResourceName, 
		[YEAR], 
		[MONTH], 
		DomainName, 
		LogonName, 
		[Site], 
		SD.SiteDivisionName,
		MachineName, 
		PrinterDeviceName, 
		PrinterQueueName

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveCubePrinting

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveCubePrinting] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](-1, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario
	DECLARE @CostAccountID INT

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @GetCosts BIT
	
	--primeiro verifica se o usuário é admin
	IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountIDOwner AND PermissionControlID = 1 AND PermissionAccessID = 9))
	BEGIN	
		-- Significa que o usuário pode ver todos os CCs e os custos dos jobs
		SET @GetCosts = 1
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
		-- Significa que o usuário só pode ver os seus dados e/ou seus CCs
		-- Verifica se ele é gerente de algum CC
		IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CostAccountsManagers WHERE AccountID = @AccountIDOwner)>0)
		BEGIN
			-- o usuário é gerente. Ve se gerentes podem ver custo
			DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToManagers BIT
			SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToManagers = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToManagers'

			IF(@ShowCostsReportsToManagers = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 1
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			--não é admion nem gerente. ve se usuários podem ver custos.
			DECLARE @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts BIT
			SELECT @ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = CAST(ParameterValue AS BIT) FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCostsReportsToAccounts'

			IF(@ShowCostsReportsToAccounts = 0)
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 0
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @GetCosts = 1
			END
		END
	END

	SELECT     
		D.DomainName,
		AC.FullName,
		S.SiteName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName, 
		DATEPART(YEAR,    [Date]) AS DateYear,
		DATEPART(MONTH,   [Date]) AS DateMonth,
		DATEPART(DAY,     [Date]) AS DateDay,
		DATEPART(QUARTER, [Date]) AS DateQuarter,
		CASE CB.PrintWayID WHEN 0 THEN 'Simplex' ELSE 'Duplex' END AS Duplex, 
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PQL.PrintQualityName,
		PS.PaperSizeName,
		CASE CB.JobOriginID 
			WHEN 1 THEN 'IMPRESSÃO DIRETA'  
			WHEN 2 THEN 'DPS'
			WHEN 3 THEN 'FORMS'
			WHEN 4 THEN 'Cópia Lexmark'
			WHEN 5 THEN 'Fax Lexmark'
			WHEN 6 THEN 'Xerox MF'
			WHEN 7 THEN 'BUREAU' END AS JobOrigin,
		CASE Color WHEN 0 THEN 'Mono' ELSE 'Color' END AS Color,
		CASE CB.CostAccountID  WHEN -1 THEN 'No Account Cost' ELSE CC.CostAccountName END AS CostAccountName,
		ISNULL(CC.CostAccountCode, '') AS CostAccountCode,
		CASE CB.PrinterQueueID WHEN -1 THEN 'No Print Server' ELSE M.MachineName END AS PrintServerName, 
		PD.SerialNumber,
		CASE CB.PrinterQueueID WHEN -1 THEN 'No Printer Queue' ELSE PQ.PrinterQueueName END AS PrinterQueueName, 
		CASE CB.JobTypeID WHEN 1 THEN 'Printing' WHEN 2 THEN 'Copy' WHEN 3 THEN 'FaxReceived' WHEN 4 THEN 'Scan' WHEN 5 THEN 'FaxSent' END AS JobType,
		ISNULL(SD.SiteDivisionName, 'No Department') AS SiteDivisionName,
		Pages, 
		CASE @GetCosts WHEN 1 THEN Cost ELSE 0 END AS Cost
	FROM       
		CubeCube CB
		INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = CB.PrinterDeviceID 
		LEFT  JOIN SitesDivisions SD ON SD.SiteDivisionID = PD.SiteDivisionID 
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PA.PrintApplicationID = CB.PrintApplicationID 
		INNER JOIN PrintQualities PQL ON PQL.PrintQualityID = CB.PrintQualityID 
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON PS.PaperSizeID = CB.PaperSizeID 
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = CB.AccountID 
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = CB.PrinterQueueID 
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID 
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		INNER JOIN Sites S ON S.SiteID = CB.SiteID
		LEFT  JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = CB.CostAccountID
	WHERE
		(CB.[Date] BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
		AND Pages > 0
		AND
		--//alteração [4.2]
		--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
		((
			@UseORMethod= 0 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR CB.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CB.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		)
		OR
		(
			@UseORMethod= 1 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR CB.AccountID = @AccountID)
				OR
				(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CB.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		))

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveDigitizingDetails]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID,@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor INT
	SELECT @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'ReportDigitizingSumPages'

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,
		GroupName, 
		Title, 
		DatePrinted,
		Pages,  
		PrintCost,
		JobTypeID,
		'' AS JobType,
		1 AS [Counter]
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PrintJobID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PrinterDeviceID) AS GroupName, 
				Title, 
				DatePrinted, 
       			CASE WHEN @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = 1 THEN SUM(PagesMono + PagesColor) ELSE PagesMono END AS Pages,
				CASE WHEN @DisplaySumPagesMonoAndPagesColor = 1 THEN SUM(CostMono + CostColor) ELSE CostMono END AS PrintCost,
				JobTypeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs 
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (JobDisabled = 0) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND JobTypeID IN (4,5)) OR JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR  PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID) 
				AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
			GROUP BY
				PrintJobID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PrinterDeviceID),
				Title,
				DatePrinted,
				PagesMono,
				PagesColor,
				CostMono,
				CostColor,
				JobTypeID
		) AS Details
	WHERE
		Pages > 0
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC
			
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveInstalledProducts

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveInstalledProducts]
@Inactive INT = 0, --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
@InactiveDate DATETIME  = '1-1-1',
@Days INT = 3,
@MachineID INT = -1,
@ProductID INT = -1,
@PrinterID INT = -1,
@OrderBy INT = 1,
@FilterType INT= 0 --FilterType pode ser 0 (sem filtro), 1 (Computadores) e 2 (Impressoras)

AS

BEGIN 

	--***********************************************************************************************************
	-- Alterado para colocar hífen na versão quando ela não for encontrada.
	--
	-- Wesley Lemos, 2018-10-31
	--***********************************************************************************************************

	SET NOCOUNT ON

	SELECT
		ObjectName,
		IP,
		ProductName,
		ProductVersion,
		OperationSystem,
		LastDateAccess,
		Actived, 
		UnActived,
		IsMachine
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				M.MachineName AS ObjectName,
				CASE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) WHEN '' THEN '-' ELSE dbo.GetIP(M.MachineID) END AS IP,
				PR.ProductName,  
				(CASE 
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = 'Não encontrada' THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion IS NULL THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = '' THEN '-'
					ELSE IPR.ProductVersion END) AS ProductVersion,
				OS.OperationSystemName AS OperationSystem, 
				IPR.LastDateAccess,
				1 AS IsMachine,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 0
					WHEN 2 THEN 1
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS Actived,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 1
					WHEN 2 THEN 0
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS UnActived 
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts IPR
				INNER JOIN Products PR ON PR.ProductID = IPR.ProductID
				INNER JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = IPR.MachineID
				INNER JOIN OperationSystems OS ON M.OperationSystemID = OS.OperationSystemID
			WHERE
				(
					@FilterType <> 2
					AND @PrinterID = -1
					AND
					(
						(@MachineID = -1 OR M.MachineID = @MachineID)
						AND M.Removed = 0
						AND (@ProductID = -1 OR  PR.ProductID = @ProductID)
						AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @InactiveDate
						AND 
						(
							@Inactive = 0
							OR (@Inactive = 1 AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()))
							OR (@Inactive = 2 AND IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days ,GETDATE()))
						)
					)
				)

			UNION ALL

			SELECT
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName2(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS ObjectName,
				PD.AddressName AS IP,
				PR.ProductName,   
				(CASE 
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = 'Não encontrada' THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion IS NULL THEN '-'
					WHEN IPR.ProductVersion = '' THEN '-'
					ELSE IPR.ProductVersion END) AS ProductVersion,
				'-' AS OperationSystem,
				IPR.LastDateAccess,
				0 AS IsMachine,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 0
					WHEN 2 THEN 1
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS Actived,
				CASE @Inactive --Todos 0, Inativos 1 e Ativos 2
					WHEN 1 THEN 1
					WHEN 2 THEN 0
					ELSE
						CASE WHEN IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()) 
							THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
				END AS UnActived 
			FROM 
				InstalledProducts IPR
				INNER JOIN Products PR ON PR.ProductID = IPR.ProductID
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = IPR.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				(
					@FilterType <> 1
					AND @MachineID = -1
					AND
					(
						(@PrinterID = -1 OR  PD.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterID)
						AND PD.EnabledCounterStatus IN (1, 3)
						AND (@ProductID = -1 OR  PR.ProductID = @ProductID)
						AND IPR.LastDateAccess > @InactiveDate
						AND 
						(
							@Inactive = 0
							OR (@Inactive = 1 AND IPR.LastDateAccess <= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days, GETDATE()))
							OR (@Inactive = 2 AND IPR.LastDateAccess >= DATEADD(DAY, -@Days ,GETDATE()))
						)
					)
				)
		) AS TB
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1) THEN ObjectName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2) THEN ProductName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3) THEN LastDateAccess END ASC
     
END

--##########################################################################################################################################
--FIM DA CRIAÇÃO DAS STORED PROCEDURES
--##########################################################################################################################################

--##########################################################################################################################################
--INICIO DA ATUALIZAÇÃO VERSÃO DO BANCO
--##########################################################################################################################################
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveObjectsFromCostAccountSummary

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveObjectsFromCostAccountSummary] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

		DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, CostAccountID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

		INSERT INTO @Parameters
			SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

		--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
		DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
		DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
		DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

		SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

					--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
		DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
		DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

		SET @Mono = - 1
		SET @Color =  -1

		 IF (@PrintColorID = 1 )
			SET @Mono = 1
		ELSE IF(@PrintColorID = 2 )
			SET @Color = 1

	IF((SELECT ParameterValue FROM [Parameters] WHERE ParameterName = 'CostAccountsType') = 2)
	BEGIN

					

				SELECT * FROM
				(
				SELECT 
						CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID,
						[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
						CostPrintersSummary.PrinterDeviceID,
						PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceName + ' (' + PrintersDevices.AddressName + ':'+  PrintersDevices.AddressPort +')' AS PrinterDeviceName,
						CostPrintersSummary.MonoPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.ColorPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalPages,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalCost,
						CostPrintersSummary.TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter

				 FROM  ( 
					
					SELECT     
						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,
						PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
     						WHEN 1 THEN  SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
	      					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
     							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono)
	      						WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs
					FROM
						PrintJobs
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
						AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
						AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
						AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
						AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
						AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
						AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
						AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID  in (1,2,3))OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
						AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							))

					 GROUP BY 
 						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,PrintJobs.PrinterDeviceID
				 ) AS CostPrintersSummary
					INNER JOIN PrintersDevices ON CostPrintersSummary.PrinterDeviceID = PrintersDevices.PrinterDeviceID
					INNER JOIN CostAccounts ON CostPrintersSummary.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				)AS T
				ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrinterDeviceName) END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc
		
	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
						

				SELECT * FROM
				(
				SELECT 
						CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID,
						[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
						CostAccountsSummary.AccountID,
						 CASE Accounts.FullName 
							WHEN '' THEN Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName
							ELSE Accounts.FullName + ' (' + Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'
						 END AS AccountName,
						CostAccountsSummary.MonoPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.ColorPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalPages,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalCost,
						CostAccountsSummary.TotalJobs,
						1 AS Counter

				 FROM  ( 
					
					SELECT     
						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,
						PrintJobs.AccountID,
						CASE @PrintColorID 
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
							WHEN 2 THEN -1
						END AS MonoPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
							WHEN 1 THEN -1
							WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS ColorPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono)
     						WHEN 1 THEN  SUM(PrintJobs.PagesMono)
	      					WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.PagesColor)
						END AS TotalPages,
						CASE @PrintColorID
							WHEN -1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono)
     							WHEN 1 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostMono)
	      						WHEN 2 THEN SUM(PrintJobs.CostColor)
						END AS TotalCost,
						COUNT(1) AS TotalJobs
					FROM
						PrintJobs
					WHERE
						(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
						AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
						AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
						AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
						AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
						AND (@PrintWayID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
						AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
						AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID  in (1,2,3))OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
						AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID)
						AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
									(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
								)
							))

					 GROUP BY 
 						PrintJobs.CostAccountID,PrintJobs.AccountID
				 ) AS CostAccountsSummary
					INNER JOIN Accounts ON CostAccountsSummary.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID
					INNER JOIN Domains ON Accounts.DomainID = Domains.DomainID
					INNER JOIN CostAccounts ON CostAccountsSummary.CostAccountID = CostAccounts.CostAccountID
				)AS T
				ORDER BY
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (AccountName) END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (AccountName) END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalPages END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalPages END desc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN TotalCost END asc,
					CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN TotalCost END desc

	END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrievePrintAmmountGraph

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintAmmountGraph] 
@NMonths INT = -1,
@MONTH INT = -1, 
@YEAR INT = -1, 
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS
BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @BeginMonth AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndMonth AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @StartDateTime AS DATETIME;
	DECLARE @EndDateTime AS DATETIME;

	SET @NMonths = @NMonths -1
	SET @BeginMonth =  DATEADD (mm , @NMonths*-1, CAST(( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4))+'-'+ CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-01') AS DATETIME) )
	SET @EndMonth  =  DATEADD(ss, -1,DATEADD (mm , 1, CAST(( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4))+'-'+ CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-01') AS DATETIME) ))

	SET @StartDateTime = @BeginMonth
	SET @EndDateTime = @EndMonth
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	IF (@AccountID = -1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT
			*
		FROM
			(
				SELECT 
					yearw,
					monthw,  
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS Mono, 
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Color , 
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Total,
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS MonoCost, 
					CAST(SUM(CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS ColorCost , 
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV + CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS TotalCost,
					(CAST(CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(dayw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) AS datew 
				FROM 
					CubeCostAccountIDWeek
				WHERE 
					(CAST( CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(dayw AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME) BETWEEN CAST( CAST(datepart(yy,@BeginMonth)AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(datepart(mm,@BeginMonth)AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-27 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)  			
					AND CAST( CAST(@YEAR AS NVARCHAR(4)) + '-' + CAST(@MONTH AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-28 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) 
					AND dayw = 28 
					AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
					(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
				GROUP BY 
					yearw, monthw, dayw
			) AS TB
		ORDER BY
			datew ASC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--//alteração [4.2]
		--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
		SELECT
			yearw,
			monthw,
			Mono,
			Color,
			Total,
			MonoCost,
			ColorCost,
			TotalCost,
			(CAST(CAST(yearw AS NVARCHAR)+'-'+CAST(monthw AS NVARCHAR)+'-28 00:00:00'  AS DATETIME)) AS datew
		FROM
			(
				SELECT 
					YEAR(Data) AS yearw,
					MONTH(Data) AS monthw,  
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS Mono, 
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Color , 
					SUM(PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN + CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN) AS Total,
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS MonoCost, 
					CAST(SUM(CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS ColorCost , 
					CAST(SUM(PDFV + PDCV + PDIV + PSFV + PSCV + PSIV + CDFV + CDCV + CDIV + CSFV + CSCV + CSIV) AS DECIMAL (19,6)) AS TotalCost
				FROM 
					CubeUser
				WHERE 
					Data BETWEEN @BeginMonth AND @EndMonth AND
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR AccountID = @AccountID) AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR AccountID = @AccountID) OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY
					YEAR(Data),
					MONTH(Data)
			) AS T
		ORDER BY
			Datew ASC
	END 
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@Reason INT = -1,
@CancelType SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = 1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	SELECT
		PolicyID,
		PolicyName,
		PrintJobID,
		Title,
		PrinterDeviceName,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		PrintCost,
		DatePrinted,
		Blocked, -- 0=Usuário | 1=Software
		1 AS Counter
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT
				PJC.PolicyID,
				P.PolicyName,
				PJC.PrintJobID,
				PJC.Title,
				[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName1](PJC.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
				PJC.PagesMono,
				PJC.PagesColor, 
				(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS PrintCost, 
				PJC.DatePrinted,
				PJC.Blocked
			FROM         
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				LEFT JOIN Policies P ON P.PolicyID = PJC.PolicyID
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Reason = -1 OR PJC.PolicyID = @Reason)
				AND (@CancelType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @CancelType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0
		) AS Details
	ORDER BY
		Details.PolicyName ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (Details.Title) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (Details.Title) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesMono END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PagesColor END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesMono END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PagesColor END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC

END
GO
```

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@RemovedType SMALLINT = -1, -- -1=Todos | 0=Usuário | 1=Software
@AccountID INT,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	SELECT
		Blocked, -- 0=Usuário | 1=Software
		PrintJobID,
		Title,
		PrinterDeviceName,
		DatePrinted,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		(PagesMono + PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
		TotalCost,
		1 AS Counter
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT
				PJC.Blocked,
				PJC.PrintJobID,
				PJC.Title,
				[dbo].[GetDefaultPrinterName1](PJC.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
				PJC.DatePrinted,
				PJC.PagesMono,
				PJC.PagesColor, 
				(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost
			FROM         
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
			WHERE
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@RemovedType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @RemovedType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((

		) AS Details
	ORDER BY

		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (Details.Title) END DESC,

### proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserSummary

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedReleaserSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@RemovedType SMALLINT = -1, -- -1=Todos | 0=Usuário | 1=Software
@AccountID INT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		* 
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				D.DomainName,
				CASE AC.FullName 
					WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName	
					WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
					ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
				END AS UserName, 
				CC.CostAccountID,
				ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS CostAccountName,
				COUNT(*) AS TotalJobs,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono) AS MonoPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesColor) AS ColorPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono + PJC.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
				SUM(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
				1 AS Counter
			FROM
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJC.AccountID
				INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
			WHERE 
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@RemovedType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @RemovedType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR	 PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJC.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 1
			GROUP BY
				--PJC.Blocked,
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.FullName,
				AC.LogonName,
				D.DomainName,
				CC.CostAccountID
		) AS PrintJobsCanceledSummary
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END DESC

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedSummary

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrievePrintsBlockedSummary]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@Reason INT = -1,
@CancelType SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterDeviceID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT = 1,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		* 
	FROM
		(
			SELECT
				AC.AccountID,
				D.DomainName,
				ISNULL([dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID), '-') AS CostAccountName,
				CASE AC.FullName 
					WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName	
					WHEN AC.LogonName THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName 
					ELSE AC.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ AC.LogonName +')'
				END AS UserName, 
				COUNT(*) AS TotalJobs,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono) AS MonoPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesColor) AS ColorPages,
				SUM(PJC.PagesMono + PJC.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
				SUM(PJC.CostMono + PJC.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
				1 AS Counter,
				CC.CostAccountID
			FROM
				PrintJobsCanceled PJC
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJC.AccountID
				INNER JOIN Domains D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
				LEFT JOIN CostAccounts CC ON CC.CostAccountID = AC.CostAccountID
			WHERE 
				(DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (@Reason = -1 OR PJC.PolicyID = @Reason)
				AND (@CancelType = -1 OR PJC.Blocked = @CancelType)
				AND (@PrinterDeviceID = -1 OR PJC.PrinterDeviceID = @PrinterDeviceID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJC.SiteID = @SiteID)
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJC.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				AND PJC.IsReleaser = 0
			GROUP BY
				AC.AccountID,
				AC.FullName,
				AC.LogonName,
				D.DomainName,
				CC.CostAccountID
		) AS PrintJobsCanceledSummary
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.DomainName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN (PrintJobsCanceledSummary.UserName) END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalPages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN PrintJobsCanceledSummary.TotalCost END DESC

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveQueuesDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrinterQueueID INT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1
	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2 )
	BEGIN
 		SET @Color = 1
 	END

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,	
		JobOriginID,
		GroupName, 
		Title , 
		DatePrinted , 
		PagesColor,			
		PagesMono,
		Pages,   
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS Counter,
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 			
				PrintJobs.PrintJobID,
				PrintJobs.JobOriginID,
				Accounts.FullName +'  (' +Domains.DomainName +'\'+ Accounts.LogonName +')'  AS GroupName, 
				PrintJobs.Title , 
				PrintJobs.DatePrinted , 
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesMono
					WHEN 2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
					WHEN 1 THEN -1
					WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor + PrintJobs.PagesMono
		     			WHEN 1 THEN  PrintJobs.PagesMono
			      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor + PrintJobs.CostMono
		     			WHEN 1 THEN PrintJobs.CostMono
			      		WHEN 2 THEN PrintJobs.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
 						 WHEN PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE
					'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PrintJobs.PrintWayID, 
				PrintApplicationID,
				PaperSizeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs 
				INNER JOIN Accounts ON PrintJobs.AccountID = Accounts.AccountID 
				INNER JOIN Domains ON Domains.DomainID = Accounts.DomainID
			WHERE
				(PrintJobs.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime) 
				AND (PrintJobs.JobDisabled = 0) 
				AND (@Color =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesColor > 0 ) 
				AND (@Mono =-1 OR PrintJobs.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID=-1 OR PrintJobs.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID=-1 OR PrintJobs.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID =-1 AND PrintJobs.JobTypeID in (1,2,3) ) OR PrintJobs.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND ((@PrinterQueueID = 0 AND PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID IS NULL) 
				OR (@PrinterQueueID =-1 OR PrintJobs.PrinterQueueID = @PrinterQueueID)) 
				AND (@SiteID =-1 OR  PrintJobs.SiteID= @SiteID) 
				AND
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PrintJobs.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PrintJobs.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
		) AS Details
	 		 INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID 
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END ASC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy = 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END DESC

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveQuotasExtract

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveQuotasExtract]
@AccountID INT,
@DateStart DATETIME,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@IsCorporative BIT

AS

BEGIN

	-- *****************************************************************************************
	-- Marco, 2013-06-14, nddPrint 5.0
	-- Alterado para trazer também os créditos do usuário e as suas regras, mesmo método
	-- utilizada a mesma lógica da SP [proc_QuotasRules_RetrieveAll], nesta versão vai ter apenas
	-- quotas por usuário, e não compartilhadas, ou seja, foi comentado as partes para obter
	-- por conta.
	-- *****************************************************************************************
	
	DECLARE @Extract TABLE
		(
			DateRef DATETIME,
			[Type] INT, --1=Crédito, 2=Débito e 3=Expiração
			Title NVARCHAR(200),
			OperatorName NVARCHAR(610),
			TotalPages INT,
			PagesMono INT,
			PagesColor INT,
			MoneyValue DECIMAL (19,6),
			IdentifyCode NVARCHAR(100)
		)

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	IF (@AccountID <> @AccountIDOwner AND @AccountIDOwner <> - 1)
	BEGIN
		IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @AccountIDOwner AND PermissionControlID = 1 AND PermissionAccessID = 9))
		BEGIN 
			-- Significa que o usuário só pode ver os seus dados e/ou seus CCs

			--pega o CC do usuário procurado
			DECLARE @CostAccountID INT
	
			SELECT @CostAccountID = ISNULL(CostAccountID, -1) FROM Accounts WHERE AccountID = @AccountID

			IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.getCostAccountManaged(@AccountIDOwner) WHERE CostAccountID = @CostAccountID))
			BEGIN
				--não tem permissão pra ver os dados desse usuário
				SELECT
					DateRef,
					[Type],
					Title,
					OperatorName,
					TotalPages,
					PagesMono,
					 PagesColor,
					MoneyValue,
					ISNULL(IdentifyCode, '') AS IdentifyCode
				FROM 
					@Extract
				-- Retorna apenas uma linha com o tipo -1, indicando 
				-- que não tem permissão para ver os dados deste usuário.
				SELECT
					-1 AS [Type],
					0 AS TotalPages,
					0 AS PagesMono,
					0 AS PagesColor,
					0.0 AS MoneyValue,
					GETDATE() AS FinishDate,
					'' AS RepeatTimes,
					0 AS IsExpire
					
				RETURN
			END
		END
	END
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	--0 = Desabilitado, 2 = Bloqueante, 3 = Não Bloqueante com aviso, 4 = Não bloqueante
	DECLARE @IsBlocked INT
	SELECT @IsBlocked = CAST(QuotaParameterValue AS INT) FROM QuotasParameters WHERE QuotaParameterID = 2 --QuotasState

	--Inserir os créditos do período
	INSERT INTO
		@Extract
	SELECT 
		QC.CreatedDateTime AS DateRef,
		1  AS [Type],
		'@@Credit +'' C' + CAST(QC.QuotaCreditID AS NVARCHAR) + '''' AS Title,
		QO.OperatorName,
		QC.TotalPages,
		QC.PagesMono,
		QC.PagesColor,
		QC.MoneyValue,
		COALESCE(QIC.IdentifyCode, QIC2.IdentifyCode) AS IdentifyCode
	FROM 
		QuotasCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC  ON QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC2 ON QIC2.QuotaRuleID   = QC.QuotaRuleID
	WHERE 
		QC.AccountID = @AccountID
		AND QC.CreatedDateTime >= @DateStart
		AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema
		AND QO.AccountID <> -2 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo estorno do sistema 
		
	--Inserir os créditos de estorno
	INSERT INTO
		@Extract
	SELECT 
		QC.CreatedDateTime AS DateRef,
		1  AS [Type],
		'@@ChargebackCredit +'' C' + CAST(QC.QuotaCreditID AS NVARCHAR) + '''' AS Title,
		QO.OperatorName,
		QC.TotalPages,
		QC.PagesMono,
		QC.PagesColor,
		QC.MoneyValue,
		COALESCE(QIC.IdentifyCode, QIC2.IdentifyCode) AS IdentifyCode
	FROM 
		QuotasCredits QC
		INNER JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC  ON QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC2 ON QIC2.QuotaRuleID   = QC.QuotaRuleID
	WHERE 
		QC.AccountID = @AccountID
		AND QC.CreatedDateTime >= @DateStart
		AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND QO.AccountID = -2 --Crédito criado pelo estorno do sistema 
		
	--Inserir as expirações do período
	INSERT INTO
		@Extract
	SELECT 
		QE.CreatedDateTime AS DateRef,
		3 AS [Type],
		'@@CreditExpiration +'' C' + CAST(QE.QuotaCreditID AS NVARCHAR) + '''' AS Title,
		QO.OperatorName,
		QE.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QE.ExpensePagesMono,
		QE.ExpensePagesColor,
		QE.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		COALESCE(QIC.IdentifyCode, QIC2.IdentifyCode) AS IdentifyCode
	FROM 
		QuotasExpires QE
		INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaCreditID = QE.QuotaCreditID
		INNER JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC  ON QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		LEFT  JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC2 ON QIC2.QuotaRuleID   = QC.QuotaRuleID
	WHERE 
		QC.AccountID = @AccountID
		AND QE.CreatedDateTime >= @DateStart
		AND (QE.ExpenseTotalPages > 0 OR (QE.ExpensePagesMono > 0 OR QE.ExpensePagesColor > 0) OR QE.ExpenseMoneyValue > 0)
		AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND QC.OperatorID > 1 --Não contar o crédito criado pelo sistema

	--Débitos do período
	INSERT INTO 
		@Extract
	SELECT 
		QD.UsedDateTime AS DateRef,
		2 AS [Type],
		CASE 
			WHEN QD.PrintJobID IS NULL THEN ISNULL(QDD.[Description], '@@PrintingDocument')
			ELSE PJ.Title
		END AS Title,
		'' AS OperatorName,
		SUM(QD.TotalPages) AS TotalPages,
		SUM(QD.PagesMono)  AS PagesMono,
		SUM(QD.PagesColor) AS PagesColor,
		SUM(QD.MoneyValue) AS MoneyValue,
		'' AS IdentifyCode
	FROM 
		QuotasDebits QD
		LEFT JOIN  PrintJobs PJ ON QD.PrintJobID = PJ.PrintJobID
		INNER JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QD.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasDebitsDescriptions QDD ON QDD.QuotaDebitID = QD.QuotaDebitID
	WHERE 
		QD.AccountID = @AccountID
		AND UsedDateTime >= @DateStart
		AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
	GROUP BY
		QD.PrintJobID,
		PJ.Title,
		QDD.[Description],
		QuotaDebitHostID,
		QD.UsedDateTime
	
	-- Extrato
	SELECT
		DateRef,
		[Type],
		Title,
		OperatorName,
		TotalPages,
		PagesMono,
		PagesColor,
		MoneyValue,
		ISNULL(IdentifyCode, '') AS IdentifyCode
	FROM 
		@Extract
	ORDER BY
		DateRef,
		CASE [Type] WHEN 3 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 END, --Ficar na ordem de: Expiração, Crédito e Débito
		Title
		
	-- Créditos
	SELECT
		  1 AS [Type], -- 1 = Crédito de cota, 2 = Regra de crédito de cota
		  QC.TotalPages,
		  QC.PagesMono,
		  QC.PagesColor,
		  QC.MoneyValue,
		  QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		  QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		  QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		  QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		  QC.FinishDate,
		  '' AS RepeatTimes,
		  0 AS IsExpire
	FROM
		  QuotasCredits QC
		  LEFT JOIN QuotasRules QR ON QR.QuotaRuleID = QC.QuotaRuleID
		  LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QC.OperatorID
		  LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaCreditID = QC.QuotaCreditID
	WHERE
		  (QC.AccountID = @AccountID)
		  --AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QC.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		  AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		  AND QC.OperatorID <> 1 --Não exibe os créditos quando o usuário fica negativo
		  AND QC.FinishDate IS NOT NULL --Obtém somente os créditos que expirão, pois os outros estão inclusos no balanço
		  AND QC.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
	
	UNION ALL 
	  
	 --Regras de créditos com expiração
	SELECT
		2 AS [Type],
		QR.TotalPages,
		QR.PagesMono,
		QR.PagesColor,
		QR.MoneyValue,
		QC.ExpenseTotalPages,
		QC.ExpensePagesMono,
		QC.ExpensePagesColor,
		QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QP.NextDate,
		CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN ''
				ELSE '(' + CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) + ')'
			END AS Recurrences,
		QP.IsExpire
	FROM
		QuotasRules QR
		LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
	WHERE
		(QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
		--AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND QR.[Enabled] = 1
		AND QC.[Enabled] = 1
		AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
		AND QR.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND QP.IsExpire = 1
		
	UNION ALL
	
	 --Regras de créditos sem expiração
	SELECT
		2 AS [Type],
		QR.TotalPages,
		QR.PagesMono,
		QR.PagesColor,
		QR.MoneyValue,
		-1, -1, -1, -1, --QC.ExpenseTotalPages, QC.ExpensePagesMono, QC.ExpensePagesColor, QC.ExpenseMoneyValue,
		QP.NextDate,
		CASE QP.RepeatTimes -- Aqui trata quando tem ou não recorrencia
				WHEN 0 THEN ''
				ELSE '(' + CAST(QP.RepeatedTimes AS NVARCHAR) + '/'+ CAST(QP.RepeatTimes AS NVARCHAR) + ')'
			END AS Recurrences,
		QP.IsExpire
	FROM
		QuotasRules QR
		LEFT JOIN QuotasPeriods QP ON QP.QuotaPeriodID = QR.QuotaPeriodID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasOperators QO ON QO.OperatorID = QR.OperatorID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasIdentifiesCodes QIC ON QIC.QuotaRuleID = QR.QuotaRuleID
	WHERE
		(QR.AccountID = @AccountID)
		--AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR QR.CostAccountID = @CostAccountID)
		AND [Enabled] = 1
		AND IsDefaultQuota = 0
		AND QR.IsCorporative = @IsCorporative
		AND (QP.IsExpire = 0 OR QR.QuotaPeriodID IS NULL)
	ORDER BY
		[Type],
		FinishDate
		
END
GO
```

```sql

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveQuotasPrepaidCardCodeSummary]
@CardCode NVARCHAR(12)

AS

BEGIN
	
	SELECT 
		QPCC.CardCode,
		QPCB.MoneyValue,
		QPCB.BatchID,
		QPCB.ExpirationDate,
		QPCB.GenerationDate,
		QPCC.QuotaCreditID,
		dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
		QC.CreatedDateTime
	FROM
		QuotasPrepaidCardsCodes QPCC
		INNER JOIN QuotasPrepaidCardsBatches QPCB ON QPCC.BatchID = QPCB.BatchID
		LEFT JOIN QuotasCredits QC ON QC.QuotaCreditID = QPCC.QuotaCreditID
		LEFT JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = QC.AccountID
		LEFT JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
	WHERE
		QPCC.CardCode = @CardCode 
		
END
GO
```
