### proc_Reports_RetrieveStampLogonSummary

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStampLogonSummary]
@StampLogonID NVARCHAR(32),
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT
	
AS

BEGIN
	-- =============================================
	-- Author:		Douglas Ribeiro de Macedo
	-- Create date: 28/05/2014
	-- Description:	Buscar relatório resumo por código de rastreio
	-- =============================================

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForQuotasReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	SELECT
		dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, AC.LogonName, AC.FullName) AS UserName,
		dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName3(PJ.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterDeviceName,
		PJ.Title,
		PJ.DatePrinted,
		ISNULL(M.MachineName, '@@WithoutMachine') AS MachineName,
		PA.PrintApplicationName,
		PJ.PrintWayID,
		PS.PaperSizeName,
		(PJ.PagesMono + PJ.PagesColor) AS TotalPages,
		PJ.PagesMono,
		PJ.PagesColor,
		(PJ.CostMono + PJ.CostColor) AS TotalCost,
		PA.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM
		PrintJobs PJ
		INNER JOIN StampLogonJobs SLJ ON PJ.PrintJobID = SLJ.PrintJobID
		INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = PJ.AccountID
		INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON D.DomainID = AC.DomainID
		LEFT  JOIN PrintersQueues PQ ON PQ.PrinterQueueID = PJ.PrinterQueueID
		LEFT  JOIN Machines M ON M.MachineID = PQ.MachineID
		INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON PA.PrintApplicationID = PJ.PrintApplicationID
		INNER JOIN PapersSize PS ON PS.PaperSizeID = PJ.PaperSizeID
	WHERE
		SLJ.StampLogonID = @StampLogonID
		AND ((
			@UseORMethod = 0 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR AC.AccountID = @AccountID)
				AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		)
		OR
		(
			@UseORMethod = 1 
			AND
			(
				(@AccountID = -1 OR AC.AccountID = @AccountID)
				OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
			)
		))

END

CREATE PROCEDURE proc_PoliciesMembers_RetrieveAllDataCollector
AS
BEGIN

--#######################################################################################
--Roger 27/08/2025
--Criado por causa destes cases antes era uma view agora foi transformada em procedure
--#######################################################################################

DECLARE @PoliciesMemberTempList TABLE (Id INT, PolicyID INT, UserID INT, UserGroupID INT, PrinterID INT,PrinterGroupID INT, Removed BIT, UpdatedDate DATETIME)

--Faz o insert na tabela temporaria
INSERT @PoliciesMemberTempList
SELECT 
	PolicyMemberID AS ID, 
	PolicyID, 
	CASE (PolicyMemberType) WHEN 1 THEN ObjectID WHEN 5 THEN ObjectID ELSE 0 END AS UserID, 
	CASE (PolicyMemberType) WHEN 2 THEN ObjectID ELSE 0 END AS UserGroupID,
	CASE (PolicyMemberType) WHEN 3 THEN ObjectID WHEN 5 THEN PrinterDeviceID ELSE 0 END AS PrinterID, 
	CASE (PolicyMemberType)  WHEN 4 THEN ObjectID ELSE 0 END AS PrinterGroupID,
	CAST(0 AS BIT) AS Removed, 
	UpdatedDate
FROM PoliciesMembers
UNION ALL
SELECT      
	PolicyMemberID AS ID, 
	0 AS PolicyID, 
	0 AS UserID, 
	0 AS UserGroupID,
	0 AS PrinterID, 
	0 AS PrinterGroupID,
	CAST(1 AS BIT) AS Removed, 
	RemovedDate AS UpdatedDate
FROM           
	PoliciesMembersRemoved

--Retorna os dados com os Guids
SELECT 
	PT.ID, 
	P.PolicyGuidID AS PolicyGuidId,
	A.AccountGuidId,
	PT.UserGroupID,
	PD.PrinterDeviceConfigurationId,
	PT.PrinterGroupID,
	PT.Removed,
	PT.UpdatedDate
FROM 
	@PoliciesMemberTempList AS PT
	LEFT JOIN Policies AS P ON P.PolicyID= PT.PolicyID
	LEFT JOIN Accounts AS A ON A.AccountID = PT.UserID
	LEFT JOIN PrintersDevices AS PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID =PT.PrinterID
END

GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopApps

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopApps]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			PA.PrintApplicationName,
			TotalPages,
			PA.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID		
			) AS P
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			PA.PrintApplicationName, 
			TotalPages,
			PA.PrintApplicationResource
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					PrintApplicationID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.PrintApplicationID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.PrintApplicationID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							PrintJobs P 
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.PrintApplicationID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.PrintApplicationID
			) AS P
				 INNER JOIN PrintApplications PA ON P.PrintApplicationID = PA.PrintApplicationID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
			
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostAccount] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT 
		*
	FROM 
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters
	
	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)
	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data  BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostAccountName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.CostAccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime)
							AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostCenter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopCostCenter] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostCenterName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM (
				SELECT
					CostAccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data  BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			C.CostAccountID,
			[dbo].[GetCostAccountName](CC.CostAccountID) AS CostCenterName,
			TotalPages, 0 AS TotalCost,
			0 AS TotalGeral
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					CostAccountID,
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(  
						SELECT
							C.CostAccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.CostAccountID
							
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.CostAccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime)
							AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							--//alteração [4.2]
							--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.CostAccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.CostAccountID
			) AS C
				 INNER JOIN CostAccounts CC ON C.CostAccountID = CC.CostAccountID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopExcededDisabled

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopExcededDisabled] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID,@AccountIDOwner,@StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END

	SELECT top 10	C.AccountID, CASE A.FullName 	WHEN '' THEN D.DomainName +'\'+ A.LogonName	
									ELSE A.FullName + ' (' + D.DomainName +'\'+ A.LogonName +')'END AS FullName, 
					TotalPrinted, TotalAllowed, Balance 
			FROM (
					SELECT	AccountID, SUM(10) AS TotalPrinted, 
							SUM(20) AS TotalAllowed, SUM(10) AS Balance
						FROM (  

								SELECT	P.AccountID, SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages, 
										100 AS TotalAllowed, 20 - SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS Balance
									FROM PrintJobs P 
										WHERE	(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR
													(P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) AND 
													((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime) ) OR 
													(p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime)) AND
												(P.JobDisabled = 0 )	AND 
												(P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3))	AND -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
												--//alteração [4.2]
												--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
												((
													@UseORMethod= 0 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												)
												OR
												(
													@UseORMethod= 1 
													AND
													(
														(@AccountID = -1			OR		P.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
														(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
													)
												))

 										GROUP BY P.AccountID
							) AS T
						GROUP BY T.AccountID		
				) AS C				
				INNER JOIN Accounts			A ON C.AccountID	= A.AccountID
				INNER JOIN Domains			D ON A.DomainID		= D.DomainID
		WHERE ((TotalAllowed - TotalPrinted) < 0)
		Order BY Balance Desc
END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopPrinter] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END
	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2
	
	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME

	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	SELECT @StartDateTime = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@StartDateTime AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)
	SELECT @EndDateTime   = CAST(FLOOR(CAST(@EndDateTime   AS FLOAT)) AS DATETIME)

	IF (DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndTime = CAST(CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS CHAR(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00' AS DATETIME)
	END
		
	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(HOUR, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(MINUTE, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(SECOND, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END
			
	IF @AccountID <> -1 
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10 
			DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID,  
			dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
			PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
			--PrintersDevices.Model AS DriverName, 
			TotalPages,  
			TotalCost 
		FROM 
			( 
				SELECT 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID, 
					SUM(PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono) AS TotalPages,  
					SUM(PJ.CostColor  + PJ.CostMono)  AS TotalCost
				FROM          
					PrintJobs PJ
				WHERE 
					(PJ.DatePrinted between @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
					AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0)
					AND (JobTypeID in (1,2,3))-- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
					AND (@SiteID = -1 OR PJ.SiteID = @SiteID)
					AND 
					--//alteração [4.2]
					--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND  (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR PJ.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY 
					PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			) AS DevicesSummary
				 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = DevicesSummary.PrinterDeviceID
				 INNER JOIN PrintersModels PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
		WHERE 
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY 
			TotalPages DESC 
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID, 
				--dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName ,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				--PD.Model AS DriverName,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(

					SELECT
						C.PrinterDeviceID,
						SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						CubePrinter C
					WHERE
						C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
						AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
						AND
						--//alteração [4.2]
						--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
						(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
					GROUP BY
						C.PrinterDeviceID
						
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC

		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 10
				D.PrinterDeviceID, 
				--dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName ,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName4(PD.PrinterDeviceID) AS PrinterName,  
				--PD.Model AS DriverName,
				PM.PrinterModelName AS DriverName,
				TotalPages,
				0 AS TotalCost
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT
						PrinterDeviceID, 
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM 
						(  
							SELECT
								C.PrinterDeviceID,
								SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								CubePrinter C 
							WHERE
								C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
								AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//aqui só pode testar os CCs
								(@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
							GROUP BY
								C.PrinterDeviceID
							
							UNION ALL
							
							SELECT
								P.PrinterDeviceID, 
								SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
							FROM 
								PrintJobs P 
							WHERE	
								(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime)) OR (P.DatePrinted between (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime)) 
								AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime)) OR (p.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
								AND (P.JobDisabled = 0 )
								AND (P.JobTypeID in (1,2,3)) -- precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
								AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR		P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))--//alteração [4.2] -- aqui só pode testar os CCs
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							GROUP BY 
								P.PrinterDeviceID
						) AS T
					GROUP BY
						T.PrinterDeviceID		
				) AS D
					 INNER JOIN PrintersDevices	PD ON D.PrinterDeviceID = PD.PrinterDeviceID 
					 INNER JOIN PrintersModels  PM ON PM.PrinterModelID = PD.PrinterModelID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC
		END
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopType

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopType]
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostCenterID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(accountID INT, costCenterID INT, useORMethod BIT, buildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO @Parameters
		SELECT * FROM [dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @buildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostCenterID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @buildListType = buildListType FROM @Parameters --*****************

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@buildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@buildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (datepart(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND datepart(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  datepart(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = cast( cast(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + cast(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + cast(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	cast(	cast(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + cast(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + cast(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((datepart(hh, @StartTime) + 	datepart(mi, @StartTime)  + datepart(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
		END

	IF((datepart(hh, @EndTime) + 	datepart(mi, @EndTime)  + datepart(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
		Begin
			SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
		END
		
	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		-- Type 1 - Impressão
		SELECT
			JobTypeID,
			TypeName,
			TotalPages
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					'1' AS JobTypeID,
					'@@Printing' AS TypeName,
					TotalPages--,	0 AS TotalCost
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							(
								SELECT
									'1' AS JobTypeID,
									SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
								FROM
									CubeUser C
								WHERE
									C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
									AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
									AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
									((
										@UseORMethod= 0 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
											(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									)
									OR
									(
										@UseORMethod= 1 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
											(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									))
							) AS T	
					) AS T
				
				UNION ALL
				
				SELECT
					'2' AS JobTypeID,
					'@@Copy' AS TypeName,
					TotalPages--,	0 AS TotalCost
				FROM
					(					
						SELECT
							SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							(
								SELECT
									'2' AS JobTypeID,
									SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN) AS TotalPages
								FROM
									CubeUser C
								WHERE
									C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
									AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
									AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
									((
										@UseORMethod= 0 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
											AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									)
									OR
									(
										@UseORMethod= 1 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
											OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									))
								) AS T	
							) AS T				
						
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							'3' AS JobTypeID,
							'@@ReceivedFax' AS TypeName,
								TotalPages--,	0 AS TotalCost
						FROM
							(					
								SELECT
									SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
								FROM
									(
										SELECT
											'3' AS JobTypeID,
											SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN) AS TotalPages
										FROM
											CubeUser C
										WHERE
											C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
											AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
											AND
											--//alteração [4.2]
											--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
											((
												@UseORMethod= 0 
												AND
												(
													(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
													AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
												)
											)
											OR
											(
												@UseORMethod= 1 
												AND
												(
													(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
													OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
												)
											))
									) AS T	
							) AS T		
			) AS T 
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN		
		-- Type 1 - Impressão
		SELECT
			JobTypeID,
			TypeName,
			TotalPages
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					'1' AS JobTypeID,
					'@@Printing' AS TypeName,
					TotalPages --, 0 AS TotalCost						
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
						FROM
							(
								SELECT
									'1' AS JobTypeID,
									SUM(CDIN + CSIN + PDIN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
								FROM
									CubeUser C
								WHERE
									C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
									AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
									AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
									((
										@UseORMethod= 0 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
											AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									)
									OR
									(
										@UseORMethod= 1 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
											OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									))
									
								UNION ALL
								
								SELECT
									JobTypeID,
									SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
								FROM 
									PrintJobs P
								WHERE
									(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
									OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
									AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
									OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
									AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
									AND (P.JobTypeID =1) --JobType 1
									AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
									AND
									--//alteração [4.2]
									--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
									((
										@UseORMethod= 0 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
											AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									)
									OR
									(
										@UseORMethod= 1 
										AND
										(
											(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
											OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
										)
									))
						GROUP BY 
							P.JobTypeID
					) AS T	
			) AS T
			
			UNION ALL
			
			SELECT
				'2' AS JobTypeID,
				'@@Copy' AS TypeName,
				TotalPages--,	0 AS TotalCost
			FROM
				(
					SELECT
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								'2' AS JobTypeID,
								SUM(CDCN + CSCN + PDCN + PSCN) AS TotalPages
							FROM
								CubeUser C
							WHERE
								C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
								AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
								((
									@UseORMethod= 0 
									AND
									(
										(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
									)
								)
								OR
								(
									@UseORMethod= 1 
									AND
									(
										(@AccountID = -1			OR		C.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
										(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT costCenterID FROM @CCIDList))
									)
								))

							UNION ALL
							
							SELECT

							FROM

							WHERE
								(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
								OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
								AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
								OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
								AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
								AND (P.JobTypeID =2) --JobType 2
								AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
								AND
								--//alteração [4.2]
								--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
								((
									@UseORMethod= 0 
									AND
									(

							GROUP BY

			UNION ALL
			
			SELECT
				'3' AS JobTypeID,
				'@@ReceivedFax' AS TypeName,
				TotalPages--,	0 AS TotalCost
			FROM
				(
					SELECT
						SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
					FROM
						(
							SELECT
								'3' AS JobTypeID,
								SUM(CDFN + CSFN + PDFN + PSFN) AS TotalPages

								((

								OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopUser

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveStatisticsTopUser] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@EndDateTime DATETIME = NULL,
@CostAccountID INT = -1,
@AccountIDOwner INT,
@SiteID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	--Quando ambas as datas forem nulas, então é pra Visão Resumo e busca somente do mês corrente
	IF (@StartDateTime IS NULL AND @EndDateTime IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		--Altera a data inicial para o primeiro dia do mês atual e a data final para um dia anterior da data atual
		DECLARE @DateTimeNow DATETIME
		
		SELECT @DateTimeNow = GETDATE()--'2013-10-31 10:24'--
		SELECT @StartDateTime = DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, @DateTimeNow),0)
		SELECT @EndDateTime   = DATEADD(SECOND, -1, DATEADD(DAY, 0, FLOOR(CONVERT(FLOAT, @DateTimeNow))))
	END
	
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE (AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT 
		*
	FROM 
		[dbo].[getParametersForReports](@CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario
	DECLARE @AccountID INT --vai vir com valor se precisar pegar os dados do usuario

	SELECT @AccountID = AccountID, @CostAccountID = CostAccountID, @UseORMethod = UseORMethod, @BuildListType = BuildListType FROM @Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
			SELECT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO @CCIDList 
				SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @StartTime DATETIME, @EndTime DATETIME
	
	SELECT  @StartTime = @StartDateTime, @EndTime = @EndDateTime

	IF (DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) = 23 AND DATEPART(mi, @EndTime) = 59 AND  DATEPART(ss, @EndTime) = 59)
	BEGIN

		SET @EndTime = CAST( CAST(YEAR(@EndTime) AS char(4) ) + '-' + CAST(MONTH(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + '-' + CAST(DAY(@EndTime) AS NVARCHAR(2)) + ' 00:00:00'    AS DATETIME)

	END

	SELECT 	@StartDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@StartDateTime) AS char(4)) +  Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@StartDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME),

			@EndDateTime	=	CAST(	CAST(YEAR(@EndDateTime) AS char(4)) +   Right('0' + CAST(MONTH(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2) + 
										 Right('0' + CAST(DAY(@EndDateTime)  AS NVARCHAR(2)), 2)    AS DATETIME) 
		
	IF((DATEPART(hh, @StartTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @StartTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @StartTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @StartDateTime = @StartDateTime + 1
	END

	IF((DATEPART(hh, @EndTime) + 	DATEPART(mi, @EndTime)  + DATEPART(ss, @EndTime)) > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @EndDateTime = @EndDateTime - 1
	END

	IF(@StartDateTime = @StartTime AND @EndDateTime = @EndTime)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			A.AccountID,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, A.LogonName, A.FullName) AS AccountName,
			A.LogonName,
			--CASE A.FullName WHEN '' 
			--	THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName
			--	ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.FullName 
			--END AS AccountName, 
			TotalPages,
			0 AS TotalCost
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					C.AccountID,
					SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					CubeUser C
				WHERE
					C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
					AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
					AND
					((
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
							AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
							OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					))
				GROUP BY
					C.AccountID
			) AS T
				 INNER JOIN Accounts A ON T.AccountID = A.AccountID
				 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
		WHERE
			TotalPages > 0
		ORDER BY
			TotalPages DESC
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT TOP 10
			A.AccountID,
			dbo.GetUserNameDefault(D.DomainName, A.LogonName, A.FullName) AS AccountName,
			A.LogonName,
			--CASE A.FullName WHEN '' 
			--	THEN D.DomainName + '\' + A.LogonName
			--	ELSE D.DomainName + '\' + A.FullName 
			--END AS AccountName, 
			TotalPages,	
			0 AS TotalCost
		FROM
			(
				SELECT
					AccountID, 
					SUM(TotalPages) AS TotalPages
				FROM
					(
						SELECT
							C.AccountID,
							SUM(CDFN + CDCN + CDIN + CSFN + CSCN + CSIN + PDFN + PDCN + PDIN + PSFN + PSCN + PSIN) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							CubeUser C
						WHERE
							C.Data BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR C.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR C.AccountID	 = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR C.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY
							C.AccountID
						
						UNION ALL
						
						SELECT
							P.AccountID,
							SUM(P.PagesColor + P.PagesMono) AS TotalPages
						FROM 
							PrintJobs P
						WHERE
							(((P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @StartDateTime) AND (@StartTime <> @StartDateTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN (@EndDateTime + 1) AND @EndTime))
							AND ((DAY(@StartTime) = DAY(@EndTime) AND (@EndTime < @StartTime))
							OR (P.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartTime AND @EndTime))
							AND (P.JobDisabled = 0)
							AND (P.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) --Precisa pra tirar fora os scan e fax enviado. ao tem estatistica de digitalização (ainda)
							AND (@SiteID = -1 OR P.SiteID = @SiteID)
							AND 
							((
								@UseORMethod= 0 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									AND (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							)
							OR
							(
								@UseORMethod= 1 
								AND
								(
									(@AccountID = -1 OR P.AccountID = @AccountID)
									OR (@CostAccountID = -1 OR P.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
								)
							))
						GROUP BY 
							P.AccountID
					) AS T
				GROUP BY
					T.AccountID		
			) AS T
				 INNER JOIN Accounts A ON T.AccountID = A.AccountID
				 INNER JOIN [Domains] D ON A.DomainID = D.DomainID
			WHERE
				TotalPages > 0
			ORDER BY
				TotalPages DESC
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersDetails

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Reports_RetrieveUsersDetails] 
@StartDateTime DATETIME,
@EndDateTime DATETIME,
@PrintColorID SMALLINT = -1,
@PaperSizeID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintApplicationID SMALLINT = -1,
@PrintWayID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobOriginID SMALLINT = -1,
@JobTypeID SMALLINT = -1,
@OrderBy SMALLINT =1 ,
@Classify SMALLINT = -1,
@SiteID INT = -1,
@SiteDivisionID INT = -1,
@AccountID INT = -1,
@CostAccountID INT = -1, 
@AccountIDOwner INT 

AS

BEGIN

	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--A partir da versão 4.2
	-- * Verificação das permissões do usuário de visualização do usuário dentro das SPs.
	--////////////////////////////////////////////////
	--/// início

	DECLARE @CCIDList TABLE (CostAccountID INT) -- tabela que contém a lista de centros de custo que serão pesquisados dependendo  do filtro e da permissão do usuário
	DECLARE @Parameters TABLE(AccountID INT, CostAccountID INT, UseORMethod BIT, BuildListType INT) --TABELA COM OS PARAMETROS DAS PERMISSOES

	INSERT INTO
		@Parameters
	SELECT
		*
	FROM
		[dbo].[getParametersForAccountsReports](@AccountID, @CostAccountID, @AccountIDOwner, @StartDateTime, @EndDateTime)

	--EXTRAIR OS PARAMETROS DA TABELA
	DECLARE @UseORMethod BIT -- 0: indica que será usado o operador E na consulta (maioria dos cacos) 1: indica o operador OU (para os casos que tem que trazer dados dos CCs E do usuário)
	DECLARE @BuildListType INT -- 0: lista vazia; 1: lista de filhos dos ccs; 2: lista de ccs gerenciados do usuario

	SELECT
		@AccountID = AccountID, 
		@CostAccountID = CostAccountID, 
		@UseORMethod = UseORMethod, 
		@BuildListType = BuildListType
	FROM 
		@Parameters

	--preenche a lista de Centros de custo que serão usados nessa consulta
	IF (@BuildListType = 1)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO
			@CCIDList 
		SELECT
			CostAccountID
		FROM
			dbo.[getCostAccountChildrenTable](@CostAccountID) --Lista recebe os filhos do CC procurado
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@BuildListType = 2)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO
				@CCIDList 
			SELECT DISTINCT
				CostAccountID
			FROM
				dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@AccountIDOwner)  --traz a lista dos ccs gerenciados por esse usuario		
		END
	END

	--/// fim das alterações da 4.2

	DECLARE @Color SMALLINT 
	DECLARE @Mono SMALLINT 

	SET @Mono = - 1
	SET @Color =  -1

	IF (@PrintColorID = 1)
	BEGIN
		SET @Mono = 1
	END
	ELSE IF (@PrintColorID = 2)
	BEGIN
		SET @Color = 1
	END

	SELECT 
		PrintJobID,
		JobOriginID,	
		GroupName, 
		Title,
		DatePrinted, 
		PagesColor, 
		PagesMono,
		Pages,  
		PrintCost, 
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationName, 
		PrintColorName,
		PrintWayID, 
		PapersSize.PaperSizeName ,
		1 AS [Counter],
		PrintApplications.PrintApplicationResource
	FROM 
		(
			SELECT 
				PJ.PrintJobID,
				PJ.JobOriginID,
				dbo.GetDefaultPrinterName1(PJ.Printerdeviceid) AS GroupName, 
				PJ.Title , 
				PJ.DatePrinted , 
				CASE @PrintColorID 
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  1 THEN PJ.PagesMono
					WHEN  2 THEN -1
				END AS PagesMono,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor
					WHEN  1 THEN -1
					WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor
				END AS PagesColor,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.PagesColor + PJ.PagesMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN  PJ.PagesMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.PagesColor 
				END AS Pages,
				CASE @PrintColorID
					WHEN -1 THEN PJ.CostColor + PJ.CostMono
	     			WHEN  1 THEN PJ.CostMono
		      		WHEN  2 THEN PJ.CostColor
				END AS PrintCost,
				CASE  
     				WHEN PJ.PagesColor > 0  THEN 'Color'
					ELSE 'Mono'
				END AS PrintColorName,
				PJ.PrintWayID,
				PJ.PrintApplicationID,
				PJ.PaperSizeID
			FROM         
				PrintJobs PJ
				INNER JOIN PrintersDevices PD ON PD.PrinterDeviceID = PJ.PrinterDeviceID
			WHERE
				(PJ.DatePrinted BETWEEN @StartDateTime AND @EndDateTime)
				AND (PJ.JobDisabled = 0 ) 
				AND (@Color = -1 OR PJ.PagesColor > 0 ) AND	(@Mono = -1 OR PJ.PagesMono > 0 ) 
				AND (@PaperSizeID = -1 OR PJ.PaperSizeID = @PaperSizeID) 
				AND (@PrintApplicationID = -1 OR PJ.PrintApplicationID = @PrintApplicationID) 
				AND (@PrintWayID = -1 OR PJ.PrintWayID = @PrintWayID) 
				AND (@JobOriginID= -1 OR PJ.JobOriginID = @JobOriginID) 
				AND ((@JobTypeID = -1 AND PJ.JobTypeID IN (1,2,3)) OR PJ.JobTypeID = @JobTypeID)
				AND (@SiteID = -1 OR  PJ.SiteID = @SiteID) 
				AND (@SiteDivisionID = -1 OR PD.SiteDivisionID = @SiteDivisionID)
				AND
				--//alteração [4.2]
				--//testa com o operador E qnd é jobs do usuário no CC ou operador OU qnd é jobs do usuário + jobs do cc
				(
					(
						@UseORMethod= 0 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			AND 
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
					OR
					(
						@UseORMethod= 1 
						AND
						(
							(@AccountID = -1			OR		PJ.AccountID				= @AccountID)			OR
							(@CostAccountID = -1 OR		PJ.CostAccountID IN (SELECT CostAccountID FROM @CCIDList))
						)
					)
				)
		) AS Details
		     INNER JOIN PrintApplications ON Details.PrintApplicationID = PrintApplications.PrintApplicationID
			 INNER JOIN PapersSize ON Details.PaperSizeID = PapersSize.PaperSizeID 
	ORDER BY
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.GroupName END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.GroupName END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.DatePrinted END ASC, 
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 1 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.DatePrinted END DESC,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.Pages END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 2 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.Pages END desc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 1) THEN Details.PrintCost END asc,
		CASE WHEN (@OrderBy= 3 AND @Classify = 2) THEN Details.PrintCost END desc

END
GO
```

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_Exists]
@ScheduledReportName NVARCHAR(150),
@OwnerAccountID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	DECLARE @Count INT
	SET @Count = 0

	IF (@OwnerAccountID <> -1)
	BEGIN

		FROM

		WHERE

			AND OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		SELECT

		FROM

			AND OwnerAccountID IS NULL
	END
	
	SELECT @Count
	
END
GO
```

### proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllFromOwner

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllFromOwner] 
@OwnerAccountID INT = -1

AS

BEGIN

	IF @OwnerAccountID =-1
	BEGIN
		PRINT 'USUÁRIO PARCEIRO'

		SELECT  
			SR.*, 
			R.ReportName, 
			'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource  
		FROM 
		ScheduledReports SR
		INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
		LEFT JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
		WHERE
			NOT ((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3))
			AND ((OwnerAccountID IS NULL) OR (SR.OwnerAccountID = AC.AccountID))
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @ShowCountersOnWeb CHAR
		SET @ShowCountersOnWeb = '1'

		SET @ShowCountersOnWeb = (SELECT ParameterValue FROM Parameters WHERE ParameterName = 'ShowCountersOnWeb')

		IF (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM AccountsPermissions WHERE AccountID = @OwnerAccountID AND PermissionControlID = 1 AND PermissionAccessID = 9))
		BEGIN 
			PRINT 'USUÁRIO ADMINISTRADOR'
			-- Significa que o usuário pode ver todos os CCs 

			SELECT  
				SR.*, 
				R.ReportName, 
				'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource              
			FROM 
				ScheduledReports SR
				INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
			WHERE 
				OwnerAccountID IS NOT NULL
				AND NOT((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3 )) AND
				(((ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '0')  AND SR.ReportID NOT IN  (19,17,16,24)) OR (ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '1'))
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN 
			PRINT 'USUÁRIO N-SERVER: Pega os seus e os de seus CCs gerenciados '
			-- Significa que o usuário só pode ver os seus dados e/ou seus CCs

			SELECT  
				SR.*, 
				R.ReportName, 
				'@@' + ReportName AS ReportNameResource              
			FROM 
				ScheduledReports SR           
				INNER JOIN Reports R ON R.ReportID = SR.ReportID
				INNER JOIN Accounts AC ON AC.AccountID = SR.OwnerAccountID
			WHERE 
				(OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID OR AC.CostAccountID IN (SELECT DISTINCT CostAccountID FROM dbo.[getCostAccountManaged](@OwnerAccountID)))
				AND NOT((SR.LastSendStatus = 2 AND SR.PeriodTypeID = 3 )) AND
				(((ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '0')  AND SR.ReportID NOT IN  (19,17,16,24)) OR (ISNULL(@ShowCountersOnWeb, '1') = '1'))
		END
	END

END
GO
```

### proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllToSend

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_RetrieveAllToSend] 
@SendDate DATETIME

AS

BEGIN

	--**************************************************************************************
	-- ROBSON , 01/06
	-- ALTERADO PARA O UPDATE 4.12 PARA NÃO DAR MAIS ERRO QUANDO O ULTIMO CAMPO ERA NULO.
	-- APLICADO NA 4.11 NO DC.
	-- Alterado tmb para deletar eventuais agendamentos de usuários que nem existem mais
	-- RAFAEl, 26-05-2014
	-- Adicionando a coluna ErrorDescription ao select.
	--**************************************************************************************

	DELETE FROM 
		ScheduledReports 
	WHERE
		OwnerAccountID IS NOT NULL
		AND OwnerAccountID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT AccountID FROM Accounts)

	SELECT  
		ScheduledReports.ScheduledReportID,
		ScheduledReports.ScheduledReportName,
		ScheduledReports.ReportID,
		ScheduledReports.PeriodTypeID,
		ScheduledReports.PeriodDay,
		ScheduledReports.SendToCostAccountManager,
		ScheduledReports.SendToEmailListXML,
		ScheduledReports.OwnerAccountID,
		ScheduledReports.LastSendStatus,
		ScheduledReports.NextSendDate,
		ScheduledReports.FilterListXML,
		ScheduledReports.Language,
		ScheduledReports.ExtendedType,
		ScheduledReports.ExtendedDayOrWeek,
		ISNULL(ScheduledReports.ExtendedDate,GETDATE()) AS ExtendedDate, 
		ISNULL(ScheduledReports.ErrorDescription, '') AS ErrorDescription,
		Reports.ReportName
	FROM 
		ScheduledReports
		INNER JOIN Reports ON ScheduledReports.ReportID = Reports.ReportID
	WHERE 
		(datepart(DAY,NextSendDate) =  datepart(DAY,@SendDate)) AND
		(datepart(MONTH,NextSendDate) = datepart(MONTH,@SendDate) ) AND
		(datepart(YEAR,NextSendDate) = datepart(YEAR,@SendDate) )  AND 
	    (LastSendStatus = 1 OR LastSendStatus = 3 ) --Status ToSend ou Status Failed

END
GO
```

### proc_Scheduler_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Scheduler_Update]
@ScheduledReportID INT,
@ScheduledReportName NVARCHAR(150)=NULL,
@ReportID INT,
@PeriodTypeID INT,
@PeriodDay INT,
@SendToCostAccountManager INT  = NULL,
@SendToEmailListXML image,
@OwnerAccountID INT=NULL,
@LastSendStatus INT,
@NextSendDate DATETIME = NULL,
@FilterListXML image,
@Language NVARCHAR(5), 
@ExtendedType INT, 
@ExtendedDayOrWeek INT, 
@ExtendedDate DATETIME = NULL,

	UPDATE

		ReportID= @ReportID, 
		PeriodTypeID = @PeriodTypeID, 
		PeriodDay = @PeriodDay, 
		SendToCostAccountManager = @SendToCostAccountManager,
		SendToEmailListXML = @SendToEmailListXML, 
		OwnerAccountID = @OwnerAccountID, 
		LastSendStatus = @LastSendStatus, 
		NextSendDate = @NextSendDate, 
		FilterListXML = @FilterListXML,
		[Language] = @Language,
		ExtendedType = @ExtendedType,
		ExtendedDayOrWeek = @ExtendedDayOrWeek,
		ExtendedDate = @ExtendedDate,
		ErrorDescription = @ErrorDescription
	WHERE 
		ScheduledReportID = @ScheduledReportID

END
```

### proc_Sites_RetrieveIDDefaultSite

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_Sites_RetrieveIDDefaultSite]
AS
 
BEGIN

	DECLARE @SiteID INT

	SELECT 
		@SiteID = SiteID
	FROM 
		Sites 
	WHERE 
		IsDefault = 1

	IF(@SiteID IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		UPDATE 
			Sites 
		SET 
			IsDefault = 1 
		WHERE 
			SiteID IN (SELECT SiteID FROM (SELECT TOP 1 COUNT(*) AS C, SiteID FROM Machines GROUP BY SiteID ORDER BY C DESC) AS T)

		SELECT 
			@SiteID = SiteID
		FROM 
			Sites 
		WHERE 
			IsDefault = 1
	END

	SELECT ISNULL(@SiteID, -1)

END
GO
```

### proc_SubNetworks_Find

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_Find] 
@SiteID INT = 0,
@SubNetworkID INT = 0,
@subNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15) = NULL
AS

 SELECT SubNetworkID 
 FROM SubNetworks 
 WHERE(
    (SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID OR @SubNetworkID = 0 )   AND 
    (SiteID = @SiteID OR @SiteID = 0)  AND
    (subNetworkAddress = @subNetworkAddress OR @subNetworkAddress IS NULL)
  )
GO
```

### proc_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_RetrieveAll]
@SiteID INT = 0,
@IgnoreSiteID BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
 

	IF (@IgnoreSiteID = 0)
	BEGIN

	    IF (@SiteID <> 0)
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID = @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
				ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
		END

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
			SELECT
				SN.SubNetworkID, 
				SN.SubNetworkAddress, 
				SN.LowerIP, 
				SN.HigherIP, 
				S.SiteName
			FROM
				SubNetworks SN
				INNER JOIN Sites S ON SN.SiteID = S.SiteID
			WHERE
				SN.SiteID <> @SiteID
			ORDER BY SN.SubNetworkAddress ASC
	END
END
GO
```

### proc_SubNetworks_Update

```sql
SET ANSI_NULLS OFF

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[proc_SubNetworks_Update]
@SubNetworkID INT,
@SiteID INT,
@SubNetworkAddress NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@LowerIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL,
@HigherIP NVARCHAR(15) = NULL
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @OldSiteID INT
	SELECT @OldSiteID = SiteID FROM SubNetworks WHERE SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID
 
	UPDATE
		SubNetworks
	SET      
		SiteID = @SiteID,
		SubNetworkAddress = @SubNetworkAddress,
		LowerIP = @LowerIP, 
		HigherIP = @HigherIP
	WHERE
		SubNetworkID = @SubNetworkID
	
	IF (@OldSiteID <> @SiteID)
	BEGIN
		--ATUALIZAR EQUIPAMENTOS
		--machines
		UPDATE Machines SET SiteID = @SiteID WHERE SiteID = @OldSiteID AND SiteForcedByUser = 0

		--impressoras
		-- AS imnpressoras serão atualziadas conforme chegarem. 
		-- Além disso é preciso criar AS filas de processamento para elas então não pode ser aqui

	END
	 
END
GO
```
